    /**
     * ============================================
     * MODAL / BOOTBOX CLOSE BUTTON (GLOBAL FIX)
     * ============================================
     * Bootbox renders the dismiss control as `.bootbox-close-button.close`
     * with the default Bootstrap `.close` styling (near-black glyph at .5
     * opacity). On the light modal headers used across the app that glyph is
     * effectively invisible — present and clickable, but not seen. Force a
     * clear, high-contrast, larger hit target on every modal so we no longer
     * need per-page patches.
     */
    .modal-header .close,
    .bootbox .modal-header .close,
    .bootbox-close-button.close {
        color: #212529 !important;
        opacity: 0.6 !important;
        text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fff !important;
        font-size: 1.6rem !important;
        line-height: 1 !important;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    .modal-header .close:hover,
    .bootbox .modal-header .close:hover,
    .bootbox-close-button.close:hover {
        opacity: 1 !important;
        color: #000 !important;

<script>
// Menu search: filters the entries as you type. A group stays when its own
// name or one of its entries matches ("pmta set" finds PMTA > Settings) and
// opens to show them; a heading stays while something under it does. Enter opens the first match,
// Escape clears, and "/" focuses the box from anywhere outside a text field.
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var input = document.getElementById('menuSearch');
    if (!input) return;
    var nav = input.closest('.nav-main');
    var empty = document.getElementById('menuSearchEmpty');
    var name = function (li) {
        var el = li.querySelector(':scope > .nav-main-link .nav-main-link-name');
        return (el ? el.textContent : '').toLowerCase();
    };

    function filter() {
        var words = input.value.toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        var searching = words.length > 0;
        var matches = function (text) { return words.every(function (w) { return text.indexOf(w) !== -1; }); };
        var any = false, heading = null, underHeading = false;
        var closeHeading = function () {
            if (heading) heading.classList.toggle('menu-hidden', searching && !underHeading);
        };

        Array.prototype.forEach.call(nav.children, function (li) {
            if (li.classList.contains('nav-main-heading')) {
                closeHeading();
                heading = li;
                underHeading = false;
                return;
            }
            if (!li.classList.contains('nav-main-item')) return;

            var entries = li.querySelectorAll(':scope > .nav-main-submenu > .nav-main-item');
            var own = name(li), show = true;
            if (!searching) {
                entries.forEach(function (entry) { entry.classList.remove('menu-hidden'); });
            } else if (!entries.length) {
                show = matches(own);
            } else {
                var whole = matches(own), shown = 0;
                entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                    var hit = whole || matches(own + ' ' + name(entry));
                    entry.classList.toggle('menu-hidden', !hit);
                    if (hit) shown++;
                });
                show = shown > 0;
            }
            li.classList.toggle('menu-hidden', !show);
            if (entries.length) {
                // a matching group opens the theme's own way; clearing the box
                // puts every group back as it was
                if (searching && !('wasOpen' in li.dataset)) li.dataset.wasOpen = li.classList.contains('open') ? '1' : '';
                if (searching) {
                    li.classList.toggle('open', show);
                } else if ('wasOpen' in li.dataset) {
                    li.classList.toggle('open', li.dataset.wasOpen === '1');
                    delete li.dataset.wasOpen;
                }
            }
            if (show) { any = true; underHeading = true; }
        });
        closeHeading();
        empty.hidden = !searching || any;
    }

    input.addEventListener('input', filter);
    input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            input.value = '';
            filter();
            input.blur();
        } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            var links = nav.querySelectorAll('a.nav-main-link:not(.nav-main-link-submenu)');
            for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
                if (!links[i].closest('.menu-hidden')) {
                    window.location.href = links[i].href;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        var t = e.target;
        if (e.key !== '/' || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
        if (/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName) || t.isContentEditable || (t.closest && t.closest('.ace_editor'))) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        input.focus();
    });
});
</script>

/* ---------- Hover cards (random types / redirect formats) ----------
   A native title="" cannot render a multi-line list, so these two tags
   use a CSS-only panel instead. It is pointer-events:none so it never
   intercepts the click that copies the tag. */
/* The bar must not clip the card, and the card must sit above page content -
   but only while a card is open. A permanent z-index: 1035 made the whole bar a
   stacking context above every Bootstrap / bootstrap-select dropdown (1000), so
   menus opened near the bar rendered underneath it. At rest the bar stays in
   normal flow; it is lifted just for the duration of a hover. */
.taghelper-bar {
    position: relative;
    z-index: auto;
}

.taghelper-bar:has(.tag-btn.has-hovercard:hover) {
    z-index: 1035;
}

.taghelper-bar,
.taghelper-bar .tags-container {
    overflow: visible;
}

.taghelper-bar .tag-btn.has-hovercard {
    position: relative;
}

/* Raise the whole tag (and therefore its card) above every sibling while
   hovered. Note .tag-btn sets backdrop-filter, which creates a stacking
   context — that is exactly why the card's own z-index was not enough and
   it rendered behind neighbouring elements. Lifting the tag itself is
   what actually fixes it. */
.taghelper-bar .tag-btn.has-hovercard:hover {
    z-index: 10002;
}

.taghelper-bar .hovercard {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 8px);
    left: 50%;
    /* --hc-shift nudges the card back inside the window when the tag sits
       near an edge (set by TagHelper). A margin, not part of the transform:
       the transform is animated, and a card sliding in from off-screen
       briefly widened the page on phones. */
    margin-left: var(--hc-shift, 0px);
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px);
    z-index: 10003;
    display: grid;
    gap: 2px;
    width: max-content;
    max-width: min(92vw, 560px);
    padding: 8px;
    background: #1f2937;
    color: #f9fafb;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    text-align: left;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, visibility 0.15s;
}

/* Bridges the 8px gap between tag and card so moving the pointer down to
   click a row does not drop :hover and close it. */
.taghelper-bar .hovercard::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -10px;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 10px;
}

.taghelper-bar .tag-btn.has-hovercard:hover .hovercard {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    pointer-events: auto;
}

    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 18px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding: 4px 6px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.12s ease;
}

.taghelper-bar .hovercard .hovercard-row:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
}

.taghelper-bar .hovercard .hovercard-row.copied {
    background: #10b981;
}

/* direct children only: a copied group row must not recolour its sub-menu */

<script>
var TagHelper = (function() {
    let currentModal = null;
    let escapeHandler = null;

    function flashCopied(el) {
        if (!el) return;
        el.classList.add('copied');
        setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('copied'), 600);
    }

    // Hover-card rows copy their own value. stopPropagation keeps the click
    // from ALSO firing the parent tag's onclick, and the element is passed
    // explicitly so the flash lands on the row rather than the whole tag.
    // Tracking links accept several path words per action (Token::PATHS, the
    // same list the tracker routes). Each copy picks one at random so every
    // campaign can use a different word.
    const TRACKING_WORDS = {"click":["read","click","link","go","visit","view","action","event","browse","page"],"unsubscribe":["opt","optout","remove","leave","uns","unsub","unsubscribe","opt-out","out","prefs"],"open":["img","open","image","src","media","static","pic","picture","opn","png","opener"],"bot":["nav"]};
    const TRACKING_TAILS = {
        click: '/[rndun_12]/[token]/[rndln_8]',
        unsubscribe: '/[rnda_14]/[token]/[rndn_5]',
        open: '/[rndu_10]/[token]/[rnda_6]',
    };

    // form 'host' = subdomain link: https://<word>.[domain]/[token]
    function trackingTag(kind, form) {
        const words = TRACKING_WORDS[kind] || [];
        if (!words.length || !TRACKING_TAILS[kind]) return '';
        const word = words[Math.floor(Math.random() * words.length)];
        return form === 'host'
            ? 'https://' + word + '.[domain]/[token]'
            : word + TRACKING_TAILS[kind];
    }

    // Cards are centred under their tag; for a tag near the window edge, slide
    // the card back inside (applied in CSS as margin-left via --hc-shift).
    // Done up front too, not only on hover: a hidden card still occupies
    // layout, and one hanging past the edge gave the page a sideways scroll.
    function placeCard(tag) {
        const card = tag.querySelector('.hovercard');
        if (!card) return;
        card.style.setProperty('--hc-shift', '0px');
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        const viewport = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
        let shift = 0;
        if (rect.right > viewport - 8) shift = viewport - 8 - rect.right;
        if (rect.left + shift < 8) shift = 8 - rect.left;
        card.style.setProperty('--hc-shift', Math.round(shift) + 'px');
    }

    const cardTags = document.querySelectorAll('.taghelper-bar .tag-btn.has-hovercard');
    cardTags.forEach(function (tag) {
        placeCard(tag);
        tag.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { placeCard(tag); });
    });
    let placeTimer = null;
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
        clearTimeout(placeTimer);
        placeTimer = setTimeout(function () { cardTags.forEach(placeCard); }, 150);
    });

    // Redirect menu: place a group's sub-menu where it fits — to the right,
    // else the left; on a narrow window one column instead of two, and as a
    // last resort below the row.
    document.querySelectorAll('.taghelper-bar .hc-group').forEach(function (group) {
        group.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
            const sub = group.querySelector('.hc-sub');
            if (!sub) return;
            const viewport = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
            const fits = function () {
                const r = sub.getBoundingClientRect();
                return r.left >= 8 && r.right <= viewport - 8;
            };
            const layouts = [[], ['hc-flip'], ['hc-narrow'], ['hc-narrow', 'hc-flip'], ['hc-narrow', 'hc-below']];
            for (const classes of layouts) {
                group.classList.remove('hc-flip', 'hc-narrow', 'hc-below');
                classes.forEach(function (c) { group.classList.add(c); });
                if (fits()) return;
            }
        });
    });

    function copyRow(e, text) {
        if (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            e.preventDefault();
        }
        const row = (e && e.currentTarget) ? e.currentTarget : null;
        copyToClipboard(text, row);
    }

    function copyToClipboard(text, targetEl) {
        if (!text) return;

        // Capture the clicked element NOW, synchronously. window.event is
        // already stale by the time the clipboard promise resolves, which
        // is why the green "copied" flash used to fire inconsistently.
        let clickedTag = targetEl || null;
        if (!clickedTag) {
            const src = (typeof window.event !== 'undefined' && window.event) ? window.event.target : null;
            clickedTag = (src && src.closest) ? src.closest('.hovercard-row, .tag-btn, .modal-tag') : null;
        }

        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
            showNotification(`Copied: ${text}`);
            flashCopied(clickedTag);
        }).catch(() => {
            // Fallback for older browsers
            const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
            textarea.value = text;
            textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
            textarea.style.opacity = '0';
            document.body.appendChild(textarea);
            textarea.select();
            document.execCommand('copy');
            document.body.removeChild(textarea);
            showNotification(`Copied: ${text}`);
            flashCopied(clickedTag);
        });
    }

    function showNotification(message) {
        const notification = document.getElementById('notification');
        const notificationText = notification.querySelector('.notification-text');
        notificationText.textContent = message;
        notification.classList.add('show');
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.classList.remove('show');
        }, 3000);
    }

    function openHelper() {
        // Tear down any previous instance (and its listener) first.
        if (currentModal) {
            currentModal.remove();
            currentModal = null;
        }
        detachEscape();

        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.className = 'professional-modal';

        modal.innerHTML = `
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h3 style="color: #fff !important;"><i class="fas fa-tags"></i> Complete Tag Reference</h3>
                    <div class="tr-tools">
                        <div class="tr-search-wrap">
                            <i class="fas fa-search"></i>
                            <input type="search" class="tr-search" placeholder="Search tags… (e.g. domain, random, unsubscribe)" autocomplete="off">
                        </div>
                        <label class="tr-toggle"><input type="checkbox" class="tr-gmail-only"> Works in Gmail sends</label>
                    </div>
                    <button class="modal-close" onclick="TagHelper.closeModal()" title="Close (Esc)">
                        <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <p class="tr-hint"><i class="fas fa-mouse-pointer"></i> Click any tag to copy it.</p>
                    ${getCompleteTags()}
                </div>
            </div>
        `;

        document.body.appendChild(modal);
        currentModal = modal;
        wireReference(modal);

        // Show modal with animation
        setTimeout(() => {
            modal.classList.add('show');
        }, 10);

        // Close on backdrop click
        modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
        });

        // Close on Escape. Kept in a variable so it is removed on EVERY
        // close path — previously it was only detached when Escape itself
        // was pressed, so closing via the X or backdrop left the listener
        // attached and they stacked up on each open.
        escapeHandler = function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
        };
        document.addEventListener('keydown', escapeHandler);
    }

    function detachEscape() {
        if (escapeHandler) {
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', escapeHandler);
            escapeHandler = null;
        }
    }

    function closeModal() {
        detachEscape();
        if (currentModal) {
            const modal = currentModal;
            currentModal = null;
            modal.classList.remove('show');
            setTimeout(() => modal.remove(), 300);
        }
    }

    const WHERE_LABEL = { all: 'PMTA + Gmail', pmta: 'PMTA', gmail: 'Gmail only', warmup: 'Warmup' };
    const ACTION_LABEL = { click: 'Click', unsubscribe: 'Unsubscribe', open: 'Open pixel', bot: 'Bot' };

    function esc(s) {
        return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
            return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
        });
    }

    function referenceRow(t) {
        const [tag, desc, example, where, flag] = t;
        return `
            <div class="tr-row${flag === 'warn' ? ' tr-row-warn' : ''}" data-where="${where}" data-search="${esc((tag + ' ' + desc + ' ' + example).toLowerCase())}">
                <span class="modal-tag tr-tag" data-copy="${esc(tag)}" title="Click to copy">${esc(tag)}</span>
                <span class="tr-desc">${esc(desc)}</span>
                <span class="tr-ex">${example ? esc(example) : ''}</span>
                <span class="tr-badge tr-badge-${where}">${WHERE_LABEL[where]}</span>
            </div>`;
    }

    function trackingBuilder() {
        const actions = Object.keys(ACTION_LABEL).map(function (a) {
            return `<button type="button" class="tr-seg-btn" data-action="${a}">${ACTION_LABEL[a]}</button>`;
        }).join('');
        const words = Object.keys(ACTION_LABEL).map(function (a) {
            return `<div class="tr-words-row"><strong>${ACTION_LABEL[a]}</strong>${(TRACKING_WORDS[a] || []).map(function (w, i) {
                return `<span class="tr-word${i === 0 ? ' tr-word-first' : ''}" data-pick="${a}:${esc(w)}" title="Use in the builder">${esc(w)}</span>`;
            }).join('')}</div>`;
        }).join('');

        return `
            <div class="tr-builder">
                <div class="tr-field"><label>Link for</label><div class="tr-seg" data-seg="action">${actions}</div></div>
                <div class="tr-field"><label>Shape</label><div class="tr-seg" data-seg="shape">
                    <button type="button" class="tr-seg-btn" data-shape="path">Path &nbsp;<small>http://[domain]/word/…</small></button>
                    <button type="button" class="tr-seg-btn" data-shape="host">Subdomain &nbsp;<small>https://word.[domain]/[token]</small></button>
                    <button type="button" class="tr-seg-btn" data-shape="bridge">Redirect page &nbsp;<small>https://your-page#[token]</small></button>
                </div></div>
                <div class="tr-field"><label>Word</label><div class="tr-wordpick">
                    <select class="tr-word-select"></select>
                    <button type="button" class="tr-btn tr-shuffle" title="Pick another word at random"><i class="fas fa-random"></i> Random word</button>
                </div></div>
                <div class="tr-out"><label>Link</label><code class="tr-link"></code><button type="button" class="tr-btn tr-copy-link"><i class="fas fa-copy"></i> Copy</button></div>
                <div class="tr-out tr-out-html"><label>HTML</label><code class="tr-html"></code><button type="button" class="tr-btn tr-copy-html"><i class="fas fa-copy"></i> Copy</button></div>
                <div class="tr-note"></div>
            </div>
            <details class="tr-details">
                <summary>All words you can use <small>(any word of an action does the same thing; click one to use it)</small></summary>
                <div class="tr-words">${words}</div>
            </details>
            <div class="tr-callout tr-callout-warn">
                <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
                <div>
                    <strong>Links that lose clicks:</strong> <code>[rnds_X]</code> inside a link (special characters break the URL), and the old
                    shapes <code>[rnd]rr[token]</code>, <code>[rnd]drdr[token]</code>, <code>uu</code>/<code>oo</code>/<code>bb</code>… — the tracker no longer serves them.
                    <br>
                    <strong>Shortening a link:</strong> put the token after the <code>#</code> and nothing else — <code>https://short.link/abc#[token]</code>.
                    Shorten a link whose token is in the path or the query and every recipient gets the same one, so every click, unsubscribe and sale
                    comes back with no recipient behind it.
                </div>
            </div>`;
    }

    function getCompleteTags() {
        const nav = REFERENCE.map(function (s) {
            return `<button type="button" class="tr-nav-btn" data-jump="${s.id}"><i class="fas ${s.icon}"></i> ${esc(s.title)}</button>`;
        }).join('');

        const sections = REFERENCE.map(function (s) {
            return `
                <div class="modal-section tr-section" id="tr-sec-${s.id}" data-section="${s.id}">
                    <h4><i class="fas ${s.icon}"></i>${esc(s.title)}</h4>
                    <p class="tr-intro">${esc(s.intro)}</p>
                    ${s.builder ? trackingBuilder() : ''}
                    <div class="tr-rows">${s.tags.map(referenceRow).join('')}</div>
                </div>`;
        }).join('');

        return `
            <div class="tr-nav">${nav}</div>
            ${sections}
            <div class="tr-empty" hidden><i class="fas fa-search"></i> No tag matches your search.</div>`;
    }

    // Link builder state + wiring, once the modal is in the page.
    function wireReference(modal) {
        const state = { action: 'click', shape: 'path', word: TRACKING_WORDS.click[0] };
        // Where the redirect page lives. Only an example: the page is yours to
        // host, and the shape of the link is what this is here to show.
        const BRIDGE = { click: 'https://your-site.example/go.html', unsubscribe: 'https://your-site.example/out.html' };
        const $ = function (sel) { return modal.querySelector(sel); };

        function render() {
            const words = TRACKING_WORDS[state.action] || [];
            if (!words.includes(state.word)) state.word = words[0];
            if (state.action === 'bot') state.shape = 'path'; // bot links are path-only
            // An open is an <img>: the browser fetches it and runs nothing, so a
            // page that reads the token with javascript can never see it.
            if (state.shape === 'bridge' && !BRIDGE[state.action]) state.shape = 'path';

            modal.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.action === state.action); });
            modal.querySelectorAll('[data-shape]').forEach(function (b) {
                b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.shape === state.shape);
                b.disabled = (b.dataset.shape === 'host' && state.action === 'bot')
                    || (b.dataset.shape === 'bridge' && !BRIDGE[state.action]);
            });

            $('.tr-wordpick').closest('.tr-field').hidden = state.shape === 'bridge';

            const select = $('.tr-word-select');
            select.innerHTML = words.map(function (w, i) {
                return `<option value="${esc(w)}"${w === state.word ? ' selected' : ''}>${esc(w)}${i === 0 ? ' (original)' : ''}</option>`;
            }).join('');

            const link = state.shape === 'bridge'
                ? BRIDGE[state.action] + '#[token]'
                : state.shape === 'host'
                    ? 'https://' + state.word + '.[domain]/[token]'
                    : 'http://[domain]/' + state.word + (TRACKING_TAILS[state.action] || TRACKING_TAILS.click);
            const html = {
                click: '<a href="' + link + '">Click here</a>',
                unsubscribe: '<a href="' + link + '">Unsubscribe</a>',
                open: '<img src="' + link + '" width="1" height="1" alt="" />',
            }[state.action];

            $('.tr-link').textContent = link;
            $('.tr-copy-link').dataset.copy = link;
            $('.tr-out-html').hidden = !html;
            if (html) {
                $('.tr-html').textContent = html;
                $('.tr-copy-html').dataset.copy = html;
            }
            $('.tr-note').innerHTML = state.shape === 'bridge'
                ? '<i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> A page you host that reads the token after the <code>#</code> and forwards it to the tracker, picking one of the words above at random. Nothing after the <code>#</code> is ever sent to a server, so the same shortened link works for every recipient. Swap <code>your-site.example</code> for wherever you put the page. <strong>Opens cannot use it</strong> — an <code>&lt;img&gt;</code> runs no javascript, so the pixel has to point at <code>[domain]</code> directly.'
                : state.shape === 'host'
                    ? '<i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> Subdomain links need a wildcard DNS record (<code>*</code>) and https on <code>[domain]</code>, and <code>[domain]</code> must be a root domain: <code>click.example.com</code> works, <code>click.sub.example.com</code> does not.'
                    : '<i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> The <code>[rnd…]</code> parts change for every email. Mixing different types and lengths makes each link look different.';
        }

        modal.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            const copy = e.target.closest('[data-copy]');
            if (copy) { copyToClipboard(copy.dataset.copy, copy); return; }

            const action = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
            if (action) { state.action = action.dataset.action; render(); return; }

            const shape = e.target.closest('[data-shape]');
            if (shape && !shape.disabled) { state.shape = shape.dataset.shape; render(); return; }

            if (e.target.closest('.tr-shuffle')) {
                const words = (TRACKING_WORDS[state.action] || []).filter(function (w) { return w !== state.word; });
                if (words.length) state.word = words[Math.floor(Math.random() * words.length)];
                render();
                return;
            }

            const pick = e.target.closest('[data-pick]');
            if (pick) {
                const parts = pick.dataset.pick.split(':');
                state.action = parts[0];
                state.word = parts[1];
                render();
                $('.tr-builder').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
                return;
            }

            const jump = e.target.closest('[data-jump]');
            if (jump) {
                const target = modal.querySelector('#tr-sec-' + jump.dataset.jump);
                if (target) target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            }
        });

        $('.tr-word-select').addEventListener('change', function (e) { state.word = e.target.value; render(); });

        // Search + "works in Gmail" filter.
        const search = $('.tr-search');
        const gmailOnly = $('.tr-gmail-only');
        function filter() {
            const q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
            const onlyGmail = gmailOnly.checked;
            let shown = 0;
            modal.querySelectorAll('.tr-section').forEach(function (sec) {
                let visible = 0;
                sec.querySelectorAll('.tr-row').forEach(function (row) {
                    const ok = (!q || row.dataset.search.includes(q))
                        && (!onlyGmail || row.dataset.where === 'all' || row.dataset.where === 'gmail');
                    row.hidden = !ok;
                    if (ok) visible++;
                });
                // The link builder ([domain], [token], [rnd…] all work in Gmail too)
                // stays visible unless the search is clearly about something else.
                const showBuilder = sec.dataset.section === 'tracking'
                    && (!q || /link|track|click|open|unsub|pixel|bot|redirect|url|word|subdomain|short/.test(q));
                sec.querySelectorAll('.tr-builder, .tr-details, .tr-callout').forEach(function (el) { el.hidden = !showBuilder; });
                sec.hidden = visible === 0 && !showBuilder;
                if (!sec.hidden) shown++;
                const navBtn = modal.querySelector('[data-jump="' + sec.dataset.section + '"]');
                if (navBtn) navBtn.hidden = sec.hidden;
            });
            $('.tr-empty').hidden = shown > 0;
        }
        search.addEventListener('input', filter);
        gmailOnly.addEventListener('change', filter);

        render();
        setTimeout(function () { search.focus(); }, 50);
    }

    // Copying is wired through the inline onclick on each tag. (A delegated
    // document click listener used to live here reading a data-tag attribute
    // that no element ever had, so it always copied null — removed.)

    return {
        openHelper: openHelper,
        closeModal: closeModal,
        copyToClipboard: copyToClipboard,
        copyRow: copyRow,
        trackingTag: trackingTag
    };
})();
</script>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

                    <h2>Method 5: Complete Solution</h2>
                    <p>Complete solution with error handling and URL encoding.</p>
                    
                    <p><strong>Complete solution - replaces your meta refresh method with <strong>?=</strong> parameter handling:</strong></p>
                    <div class="code">
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                        try {
    const currentUrl = window.location.href;
    const urlParts = currentUrl.split('?=');
    
    if (urlParts.length > 1 && urlParts[1]) {
        const param = urlParts[1];
        window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/' + encodeURIComponent(param);
    } else {
        window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/';
    }
} catch (error) {
    console.error('Redirect failed:', error);
    window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/';

                    <h2>Method 10: AJAX Redirect</h2>
                    <p>Check server response before redirecting.</p>
                    
                    <p><strong>Fetch and redirect with <strong>?=</strong> parameter:</strong></p>
                    <div class="code">
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                        const param = window.location.href.split('?=')[1];
if (param) {
    fetch('https://tiphp.com/check', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({redirect: param}),
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.valid) {
            window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/' + param;
        }
    });
}
                    </div>
                    
                    <p><strong>XMLHttpRequest redirect:</strong></p>
                    <div class="code">
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                        const param = window.location.href.split('?=')[1];
if (param) {
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('GET', 'https://tiphp.com/validate?param=' + param);
    xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
        if (xhr.readyState === 4 && xhr.status === 200) {
            window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/' + param;
        }
    };
    xhr.send();
}

                <div class="method">
                    <h2>Method 14: Multiple Parameter Handling</h2>
                    <p>Handle different parameter formats and multiple parameters.</p>
                    
                    <p><strong>Handle both <strong>?=</strong> and standard URL parameters:</strong></p>
                    <div class="code">
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                        function getRedirectParam() {
    let param = window.location.href.split('?=')[1];
    
    if (!param) {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        param = urlParams.get('redirect') || urlParams.get('url') || urlParams.get('target');
    }
    
    return param;
}

const param = getRedirectParam();
if (param) {
    window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/' + encodeURIComponent(param);
}
                    </div>
                    
                    <p><strong>Parse multiple <strong>?=</strong> style parameters:</strong></p>
                    <div class="code">
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                        const url = window.location.href;
const parts = url.split('?=');

if (parts.length > 1) {
    const allParams = parts.slice(1);
    const mainParam = allParams[0];
    const additionalData = allParams.slice(1).join('&');
    
    let redirectUrl = 'https://tiphp.com/' + encodeURIComponent(mainParam);
    if (additionalData) {
        redirectUrl += '?data=' + encodeURIComponent(additionalData);
    }
    
    window.location.href = redirectUrl;
}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="method">
                    <h2>Method 15: Secure Redirect</h2>
                    <p>Validate and sanitize parameters before redirecting.</p>
                    
                    <p><strong>Whitelist validation with <strong>?=</strong> parameter:</strong></p>
                    <div class="code">
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                        const param = window.location.href.split('?=')[1];
const allowedDomains = ['page1', 'page2', 'section1', 'section2'];

if (param && allowedDomains.includes(param)) {
    window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/' + param;
} else {
    window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/error';
}
                    </div>
                    
                    <p><strong>Sanitize parameter and validate URL:</strong></p>
                    <div class="code">
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                        function sanitizeParam(param) {
    return param.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\-_]/g, '');
}

function isValidRedirect(param) {
    const sanitized = sanitizeParam(param);
    return sanitized.length > 0 && sanitized.length < 100;
}

const param = window.location.href.split('?=')[1];
if (param && isValidRedirect(param)) {
    const cleanParam = sanitizeParam(param);
    window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/' + cleanParam;
} else {
    window.location.href = 'https://tiphp.com/';
}
                    </div>
                </div>

    iframe.src = 'https://tiphp.com/' + param;
    iframe.onload = function() {
        window.location.href = iframe.src;
    };
}
&lt;/script&gt;
                    </div>

               <div class="method">

const param = window.location.href.split('?=')[1];

               <div class="method">
                   <h2>Method 22: HTML Data Attributes Redirect</h2>
                   <p>Using HTML5 data attributes for redirect configuration.</p>
                   
                   <p><strong>Direct data attribute redirect with <strong>?=</strong> parameter:</strong></p>
                   <div class="code">
                       <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                       &lt;div id="redirectConfig" 
    data-base-url="https://tiphp.com/" 
    data-redirect-delay="0"&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;script&gt;
const param = window.location.href.split('?=')[1];
if (param) {
   const config = document.getElementById('redirectConfig');
   const baseUrl = config.dataset.baseUrl;
   const delay = parseInt(config.dataset.redirectDelay);
   
   const redirectUrl = baseUrl + param;
   
   if (delay === 0) {
       window.location.href = redirectUrl;
   } else {
       setTimeout(() => {
           window.location.href = redirectUrl;
       }, delay);
   }
}
&lt;/script&gt;
                   </div>
                   
                   <p><strong>Direct device-based redirect with data attributes:</strong></p>
                   <div class="code">
                       <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
                       &lt;div id="redirectOptions"
    data-mobile-url="https://m.tiphp.com/"
    data-desktop-url="https://tiphp.com/"
    data-tablet-url="https://tablet.tiphp.com/"&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;script&gt;
const param = window.location.href.split('?=')[1];
if (param) {
   const options = document.getElementById('redirectOptions');
   const isMobile = /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
   const isTablet = /iPad/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
   
   let baseUrl;
   if (isMobile) {
       baseUrl = options.dataset.mobileUrl;
   } else if (isTablet) {
       baseUrl = options.dataset.tabletUrl;
   } else {
       baseUrl = options.dataset.desktopUrl;
   }
   
   window.location.href = baseUrl + param;
}
&lt;/script&gt;
                   </div>
               </div>

           <script>
               function copyCode(button) {
                   const codeBlock = button.parentNode;
                   const codeText = codeBlock.textContent || codeBlock.innerText;
                   const cleanCode = codeText.replace('Copy', '').replace(/<strong>|<\/strong>/g, '').trim();
                   
                   if (navigator.clipboard) {
                       navigator.clipboard.writeText(cleanCode).then(function() {
                           const originalText = button.textContent;
                           button.textContent = 'Copied!';
                           button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
                           button.classList.add('btn-success');
                           
                           setTimeout(function() {
                               button.textContent = originalText;
                               button.classList.remove('btn-success');
                               button.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
                           }, 2000);
                       }).catch(function(err) {
                           fallbackCopyCode(cleanCode);
                       });
                   } else {
                       fallbackCopyCode(cleanCode);
                   }
               }

               function fallbackCopyCode(text) {
                   const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
                   textArea.value = text;
                   document.body.appendChild(textArea);
                   textArea.select();
                   try {
                       document.execCommand('copy');
                       alert('Code copied to clipboard!');
                   } catch (err) {
                       alert('Copy failed. Please copy manually.');
                   }
                   document.body.removeChild(textArea);
               }
           </script>
       </div>
   </div>

<script>
    window.__campaignHeaderTabsConfig = {
        aceId: "campaign_header",
        initialHeaders: ["Subject: [placeholder2]\nFrom: [placeholder1] <dorns2kids@[domain]>\nContent-Type: multipart\/alternative;\n\tboundary=[bndu\/25]\nX-[rndl_5]:  Mailer v[rndn_6].[rndn_6]\nMessage-Id: <[rndl_2][rndn_18][rndl_2][to].[rndl_5]>\nDate: [date]\nTo: [to]\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: 7bit\nMime-Version: 1.0 (1.0)\nX-DLP-OUTBOUND: 137.118.40.128\/25\nX-MAG-OUTBOUND: greymail.redcondor.net@137.118.40.128\/25"],
        defaultHeaderTemplate: "To: \u003C[to]\u003E\nSubject: New WordPress Site\nX-PHP-Originating-Script: 1007:PHPMailer.php\nDate: [date]\nFrom: WordPress \u003Cwordpress@[domain]\u003E\nMessage-ID: \u003C[rndA_25]@[domain]\u003E\nX-Mailer: PHPMailer 6.6.5 (https:\/\/github.com\/PHPMailer\/PHPMailer)\nMIME-Version: 1.0\nContent-Type: text\/plain; charset=UTF-8",
        maxTabs: 10
    };

<script>
(function () {
    const cfg = window.__campaignHeaderTabsConfig || {};
    const maxTabs = cfg.maxTabs || 10;

    function defaultHeaderText() {
        return typeof cfg.defaultHeaderTemplate === 'string' ? cfg.defaultHeaderTemplate : '';
    }

    window.campaignHeaderTabs = {
        activeIndex: 0,
        headers: [],
        editor: null,

        init: function (editor) {
            this.editor = editor;
            const initial = Array.isArray(cfg.initialHeaders) && cfg.initialHeaders.length
                ? cfg.initialHeaders.slice()
                : [defaultHeaderText()];
            this.headers = initial;
            this.activeIndex = 0;
            this.renderTabs();
            this.editor.session.setValue(this.headers[0] || '');
            this.bindTabControls();
            this.keepNeighbourLevel();
        },

        // The tabs and "rotate every" stand above the header editor, so it
        // ends lower than the editor beside it - the body's, on every page
        // that has the two. That editor is given the height it needs to end
        // level with this one, while they stand side by side; under it, on a
        // narrow screen, or out of sight, it keeps (or gets back) its own.
        levelNeighbour: function () {
            const header = this.editor.container.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (!header.width) {
                return;
            }
            document.querySelectorAll('.ace_editor').forEach((el) => {
                const other = el.env && el.env.editor;
                const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (!other || other === this.editor || !box.width) {
                    return;
                }
                // its own size, as the page set it: a number of lines, or a height
                if (el.dataset.ownMax === undefined) {
                    el.dataset.ownMax = other.getOption('maxLines') || '';
                    el.dataset.ownMin = other.getOption('minLines') || '';
                    el.dataset.ownHeight = el.style.height || '';
                }
                const beside = (box.left >= header.right - 1 || header.left >= box.right - 1) && box.top < header.bottom;
                // from where it starts down to where the header editor ends
                const reach = header.bottom - box.top - 2;
                if (el.dataset.ownMax) {
                    const own = parseInt(el.dataset.ownMax, 10);
                    const lines = beside ? Math.max(own, Math.round(reach / (other.renderer.lineHeight || 19))) : own;
                    const least = beside && lines > own ? lines : (parseInt(el.dataset.ownMin, 10) || undefined);
                    if (other.getOption('maxLines') !== lines || other.getOption('minLines') !== least) {
                        other.setOptions({minLines: least, maxLines: lines});
                        other.resize(true);
                    }
                } else {
                    const height = beside && reach > box.height + 4 ? Math.round(reach) + 'px' : (beside ? el.style.height : el.dataset.ownHeight);
                    if (el.style.height !== height) {
                        el.style.height = height;
                        other.resize(true);
                    }
                }
            });
        },

        keepNeighbourLevel: function () {
            let timer = null;
            const soon = () => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => this.levelNeighbour(), 80); };
            soon();
            // the editor beside is often made after this one, and fonts move things once loaded
            setTimeout(soon, 700);
            $(window).off('.headerTabsLevel').on('load.headerTabsLevel resize.headerTabsLevel', soon);
        },

        flushActive: function () {
            if (!this.editor) {
                return;
            }
            this.headers[this.activeIndex] = this.editor.session.getValue();
        },

        renderTabs: function () {
            const $nav = $('#campaign_header_tabs');
            $nav.empty();
            this.headers.forEach((_, i) => {
                const isActive = i === this.activeIndex;
                const $li = $('<li class="nav-item" role="presentation"/>');
                const $link = $('<a class="nav-link" href="#" role="tab"/>')
                    .text('Header ' + (i + 1))
                    .toggleClass('active', isActive);
                if (this.headers.length > 1) {
                    const $close = $('<button type="button" class="close ml-1" aria-label="Remove">&times;</button>')
                        .on('click', (e) => {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            this.removeTab(i);
                        });
                    $link.append($close);
                }
                $link.on('click', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.switchTab(i);
                });
                $li.append($link);
                $nav.append($li);
            });
            const activeEl = $nav.find('.nav-link.active')[0];
            if (activeEl) {
                activeEl.scrollIntoView({block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest'});
            }
        },

        switchTab: function (index) {
            if (index === this.activeIndex || index < 0 || index >= this.headers.length) {
                return;
            }
            this.flushActive();
            this.activeIndex = index;
            this.editor.session.setValue(this.headers[index] || '');
            this.renderTabs();
        },

        addTab: function () {
            if (this.headers.length >= maxTabs) {
                return;
            }
            this.flushActive();
            const template = defaultHeaderText();
            this.headers.push(template);
            this.activeIndex = this.headers.length - 1;
            this.editor.session.setValue(template);
            this.renderTabs();
        },

        removeTab: function (index) {
            if (this.headers.length <= 1) {
                return;
            }
            this.flushActive();
            this.headers.splice(index, 1);
            if (this.activeIndex >= this.headers.length) {
                this.activeIndex = this.headers.length - 1;
            }
            this.editor.session.setValue(this.headers[this.activeIndex] || '');
            this.renderTabs();
        },

        // a list of headers put in the tabs, in place of those there (a test opened again on the Create page)
        load: function (headers, rotateEvery) {
            this.headers = (Array.isArray(headers) && headers.length ? headers : [defaultHeaderText()]).slice(0, maxTabs);
            this.activeIndex = 0;
            this.editor.session.setValue(this.headers[0] || '');
            $('#header_rotate_every').val(Math.max(1, parseInt(rotateEvery, 10) || 1));
            this.renderTabs();
        },

        bindTabControls: function () {
            $('#campaign_header_tab_add').off('click').on('click', () => this.addTab());
        },

        collectPayload: function (activeTabOnly) {
            this.flushActive();
            const rotate = parseInt($('#header_rotate_every').val(), 10) || 1;
            const texts = activeTabOnly
                ? [this.headers[this.activeIndex] || '']
                : this.headers.slice();
            return {
                header_2: texts.map((t) => b64encode(t)),
                header_rotate_every: rotate
            };
        }
    };
})();
</script>
                        <div id="ace-encode-toolbar"
     data-encode-url="https://a-p.io/mailer/tools/encoding/encode"
     style="display:none;position:fixed;z-index:10000;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ced4da;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px;box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.18);white-space:nowrap;">
    <small class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px;">ENCODE:</small>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary mr-1"   data-ace-action="b64enc" title="Base64 encoded-word  →  =?UTF-8?B?...?=">B64 ↑</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary mr-1"   data-ace-action="b64dec" title="Base64 decode  →  plain text">B64 ↓</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-warning mr-1"   data-ace-action="qpenc"  title="Quoted-Printable encoded-word  →  =?UTF-8?Q?...?=">QP ↑</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary mr-1" data-ace-action="urlenc" title="URL encode  →  %XX">URL ↑</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary"      data-ace-action="urldec" title="URL decode  →  plain text">URL ↓</button>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
    // Encode-on-select is OFF by default so the toolbar never pops up
    // unexpectedly. The user turns it on/off via a toggle icon (added next to
    // the header "Encoding" icon). Preference is remembered across page loads.
    var STORAGE_KEY = 'aceEncodeOnSelect';
    var encodeEnabled = false;
    try { encodeEnabled = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) === '1'; } catch (e) {}

    function refreshToggle($toggle) {
        if (encodeEnabled) {
            $toggle.css('color', '#4680ff')
                   .attr('title', 'Encode-on-select: ON — select text to show the Base64/QP/URL toolbar. Click to turn off.');
        } else {
            $toggle.css('color', '#adb5bd')
                   .attr('title', 'Encode-on-select: OFF — click to enable the Base64/QP/URL toolbar when selecting text.');
        }
    }

    window.initAceEncodeToolbar = function (editor) {
        var $toolbar    = $('#ace-encode-toolbar');
        var encodeUrl   = $toolbar.data('encode-url');

        // ── toggle control (added once, next to the header "Encoding" icon) ──
        var $toggle = $('#ace-encode-sel-toggle');
        if (!$toggle.length) {
            $toggle = $('<i>', {
                id: 'ace-encode-sel-toggle',
                class: 'fas fa-code curs mr-2'
            });
            if ($('#encode').length) {
                $('#encode').after($toggle);          // sit beside the existing Encoding icon
            } else {
                $toggle.addClass('ml-2');
                $(editor.container).before($toggle);  // fallback: just above the editor
            }
            refreshToggle($toggle);

            $toggle.on('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                encodeEnabled = !encodeEnabled;
                try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, encodeEnabled ? '1' : '0'); } catch (err) {}
                refreshToggle($toggle);
                if (!encodeEnabled) { $toolbar.hide(); }
            });
        }

        // ── show toolbar after mouse selection (only when enabled) ───────────
        editor.container.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) {
            if (!encodeEnabled) { return; }
            setTimeout(function () {
                var selected = editor.getSelectedText();
                if (selected && selected.length > 0) {
                    var toolbarWidth = 340;
                    var left = e.clientX;
                    var top  = e.clientY + 14;

                    if (left + toolbarWidth > window.innerWidth - 5) {
                        left = window.innerWidth - toolbarWidth - 5;
                    }
                    left = Math.max(left, 5);

                    $toolbar.css({ top: top + 'px', left: left + 'px' }).show();
                }
            }, 10);
        });

        // ── hide when clicking outside toolbar / editor ──────────────────────
        $(document).off('mousedown.aceEncTb').on('mousedown.aceEncTb', function (e) {
            if (!$(e.target).closest('#ace-encode-toolbar').length &&
                !$(e.target).closest(editor.container).length) {
                $toolbar.hide();
            }
        });

        // ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        function flashError($btn) {
            var origClass = $btn.attr('class');
            $btn.removeClass('btn-outline-primary btn-outline-secondary btn-outline-warning').addClass('btn-danger');
            setTimeout(function () { $btn.attr('class', origClass); }, 900);
        }

        function applyResult(result) {
            editor.session.replace(editor.selection.getRange(), result);
            $toolbar.hide();
        }

        // ── button actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
        $toolbar.off('click.aceEncode').on('click.aceEncode', '[data-ace-action]', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();

            var $btn     = $(this);
            var action   = $btn.data('ace-action');
            var selected = editor.getSelectedText();
            if (!selected) return;

            try {
                switch (action) {

                    case 'b64enc':
                        // =?UTF-8?B?base64text?=
                        applyResult('=?UTF-8?B?' + btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(selected))) + '?=');
                        break;

                    case 'b64dec':
                        // strip =?...?B?...?= wrapper if present, then decode
                        var b64match = selected.trim().match(/=\?[^?]+\?B\?([^?]+)\?=/i);
                        var b64text  = b64match ? b64match[1] : selected.trim();
                        applyResult(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(b64text))));
                        break;

                    case 'urlenc':
                        applyResult(encodeURIComponent(selected));
                        break;

                    case 'urldec':
                        applyResult(decodeURIComponent(selected));
                        break;

                    case 'qpenc':
                        // server-side QP → =?UTF-8?Q?...?=
                        var origHtml = $btn.html();
                        $btn.attr('disabled', true).html('<span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm"></span>');
                        $.ajax({
                            url:      encodeUrl,
                            type:     'post',
                            dataType: 'json',
                            data:     { string: selected, schema: 'Q', charset: 'UTF-8' }
                        }).done(function (res) {
                            applyResult(res);
                        }).fail(function () {
                            flashError($btn);
                        }).always(function () {
                            $btn.attr('disabled', false).html(origHtml);
                        });
                        break;
                }
            } catch (err) {
                flashError($btn);
            }
        });
    };
}());
</script>

        generate: function(baseDomains, count) {
            var result = [], total = this.patternFunctions.length;
            baseDomains.forEach(function(base) {
                var domain = base.trim();
                if (!domain) return;
                for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    result.push(this.patternFunctions[i % total](domain));
                }
            }.bind(this));
            return result;
        }
    };

    function r(len) {
        var s = '';
        for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) s += Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
        return s;
    }
    function rl(len) {
        var alpha = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', s = '';
        for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) s += alpha[Math.floor(Math.random() * alpha.length)];
        return s;
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

    function loadIps(serverIds) {
        var $sel = $('#vmqm-ips');
        if (!serverIds || !serverIds.length) {
            $sel.html('<option disabled value="">— select servers first —</option>');
            return;
        }
        $sel.html('<option disabled>Loading...</option>');
        $.get('https://a-p.io/mailer/pmta/ips-for-servers', {servers: serverIds})
            .done(function(res) {
                var opts = res.data.map(function(ip) {
                    return '<option value="' + ip.id + '">' + ip.ip + '</option>';
                }).join('');
                $sel.html(opts || '<option disabled>No IPs found</option>');
            })
            .fail(function() {
                $sel.html('<option disabled>Failed to load IPs</option>');
            });
    }

    $('#vmtaQuickModal').on('show.bs.modal', function() {
        var selectedServers = $('#servers').val() || [];
        var opts = $('#servers option').map(function() {
            var v = $(this).val();
            var sel = selectedServers.indexOf(v) !== -1 ? ' selected' : '';
            return '<option value="' + v + '"' + sel + '>' + $(this).text() + '</option>';
        }).get().join('');
        $('#vmqm-servers').html(opts);
        loadIps(selectedServers);
        $('#vmqm-result').hide();
        $('#vmqm-result-body').html('');
        $('#vmqm-dkim').prop('checked', false);
        $('#vmqm-dkim-isp').val('');
        $('#vmqm-dkim-isp-wrap').hide();
    });

    $('#vmqm-servers').on('change', function() {
        loadIps($(this).val());
    });

    $('#vmqm-clear-domains').on('click', function() {
        $('#vmqm-domains').val('');
    });

    $('#vmqm-dkim').on('change', function() {
        if (this.checked) {
            $('#vmqm-dkim-isp-wrap').show();
            return;
        }
        $('#vmqm-dkim-isp-wrap').hide();
        $('#vmqm-dkim-isp').val('');
    });

    $('#vmqm-gen-domains').on('click', function() {
        swal.fire({
            title: 'Generate Domains',
            html:
                '<div style="text-align:left"><label style="font-size:13px">Base domains (one per line)</label></div>' +
                '<textarea id="vmqm-swal-bases" class="swal2-textarea" style="height:90px" placeholder="example.com&#10;test.com"></textarea>' +
                '<div style="text-align:left;margin-top:6px"><label style="font-size:13px">Count per domain</label></div>' +
                '<input id="vmqm-swal-count" class="swal2-input" type="number" value="14" min="1" max="100">',
            confirmButtonText: 'Generate',
            showCancelButton: true,
            preConfirm: function() {
                var bases = document.getElementById('vmqm-swal-bases').value
                    .split('\n').map(function(s){ return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
                var count = parseInt(document.getElementById('vmqm-swal-count').value) || 0;
                if (!bases.length) { swal.showValidationMessage('Enter at least one base domain'); return false; }
                if (count < 1)     { swal.showValidationMessage('Count must be at least 1');       return false; }
                if (count > 100)   { swal.showValidationMessage('Maximum 100 per domain');         return false; }
                return {bases: bases, count: count};
            }
        }).then(function(result) {
            if (result.value) {
                var generated = VmqmDomainGenerator.generate(result.value.bases, result.value.count);
                var current = $('#vmqm-domains').val().trim();
                $('#vmqm-domains').val(current ? current + '\n' + generated.join('\n') : generated.join('\n'));
            }
        });
    });

    // Result table, used by both Push and Reset (same response shape).
    function showResults(data) {
        var rows = '';
        $.each(data || {}, function(k, v) {
            var text = (v && v.data != null) ? String(v.data) : String(v);
            var cls = text.toUpperCase().includes('ERROR') ? 'text-danger' : 'text-success';
            rows += '<tr><td><strong>' + ((v && v.id) || '') + '</strong></td><td class="' + cls + '"><strong>' + text + '</strong></td></tr>';
        });
        $('#vmqm-result-body').html(rows);
        $('#vmqm-result').show();
    }

    // Reset (restore) the VMTAs of the selected IPs — same action as the
    // RESET VMTAs button on the PMTA VMTA page.
    $('#vmqm-reset').on('click', function() {
        var $btn = $(this);
        var origHtml = $btn.html();
        var ips = $('#vmqm-ips').val();

        if (!ips || !ips.length) { swal.fire('Oops', 'Select at least one IP', 'error'); return; }

        swal.fire({
            icon: 'question',
            title: 'Are you sure ?',
            text: 'Your Vmta\'s in those servers will be reset',
            allowOutsideClick: false,
            showCloseButton: true,
            confirmButtonText: 'YES',
            showCancelButton: true,
        }).then(function(result) {
            if (!result.value) return;

            $.ajax({
                url:      'https://a-p.io/mailer/pmta/restore-vmta',
                type:     'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                data:     {ips: ips},
                beforeSend: function() {
                    $btn.attr('disabled', true).html('Resetting… <span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm"></span>');
                    $('#vmqm-push').attr('disabled', true);
                    $('#vmqm-result').hide();
                }
            }).done(function(res) {
                showResults(res.data);
            }).fail(function(xhr) {
                var msg = (xhr.responseJSON && (xhr.responseJSON.message || xhr.responseJSON.data)) || 'Reset failed';
                swal.fire('Error', msg, 'error');
            }).always(function() {
                $btn.attr('disabled', false).html(origHtml);
                $('#vmqm-push').attr('disabled', false);
            });
        });
    });

    $('#vmqm-push').on('click', function() {
        var $btn = $(this);
        var origHtml = $btn.html();
        var ips     = $('#vmqm-ips').val();
        var domains = $.unique(
            $('#vmqm-domains').val().split('\n')
                .map(function(s){ return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean)
        );
        var route = $('#vmqm-route').is(':checked') ? 1 : 0;
        var dkim  = $('#vmqm-dkim').is(':checked') ? 1 : 0;
        var isp   = dkim ? $('#vmqm-dkim-isp').val() : '';

        if (!ips || !ips.length)  { swal.fire('Oops', 'Select at least one IP', 'error');     return; }
        if (!domains.length)      { swal.fire('Oops', 'Enter at least one domain', 'error'); return; }
        if (dkim && !isp)         { swal.fire('Oops', 'Select the ISP config to add the dkim-identity to', 'error'); return; }

        $.ajax({
            url:      'https://a-p.io/mailer/pmta/push-vmta',
            type:     'POST',
            dataType: 'json',
            data:     {ips: ips, domains: domains, route: route, dkim_identity: dkim, isp: isp},
            beforeSend: function() {
                $btn.attr('disabled', true).html('Pushing… <span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm"></span>');
                $('#vmqm-reset').attr('disabled', true);
                $('#vmqm-result').hide();
            }
        }).done(function(res) {
            showResults(res.data);
        }).fail(function(xhr) {
            var msg = (xhr.responseJSON && (xhr.responseJSON.message || xhr.responseJSON.data)) || 'Push failed';
            swal.fire('Error', msg, 'error');
        }).always(function() {
            $btn.attr('disabled', false).html(origHtml);
            $('#vmqm-reset').attr('disabled', false);
        });
    });

    }); // DOMContentLoaded
}());
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    window.initEmailFetcher = function (editorHeader, editorBody) {
        var accountsUrl = 'https://a-p.io/mailer/tools/fetcher/accounts';
        var fetchUrl    = 'https://a-p.io/mailer/tools/fetcher/fetch';
        var lastUrl     = 'https://a-p.io/mailer/tools/fetcher/last';
        var clearUrl    = 'https://a-p.io/mailer/tools/fetcher/clear';
        var ignoreUrl   = 'https://a-p.io/mailer/tools/fetcher/ignore-sender';
        var csrf        = $('meta[name="csrf-token"]').attr('content');

        var state = { items: [], filtered: [], index: 0, shown: false, loadedAccounts: false, loadedStored: false };

        function status(msg, cls) {
            $('#fe_status').removeClass('text-muted text-danger text-success')
                           .addClass(cls || 'text-muted').html(msg || '');
        }

        function subjectOf(header) {
            var m = (header || '').match(/^Subject:\s*(.+(?:\n[ \t].+)*)/mi);
            return m ? m[1].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : '(no subject)';
        }

        function loadAccounts(force) {
            if (state.loadedAccounts && !force) return;
            var previouslySelected = $('#fe_account').val() || [];
            $.getJSON(accountsUrl).done(function (res) {
                var $sel = $('#fe_account').empty();
                (res.data || []).forEach(function (email) {
                    $sel.append($('<option>').val(email).text(email));
                });
                $sel.val(previouslySelected); // keep prior selection where still present
                if (res.limit && !state.loadedAccounts) $('#fe_limit').val(res.limit);
                if (!(res.data || []).length) {
                    status('No accounts configured yet — use "Manage accounts" below.', 'text-danger');
                } else if (force) {
                    status('Accounts reloaded (' + res.data.length + ').', 'text-success');
                }
                state.loadedAccounts = true;
            }).fail(function () {
                status('Could not load accounts.', 'text-danger');
            });
        }

        function buildVerdicts() {
            var set = { 'All Emails': true };
            state.items.forEach(function (e) { if (e.verdict) set[e.verdict] = true; });
            var $v = $('#fe_verdict').empty();
            Object.keys(set).forEach(function (v) { $v.append($('<option>').val(v).text(v)); });
            $v.val('All Emails');
        }

        function applyFilter() {
            var v = $('#fe_verdict').val();
            state.filtered = (v === 'All Emails' || !v)
                ? state.items.slice()
                : state.items.filter(function (e) { return e.verdict === v; });
            state.index = 0;
            updateInfo(); // refresh counters/preview without touching the editors
        }

        // Update the modal preview + the header Prev/Next counter (no editor writes).
        function updateInfo() {
            var n = state.filtered.length;
            $('#fe_counter').text((n ? state.index + 1 : 0) + ' / ' + n);
            // Header counter shows a dash until the first navigation writes an item.
            $('#fetch_counter').text(n ? ((state.shown ? state.index + 1 : '–') + '/' + n) : '');
            if (!n) {
                $('#fe_from').text('—'); $('#fe_subject').text('—'); $('#fe_verdict_badge').text('—');
                return;
            }
            var item = state.filtered[state.index];
            $('#fe_from').text(item.from || '—');
            $('#fe_subject').text(subjectOf(item.header));
            $('#fe_verdict_badge').text(item.verdict || '—');
        }

        // Write the current message into the Header & Body editors.
        function render() {
            if (!state.filtered.length) { updateInfo(); return; }
            var item = state.filtered[state.index];
            editorHeader.session.setValue(item.header || '');
            editorBody.session.setValue(item.body || '');
            state.shown = true;
            updateInfo();
        }

        // Navigation used by both the modal and the header Prev/Next.
        // First press (before anything has been written) shows the current item
        // so we never overwrite the editors just from loading stored messages.
        function navNext() {
            if (!state.filtered.length) { return; }
            if (!state.shown) { render(); return; }
            if (state.index < state.filtered.length - 1) { state.index++; render(); }
        }
        function navPrev() {
            if (!state.filtered.length) { return; }
            if (!state.shown) { render(); return; }
            if (state.index > 0) { state.index--; render(); }
        }

        // Load the last stored fetch so the user sees messages immediately (no IMAP call).
        function loadStored(force) {
            if (state.loadedStored && !force) { return $.Deferred().resolve().promise(); }
            state.loadedStored = true;
            return $.getJSON(lastUrl).done(function (res) {
                if (!res.data || !res.data.length) return;
                state.items = res.data;
                buildVerdicts();
                applyFilter(); // populates state + counters, does NOT write the editors
                $('#fe_nav').removeClass('d-none');
                status('Showing ' + res.data.length + ' stored message(s)'
                    + (res.at ? ' — fetched ' + res.at : '') + '. Click Fetch to refresh.', 'text-muted');
            });
        }

        function reportErrors(res) {
            return (res.report || [])
                .filter(function (r) { return !r.ok; })
                .map(function (r) { return r.account + ': ' + (r.message || 'failed'); });
        }

        // ── events ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        $('#fetchEmailModal').on('show.bs.modal', function () {
            loadAccounts(false);
            loadStored(false).always(function () {
                if (state.filtered.length) { render(); } // show current message on open
            });
        });
        $('#fe_refresh').on('click', function () { loadAccounts(true); });

        $('#fe_fetch').on('click', function () {
            var accounts = $('#fe_account').val() || [];
            if (!accounts.length) { status('Select at least one account.', 'text-danger'); return; }
            var btn = $(this), html = btn.html();

            $.ajax({
                url: fetchUrl, type: 'POST', dataType: 'json',
                headers: { 'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrf },
                data: { accounts: accounts, limit: $('#fe_limit').val() },
                beforeSend: function () {
                    btn.attr('disabled', true).html('<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-1"></i> Fetching...');
                    status('Connecting and fetching from ' + accounts.length + ' account(s)…');
                    $('#fe_nav').addClass('d-none');
                }
            }).done(function (res) {
                state.items = res.data || [];
                var errs = reportErrors(res);
                var errHtml = errs.length ? ' <span class="text-danger">— ' + errs.join('; ') + '</span>' : '';

                if (!state.items.length) {
                    status('No emails found (fetched ' + (res.fetched || 0) + ').' + errHtml,
                           errs.length ? 'text-danger' : 'text-muted');
                    return;
                }
                buildVerdicts();
                applyFilter();
                render(); // a fresh fetch is explicit — load the first result
                $('#fe_nav').removeClass('d-none');
                var savedTxt = (res.stored === false)
                    ? ' <span class="text-danger">— too large to save, available until you reload</span>'
                    : ' — saved.';
                var sk = res.skipped || {}, skParts = [];
                if (sk.no_dkim)   { skParts.push(sk.no_dkim + ' no DKIM'); }
                if (sk.duplicate) { skParts.push(sk.duplicate + ' duplicate'); }
                if (sk.ignored)   { skParts.push(sk.ignored + ' ignored'); }
                var skTxt = skParts.length ? ' <span class="text-muted">(skipped: ' + skParts.join(', ') + ')</span>' : '';
                status('Fetched ' + res.fetched + ', ' + state.items.length + ' unique' + savedTxt + skTxt + errHtml,
                       errs.length || res.stored === false ? 'text-muted' : 'text-success');
            }).fail(function (xhr) {
                status(xhr.responseJSON?.data || xhr.responseJSON?.message || 'Fetch failed.', 'text-danger');
            }).always(function () {
                btn.attr('disabled', false).html(html);
            });
        });

        $('#fe_clear').on('click', function () {
            swal.fire({
                title: 'Clear stored messages?',
                text: 'This deletes all fetched templates saved for your account.',
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonColor: '#dc3545',
                confirmButtonText: 'Yes, clear'
            }).then(function (r) {
                if (!r.isConfirmed) return;
                $.ajax({
                    url: clearUrl, type: 'DELETE', dataType: 'json',
                    headers: { 'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrf }
                }).done(function (res) {
                    state.items = []; state.filtered = []; state.index = 0; state.shown = false;
                    $('#fe_nav').addClass('d-none');
                    updateInfo();
                    status(res.data || 'Stored messages cleared.', 'text-success');
                }).fail(function () {
                    status('Failed to clear stored messages.', 'text-danger');
                });
            });
        });

        $('#fe_next').on('click', navNext);
        $('#fe_prev').on('click', navPrev);
        // Header Prev/Next (outside the modal) — same navigation, easy switching.
        $('#fetch_next').on('click', navNext);
        $('#fetch_prev').on('click', navPrev);
        $('#fe_verdict').on('change', function () { applyFilter(); render(); });

        // Preload stored messages on page load so the header Prev/Next work
        // immediately, without ever opening the modal (editors stay untouched
        // until the first navigation).
        loadStored(false);

        function domainOf(from) {
            var i = (from || '').lastIndexOf('@');
            return i >= 0 ? from.slice(i + 1).replace(/[>\s]+$/, '').toLowerCase() : '';
        }
        function matchesDomain(d, ig) {
            return d === ig || (d && d.endsWith('.' + ig));
        }

        $('#fe_ignore').on('click', function () {
            if (!state.filtered.length) return;
            var from = state.filtered[state.index].from || '';
            var dom = domainOf(from);
            if (!dom) { status('This message has no sender domain to ignore.', 'text-danger'); return; }

            swal.fire({
                title: 'Ignore this sender?',
                html: 'All emails from <strong>' + dom + '</strong> (and its subdomains) will be removed and never fetched again.',
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonColor: '#dc3545',
                confirmButtonText: 'Yes, ignore'
            }).then(function (r) {
                if (!r.isConfirmed) return;
                $.ajax({
                    url: ignoreUrl, type: 'POST', dataType: 'json',
                    headers: { 'X-CSRF-TOKEN': csrf },
                    data: { domain: dom }
                }).done(function (res) {
                    var d = res.domain || dom;
                    // Drop matching messages locally, then re-render.
                    state.items = state.items.filter(function (e) { return !matchesDomain(domainOf(e.from), d); });
                    buildVerdicts();
                    applyFilter();
                    if (!state.items.length) { state.shown = false; $('#fe_nav').addClass('d-none'); }
                    else if (state.shown) { render(); } // move editors to the next available message
                    status('Ignored ' + d + ' — removed ' + (res.removed || 0) + ' message(s). Added to Ignore Senders.', 'text-success');
                }).fail(function (xhr) {
                    status(xhr.responseJSON?.data || 'Failed to ignore sender.', 'text-danger');
                });
            });
        });
    };
}());
</script>
                        <script>
/**
 * Emails per IP for a send, in one place.
 *
 * The create, edit and campaigns-list screens each used to compute this on
 * their own - with ceil, floor and round respectively - so the same campaign
 * showed a different Fraction IP depending on which screen you were looking
 * at, and floor left the tail of the list unallocated: 148674 over 4 IPs gave
 * 37168, and 4 x 37168 is 148672, two recipients short.
 *
 * It rounds up: every recipient has to belong to an IP, and the last IP simply
 * takes a slightly smaller share.
 */
window.fractionIp = function (total, ips) {
    const count = parseInt(total, 10);
    const perIp = parseInt(ips, 10);

    if (!Number.isFinite(count) || !Number.isFinite(perIp) || count <= 0 || perIp <= 0) {
        return 1;
    }

    return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(count / perIp));
};
</script>
