                    <div class="form-group col-8 mb-2">
                        <label class="small text-muted mb-0">Style</label>
                        <select class="form-control form-control-sm" id="nb-style">${option(RSS_BUILDER.styles, '')}</select>
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group col-4 mb-2">
                        <label class="small text-muted mb-0">Colour</label>
                        <input type="color" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="nb-color">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <label class="small text-muted mb-1">Add a block: click it, or drag it into place</label>
                <div id="nb-palette" class="mb-2">${Object.entries(B).map(([type, block]) =>
                    `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-alt-secondary nb-add mr-1 mb-1" draggable="true" data-type="${type}"><i class="fas ${block.icon} mr-1"></i>${block.label}</button>`).join('')}</div>
                <label class="small text-muted mb-1">The newsletter, top to bottom: drag a block to move it, click it for its settings</label>
                <div id="nb-blocks" class="border rounded p-2 mb-2 bg-body-light" style="max-height: 400px; min-height: 80px; overflow-y: auto"></div>
                <div id="nb-count" class="small"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-lg-7">
                <label class="small text-muted mb-1">Preview, with real articles <a href="#" id="nb-refresh" class="ml-2"><i class="fas fa-sync-alt"></i> other articles</a></label>
                <iframe id="nb-preview" sandbox="" style="width:100%;height:640px;border:1px solid #e9ecef;border-radius:4px;background:#fff"></iframe>
            </div>
        </div>`,
        buttons: {
            cancel: {label: 'Cancel', className: 'btn-secondary'},
            use: {
                label: '<i class="fas fa-check mr-1"></i> Use this newsletter',
                className: 'btn-primary nb-use',
                callback: () => {
                    const apply = () => {
                        const lead = blocks().some(b => b.type === 'article'), first = numberOf(sectionCategories()[0]);
                        $('#rss_selected').selectpicker('val', feedsOf()).trigger('change');
                        editorBody.session.setValue(html());
                        swal.mixin({toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 6000})
                            .fire({icon: 'success', title: 'Newsletter written and its feeds selected. For the subject: "Subject: '
                                + (lead || !first ? '[rss_cat]: [rss_title]' : `[rss_cat${first}]: [rss_title1_${first}]`) + '".'});
                    };
                    if (!editorBody.session.getValue().trim()) { apply(); return true; }
                    swal.fire({icon: 'question', title: 'Replace the body?', text: 'The body will be replaced by this newsletter.', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Replace'})
                        .then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) { apply(); dialog.modal('hide'); } });
                    return false;
                },
            },
        },
    });
    const list = dialog.find('#nb-blocks');
    const toast = (icon, title) => swal.mixin({toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 3500}).fire({icon, title});
    const failed = (xhr) => toast('error', xhr.responseJSON?.data || xhr.responseJSON?.message || 'Could not reach the server');

    let timer = null, shown = 0;
    function preview() {
        const mine = ++shown;
        $.ajax({url: RSS_BUILDER.urls.sample, type: 'post', dataType: 'json', global: false, data: {body: html(), rss_selected: feedsOf()}})
            .done((res) => { if (mine === shown) dialog.find('#nb-preview').attr('srcdoc', res.data); });
    }

    const head = (b) => `<i class="fas fa-grip-vertical text-muted mr-2"></i><i class="fas ${B[b.type].icon} text-primary mr-2" style="width: 1rem"></i>
        <span class="flex-grow-1 text-truncate"><b>${B[b.type].label}</b> <small class="text-muted ml-1 nb-summary">${nbSafe(summary(b))}</small></span>`;
    function draw() {
        list.html(blocks().map((b) => `
            <div class="nb-block border rounded bg-white mb-1 ${state.open === b.uid ? 'nb-open' : ''}" data-uid="${b.uid}">
                <div class="nb-head d-flex align-items-center px-2 py-1" draggable="true" title="Drag to move, click for the settings">
                    ${head(b)}
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link text-muted px-1 nb-dup" title="Duplicate"><i class="far fa-clone"></i></button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link text-danger px-1 nb-del" title="Take out"><i class="fas fa-times"></i></button>
                </div>
                ${state.open === b.uid ? `<div class="form-row border-top px-2 pt-2 mx-0">${form(b)}</div>` : ''}
            </div>`).join('') || '<div class="text-center text-muted small py-3">Empty: click a block above, or drag one here.</div>');
        changed(false);
    }
    // the newsletter changed: count, keep, show
    function changed(edited = true) {
        if (edited) state.dirty = true;
        const tags = rssBuilderTags(html());
        // a warmup keeps the first of its contents for the lead, used or not
        const used = tags.length + (tags.includes('[rss_content1]') ? 0 : 1);
        const problems = [];
        if (!blocks().length) problems.push('add a block');
        if (sectionCategories().length > 9) problems.push('9 categories at most');
        if (RSS_BUILDER.slots && used > RSS_BUILDER.slots) problems.push(`${used} articles, a warmup email carries ${RSS_BUILDER.slots}: take some out`);
        const notes = [];
        if (blocks().some(b => b.type === 'section' && !byId[b.category])) notes.push('a section without a category is left out');
        if (blocks().some(b => b.type === 'image' && !String(b.src || '').trim())) notes.push('a picture without an address is left out');
        if (!blocks().some(b => b.type === 'footer' && /unsubscribe/i.test(b.text || ''))) notes.push('no unsubscribe link in a footer');
        dialog.find('#nb-count')
            .toggleClass('text-danger', problems.length > 0).toggleClass('text-muted', !problems.length)
            .text(problems.length ? problems.join('; ') : `${tags.length} article${tags.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} per email`
                + (RSS_BUILDER.slots ? ` - ${used} of the ${RSS_BUILDER.slots} a warmup email can carry` : '')
                + (notes.length ? ' · ' + notes.join('; ') : ''));
        dialog.find('.nb-use').prop('disabled', problems.length > 0);
        dialog.find('#nb-status').text(state.current
            ? `Working on "${state.current.name}"` + (state.dirty ? ', changed since it was saved' : '')
            : state.read ? 'Read from the body as it is now, with the changes made to it by hand'
                + (state.read.loose ? '. Changes outside the blocks (the page\'s colours, its title) are not kept: use the Style and Colour here' : '')
            : 'Not saved under a name yet: it is kept in this browser only');
        dialog.find('#nb-remove').prop('disabled', !state.current);
        try { localStorage.setItem(RSS_BUILDER.key, JSON.stringify({template: bare(), current: state.current, name: dialog.find('#nb-tname').val()})); } catch (e) {}
        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(preview, 350);
    }
    function drawLoad() {
        dialog.find('#nb-load').html('<option value="">Load a newsletter...</option>'
            + (templates.length ? `<optgroup label="Saved">${templates.map(t => `<option value="s:${t.id}">${nbSafe(t.name)}</option>`).join('')}</optgroup>` : '')
            + `<optgroup label="Start from">${presets.map(p => `<option value="p:${p.key}">${nbSafe(p.name)}</option>`).join('')}</optgroup>`);
    }
    function load(template, current) {
        state.template = adopt(template);
        state.current = current;
        state.open = null;
        state.dirty = false;
        state.read = null;
        dialog.find('#nb-tname').val(current ? current.name : '');
        dialog.find('#nb-style').val(state.template.style);
        dialog.find('#nb-color').val(state.template.color);
        draw();
    }
    // a block of a kind, ready to go in: a section takes the first category no section has yet
    function fresh(type) {
        const block = {type, ...B[type].make(), uid: String(++uid)};
        if (type === 'section') {
            const taken = sectionCategories();
            block.category = (categories.find(c => !taken.includes(c.id)) || categories[0]).id;
        }
        return block;
    }

    dialog.find('#nb-tname').val(state.current ? state.current.name : state.name).on('input', () => changed(false));
    dialog.find('#nb-style').val(state.template.style).on('change', function () { state.template.style = this.value; changed(); });
    dialog.find('#nb-color').val(state.template.color).on('input', function () { state.template.color = this.value; changed(); });
    dialog.find('#nb-refresh').on('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); preview(); });

    // saved newsletters: load, save, copy, remove
    dialog.find('#nb-load').on('change', function () {
        const [kind, key] = this.value.split(':');
        this.value = '';
        const found = kind === 's' ? templates.find(t => String(t.id) === key) : presets.find(p => p.key === key);
        if (!found) return;
        const go = () => load(found.template, kind === 's' ? {id: found.id, name: found.name} : null);
        if (!state.dirty) return go();
        swal.fire({icon: 'question', title: 'Load it?', text: 'The changes made here since the last save will be lost.', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Load'})
            .then((result) => result.isConfirmed && go());
    });
    function store(name, onto) {
        const done = (res) => {
            templates = templates.filter(t => t.id !== res.template.id).concat([res.template]).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
            state.current = {id: res.template.id, name: res.template.name};
            state.dirty = false;
            dialog.find('#nb-tname').val(res.template.name);
            drawLoad();
            changed(false);
            toast('success', res.data);
        };
        return $.ajax({
            url: onto ? RSS_BUILDER.urls.item.replace('__ID__', onto) : RSS_BUILDER.urls.list,
            type: onto ? 'put' : 'post', dataType: 'json', global: false,
            // as one text: sent field by field, an emptied setting would come back as "not set"
            data: {name, template: JSON.stringify(bare())},
        }).done(done).fail(failed);
    }
    function save(copy) {
        let name = dialog.find('#nb-tname').val().trim();
        if (!name) {
            dialog.find('#nb-tname').focus();
            return toast('info', 'Give the newsletter a name first');
        }
        if (!blocks().length) return toast('info', 'There is nothing to save yet');
        const mine = !copy && state.current ? state.current.id : null;
        if (copy && templates.some(t => t.name === name)) {
            // a copy needs a name of its own
            const base = name.replace(/ copy( \d+)?$/, '');
            for (let n = 1; templates.some(t => t.name === name); n++) name = `${base} copy${n > 1 ? ' ' + n : ''}`;
        }
        const other = templates.find(t => t.name === name && t.id !== mine);
        if (!other) return store(name, mine);
        swal.fire({icon: 'question', title: `Replace "${name}"?`, text: 'A saved newsletter has that name already.', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Replace'})
            .then((result) => result.isConfirmed && store(name, null));
    }
    dialog.find('#nb-save').on('click', () => save(false));
    dialog.find('#nb-copy').on('click', () => save(true));
    dialog.find('#nb-remove').on('click', () => {
        if (!state.current) return;
        const {id, name} = state.current;
        swal.fire({icon: 'warning', title: `Remove "${name}"?`, text: 'The saved newsletter is removed. What is on screen stays.', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Remove'})
            .then((result) => {
                if (!result.isConfirmed) return;
                $.ajax({url: RSS_BUILDER.urls.item.replace('__ID__', id), type: 'delete', dataType: 'json', global: false}).done((res) => {
                    templates = templates.filter(t => t.id !== id);
                    state.current = null;
                    drawLoad();
                    changed(false);
                    toast('success', res.data);
                }).fail(failed);
            });
    });

    // the blocks: settings, duplicate, take out
    const blockOf = (el) => blocks().find(b => b.uid === String($(el).closest('.nb-block').data('uid')));
    dialog.on('click', '.nb-add', function () {
        const block = fresh($(this).data('type'));
        blocks().push(block);
        state.open = block.uid;
        draw();
        changed();
        list.scrollTop(list[0].scrollHeight);
    }).on('click', '.nb-head', function (e) {
        if ($(e.target).closest('button').length) return;
        const b = blockOf(this);
        state.open = state.open === b.uid ? null : b.uid;
        draw();
    }).on('click', '.nb-dup', function () {
        const b = blockOf(this), copy = {...b, uid: String(++uid)};
        blocks().splice(blocks().indexOf(b) + 1, 0, copy);
        draw();
        changed();
    }).on('click', '.nb-del', function () {
        blocks().splice(blocks().indexOf(blockOf(this)), 1);
        draw();
        changed();
    }).on('input change', '[data-field]', function () {
        const b = blockOf(this), name = $(this).data('field');
        if (!b) return;
        // a number within the limits its box has; one that may be left empty stays empty
        const least = parseInt(this.min, 10) || 1, most = parseInt(this.max, 10) || 10;
        b[name] = this.type !== 'number' ? this.value
            : this.value === '' && $(this).data('optional') ? ''
            : Math.min(most, Math.max(least, parseInt(this.value, 10) || least));
        $(this).closest('.nb-block').find('.nb-summary').text(summary(b));
        changed();
    });

    // drag and drop: a block of the list to another place, or a new one from the palette
    let drag = null, at = null;
    const placeOf = (y) => {
        const cards = list.children('.nb-block').toArray();
        const i = cards.findIndex((card) => { const r = card.getBoundingClientRect(); return y < r.top + r.height / 2; });
        return i < 0 ? cards.length : i;
    };
    const drop = (place) => {
        let block;
        if (drag.uid) {
            const from = blocks().findIndex(b => b.uid === drag.uid);
            if (from < 0) return;
            [block] = blocks().splice(from, 1);
            if (from < place) place--;
        } else {
            block = fresh(drag.type);
            state.open = block.uid;
        }
        blocks().splice(place, 0, block);
    };
    dialog.on('dragstart', '.nb-head, .nb-add', function (e) {
        const card = $(this).closest('.nb-block');
        drag = card.length ? {uid: String(card.data('uid'))} : {type: $(this).data('type')};
        at = null;
        card.addClass('nb-dragging');
        const transfer = e.originalEvent.dataTransfer;
        if (transfer) {
            transfer.effectAllowed = 'copyMove';
            transfer.setData('text/plain', drag.uid || drag.type);     // Firefox drags nothing without data
        }
    }).on('dragend', function () {
        drag = null;
        list.find('.nb-marker').remove();
        list.find('.nb-dragging').removeClass('nb-dragging');
    });
    list.on('dragover', function (e) {
        if (!drag) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const place = placeOf(e.originalEvent.clientY);
        if (place === at) return;
        at = place;
        list.find('.nb-marker').remove();
        const cards = list.children('.nb-block');
        const marker = $('<div class="nb-marker"></div>');
        place < cards.length ? marker.insertBefore(cards.eq(place)) : marker.appendTo(list);
    }).on('drop', function (e) {
        if (!drag) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        drop(at ?? placeOf(e.originalEvent.clientY));
        drag = null;
        draw();
        changed();
    });

    drawLoad();
    draw();
    $.ajax({url: RSS_BUILDER.urls.list, dataType: 'json', global: false}).done((res) => {
        templates = res.data || [];
        // the one worked on last time may be gone, or renamed, since
        const mine = state.current && templates.find(t => t.id === state.current.id);
        state.current = mine ? {id: mine.id, name: mine.name} : null;
        drawLoad();
        changed(false);
    });
});
        const rssSummary = () => {
            const count = ($('#rss_selected').val() || []).length;
            $('#rss_summary').text(count ? `${count} feed${count === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected` : 'not used');
        };
        $('#rss_selected').on('changed.bs.select change', rssSummary);
        rssSummary();

        $("#preview").on("click", function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            const body = editorBody.session.getValue();
            if (body) {
                // the RSS tags, if any, are filled from a real article of the selected feeds
                rssPreview(body).then((html) => {
                    bootbox.dialog({
                        scrollable: true,
                        closeButton: true,
                        size: "lg",
                        message: $("<iframe />").attr({
                            srcdoc: html,
                            width: "100%",
                            height: "700px",
                            scrolling: "auto",
                            frameborder: "0"
                        }),
                        onEscape: true,
                        centerVertical: true
                    })
                });
            }
        });

        $("#body_map").on('change', async function () {
            const getMeta = (image) => {
                return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    if(!image) {
                        resolve([0,0]);
                    }
                    const link = "/o" + "/" + image;
                    $("<img/>").attr('src', link)
                        .on('load', function () {
                            resolve([this.width, this.height]);
                        });
                });
            };

            const creative = $("#creative option:selected").text();
            if (!creative) {
                $(this).prop('checked', false);
                alert("Please select creative");
                return;
            }
            const domain = $("#domain").val() || '[domain]';

            let body = bodyZero
                .replace(/\[domain\]/gi, domain)
                .replace('[imgr]', creative || 'NA')
                .replace('[imgu]', unsubscribe?.value || 'NA');

            if (this.checked) {
                body = bodyMapZero
                    .replace(/\[domain\]/gi, domain)
                    .replace('[imgr]', creative || 'NA')
                    .replace('[imgu]', unsubscribe?.value || 'NA');

                const [wr, hr] = await getMeta(creative);
                body = body.replace('[imgr_width]', wr).replace('[imgr_height]', hr);
                const [wu, hu] = await getMeta(unsubscribe?.value);
                body = body.replace('[imgu_width]', wu).replace('[imgu_height]', hu);
            }
            editorBody.session.setValue(body);
        });

        window.ptrMode = () => Number($('#option option:selected').data('ptr')) === 1;

// Resolves when the PTR VMTAs of the servers are in place (at once when the
// option is not PTR); rejects when the user says no, after going back to IP.
window.ptrReady = function (servers, type) {
    const ready = $.Deferred();
    if (!ptrMode()) {
        return ready.resolve().promise();
    }

    const esc = (text) => $('<div>').text(text == null ? '' : text).html();
    const list = (items) => esc(items.slice(0, 6).join(', ')) + (items.length > 6 ? ` and ${items.length - 6} more` : '');
    const back = () => {
        $('#option').val('ip').selectpicker('refresh').trigger('change');
        ready.reject();
    };
    const ask = (apply) => $.ajax({
        url: "https:\/\/a-p.io\/mailer\/pmta\/ptr-vmta",
        type: 'post',
        dataType: 'json',
        global: false,
        data: {server_ids: servers, type: type, apply: apply ? 1 : 0},
    });
    const failed = (xhr) => {
        swal.fire({icon: 'error', title: 'PTR option', text: xhr.responseJSON?.message || xhr.responseJSON?.data || 'Could not prepare the PTR VMTAs'});
        back();
    };
    // what could not be used, or is worth knowing, once the VMTAs are there
    const notes = (res) => [
        res.errors.length ? `<p class="text-danger mb-1"><b>Not created</b> on ${res.errors.length} server(s): ${esc(res.errors.join(' | '))}</p>` : '',
        res.no_ptr.length ? `<p class="mb-1"><b>${res.no_ptr.length} IP(s) have no PTR</b> and are left out: ${list(res.no_ptr)}</p>` : '',
        res.unconfirmed.length ? `<p class="mb-1"><b>${res.unconfirmed.length} IP(s)</b> have a PTR that does not point back at them (receivers may distrust it): ${list(res.unconfirmed)}</p>` : '',
    ].join('');
    const waiting = (title) => swal.fire({title, allowOutsideClick: false, showConfirmButton: false, didOpen: () => swal.showLoading()});

    waiting('Looking up the PTR of the IPs...');
    ask(false).done((plan) => {
        if (!plan.to_create) {
            const extra = notes(plan);
            if (extra) {
                swal.fire({icon: 'info', title: 'PTR as VMTA', html: `<p class="mb-1">${plan.kept} IP(s) ready.</p>${extra}`});
            } else {
                swal.close();
            }
            ready.resolve();
            return;
        }
        swal.fire({
            icon: 'info',
            title: 'Set the PTR as VMTA?',
            html: `<p>For <b>${plan.to_create} IP(s)</b> on <b>${plan.servers} server(s)</b>, a VMTA is created on the server
                   with the IP's PTR (its reverse DNS name) as host name, and PMTA is reloaded.</p>
                   <p class="mb-1">The send then goes through these VMTAs: PMTA greets with the PTR, and
                   <b>[vmta_domain]</b> is the PTR, like <b>[rdns]</b>. <b>[domain]</b> stays the IP's own domain.</p>
                   ${plan.kept ? `<p class="mb-1 text-muted">${plan.kept} IP(s) already have theirs.</p>` : ''}${notes(plan)}`,
            showCancelButton: true,
            confirmButtonText: 'Set PTR as VMTA',
            cancelButtonText: 'Cancel',
        }).then((result) => {
            if (!result.isConfirmed) {
                back();
                return;
            }
            waiting('Creating the VMTAs on the servers...');
            ask(true).done((res) => {
                const extra = notes(res);
                swal.fire({
                    icon: res.errors.length ? 'warning' : 'success',
                    title: `${res.created} PTR VMTA(s) created`,
                    html: extra || undefined,
                    timer: extra ? undefined : 1800,
                    showConfirmButton: !!extra,
                });
                ready.resolve();
            }).fail(failed);
        });
    }).fail(failed);

    return ready.promise();
};

    }).done(function (res) {

        $("#searchServers").on("click", async function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const {value: text} = await swal.fire({
                input: 'textarea',
                inputLabel: 'Search Servers',
                inputPlaceholder: 'Type your servers here...',
                inputAttributes: {
                    'aria-label': 'Type your servers here'
                },
                showCancelButton: true
            })

            if (text) {
                const servers = [...new Set(text.split("\n").filter((i) => i))];
                const result = [];
                $.each(servers, function (i, v) {
                    $("#servers").find("option").each(function (index) {
                        const data = $(this).text().split("|");
                        const server = data[0].trim().toLowerCase();
                        const ip = data[1].trim();
                        if (server === v.toLowerCase() || ip.includes(v)) {
                            result.push($(this).val());
                        }
                    });
                });
                $("#servers").selectpicker('val', result);
                $("#servers").selectpicker('refresh');
                $("#servers").trigger('change');
            }
        });

       $("#servers").on('change', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const servers = $(this).val();
    const option = $('#option').val();
    const type = $('#type').val();
    if (servers.length && option && type) {
        ptrReady(servers, type).then(() => $.ajax({
            url: "https://a-p.io/mailer/ips/get",
            type: 'get',
            dataType: "json",
            data: {
                option: option,
                server_ids: servers,
                type: type,
                ptr: ptrMode() ? 1 : 0,
            }
        }).done(function (res) {
            ips.empty();
            $.each(res, (i, v) => {
                const domain_id = (option === 'vmta' || option === 'smtp') ? 0 : v.domain_id;
                const ipId = (option === 'vmta' || option === 'smtp') ? v.ip_id : v.id;
                const username = option === 'smtp' ? `,${v.username}` : (option === 'vmta' ? ',' : '');
                const dns = (option === 'vmta' || option === 'smtp') ? (v.ip_dns || v.dns) : v.dns;
                const vmtaDns = (option === 'vmta' || option === 'smtp') ? `,${v.dns}` : '';
                const val = `${v.ip},${dns},${ipId},${domain_id},${v.server_id},${v.id}${username}${vmtaDns}`;
                const text = `${v.ip},${v.dns}${username}`;
                const listed = v?.history?.ip_listed_spamhaus || v?.history?.ip_listed_spamcop || v?.history?.ip_listed_barracuda || v?.history?.domain_listed_hostkarma || v?.history?.domain_listed_spamhaus_dbl || v?.history?.domain_listed_surbl;

                // Always select the option to move it to the Selected Ips side
                $('<option/>', {
                    style: listed ? 'color:red' : '',
                    value: val,
                    text: text,
                    selected: true  // This ensures the option is moved to Selected Ips
                }).appendTo(ips)
            });
            ips.bootstrapDualListbox('refresh', true);
        }));
    } else {
        ips.empty();
        ips.bootstrapDualListbox('refresh', true);
    }
});

// Copy IPs from NON-SELECTED (left side) list
$(".content").on("click", "#preCopyIps", async function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    // Get the non-selected listbox
    const nonSelectedListbox = $("#bootstrap-duallistbox-nonselected-list_");

    // Check if any items are selected in the non-selected listbox
    const selectedOptions = nonSelectedListbox.find('option:selected');

    let ipsToCopy;

    if (selectedOptions.length > 0) {
        // If items are selected, copy only selected items
        ipsToCopy = selectedOptions.map(function () {
return this.value.split(',')[0]; // Extract IP from "ip,domain,..." format
        }).get();
    } else {
        // If no items are selected, copy all items
        ipsToCopy = nonSelectedListbox.find('option').map(function () {
return this.value.split(',')[0]; // Extract IP from "ip,domain,..." format
        }).get();
    }

    if (ipsToCopy.length > 0) {
        copyToClipboard(ipsToCopy.join("\n"));

        // Use toast notification instead of alert
        Toast.fire({
icon: 'success',
title: `Copied ${ipsToCopy.length} IPs from available list`
        });
    } else {
        Toast.fire({
icon: 'warning',
title: 'No IPs to copy'
        });
    }
});

$('#fetchBoxes').click(function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var $btn = $(this);
    var originalHtml = $btn.html();

    $.ajax({
        url: 'https://a-p.io/mailer/warmups/boxes/fetch-all',
        type: 'GET',
        dataType: 'json',
        data: {
            'load': 1
        },
        beforeSend: function() {
            $btn.attr('disabled', true).html(spinner());
        }
    })
        .done(function(response) {
            swal.fire({
                icon: 'success',
                title: response.data
            }).then(function() {
                //replace the boxes list with the new data
                if(response.sources) {
                    const boxesSelect = $('#boxes_selected');
                    boxesSelect.empty();
                    $.each(response.sources, function(i, v) {
                        const option = $("<option></option>", {
                            "value": v.id,
                            "text": v.subject
                        });
                        boxesSelect.append(option);
                    });
                    boxesSelect.selectpicker('refresh');
                }
            });
        })
        .always(function() {
            $btn.attr('disabled', false).html(originalHtml);
        });
});

            const html = btn.html();

                icon: 'question',
                title: 'Clone campaign #3792?',
                html: 'The same offer, ISP and mixed list, with the suppression run again. The clone is made from the campaign as it is <b>saved</b>: changes on this page that are not saved yet are not in it.',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-clone mr-1"></i> Clone',
            }).then((choice) => {
                if (!choice.isConfirmed) {
                    return;
                }
                $.ajax({
                    url: "https:\/\/a-p.io\/mailer\/campaigns\/3792\/duplicate",
                    type: 'post',
                    dataType: 'json',
                    global: false,
                    beforeSend: () => {
                        btn.prop('disabled', true).html('<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>');

                    },
                }).done((res) => {
                    swal.fire({
                        icon: res.warning ? 'warning' : 'success',

                               <p class="mb-1">Blacklisted: <b>${Number(res.bl).toLocaleString()}</b></p>
                               <p class="mb-1">Elapsed time: <b>${$('<span>').text(res.time).html()}</b></p>`
                            + (res.from_file ? '<p class="mb-1 text-muted">Its mixed list has expired: the emails were taken from the campaign\'s data file.</p>' : '')
                            + (res.warning ? `<p class="mb-0 text-danger">${$('<span>').text(res.warning).html()}</p>` : ''),
                        showCancelButton: true,
                        confirmButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-external-link-alt mr-1"></i> Open the clone',
                        cancelButtonText: 'Stay here',
                    }).then((result) => {
                        if (result.isConfirmed) {
                            window.location.href = "https://a-p.io/mailer/campaigns/:id".replace(':id', res.id);
                        }
                    });
                }).fail((xhr) => {
                    swal.fire({icon: 'error', title: 'Not cloned', text: xhr.responseJSON?.data || xhr.responseJSON?.message || 'Could not clone the campaign'});
                }).always(() => btn.prop('disabled', false).html(html));
            });
        });

// Regular Test Function — defined unconditionally so the NORMAL TEST
// button onclick="regularTest()" works even when Vade module is disabled.
window.regularTest = function() {
    var ips = $("#ips").val() || [];
    if (ips.length <= 1) {
        test_campaign('single');
        return;
    }
    swal.fire({
        title: 'Multiple IPs/VMTAs selected',
        text: ips.length + ' selected. How do you want to test?',
        icon: 'question',
        showCancelButton: true,
        showDenyButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-paper-plane mr-1"></i> Normal Test (1)',
        denyButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-layer-group mr-1"></i> Batch Test (all)',
        cancelButtonText: 'Cancel',
        reverseButtons: false,
        buttonsStyling: false,
        customClass: {
            confirmButton: 'btn btn-primary btn-lg m-1',
            denyButton:    'btn btn-info btn-lg m-1',
            cancelButton:  'btn btn-secondary btn-lg m-1'
        }
    }).then(function (result) {
        if (result.isConfirmed)      test_campaign('single');
        else if (result.isDenied)    test_campaign('batch');
    });
};

// ===== FIXED VADE TEST WITH PROPER INTERVAL MANAGEMENT AND QUEUE RESUME =====

// Store the last result for navigation and active interval
let lastVadeResult = null;
let lastTotalFound = 1;
let activeCheckInterval = null; // Track the active interval

// Vade Test Function - properly exposed to window
window.vadeTest = function () {
    console.log('vadeTest function called'); // Debug log

    const from = $("#from").val();
    const subjects = $("#subject").val();
    const return_path = $("#return_path").val();
    const header = editorHeader.session.getValue();
    const negative = $("#negative").val();
    const body = editorBody.session.getValue();
    const option = $("#option").val();
    const type = $("#type").val();
    const servers = $("#servers").val();
    const ips = $("#ips").val();
    const content_type = $("#content_type").val();
    const charset = $("#charset").val();
    const transfer = $("#transfer").val();

    const placeholder_combination = $("#placeholder_combination").is(':checked') ? 1 : 0;
    const placeholder_all_combination = $("#placeholder_all_combination").is(':checked') ? 1 : 0;
    editorPlaceHolders.removeEmptyRows();
    const placeholders = editorPlaceHolders.getAllValue().map(p => {
        return {
            data: p.data.split("\n").map(i => i.trim()).filter((i) => i),
            rotate_every: p.rotate_every
        }
    }).filter((p) => p.data.length > 0 && p.rotate_every > 0);
    const send_type = $("#send_type").val();

    const boxes_selected = $("#boxes_selected").val();
    const boxes_rotate_every = $("#boxes_rotate_every").val();

    // Validation checks
    if (!ips || ips.length === 0) {
        swal.fire({
            icon: 'error',
            title: 'Missing IPs',
            text: 'Please select at least one IP for Vade testing'
        });
        return;
    }

    if (!header.trim()) {
        swal.fire({
            icon: 'error',
            title: 'Missing Header',
            text: 'Please enter email header for Vade testing'
        });
        return;
    }

    // Send helper — runs the actual AJAX with whatever IP set the user picked.
    // Single source of truth for the request body so Normal Test and Batch Test
    // can both call into it without duplicating the payload.
    const sendVadeTest = (ipsToSend) => {
        if (activeCheckInterval) {
            clearInterval(activeCheckInterval);
            activeCheckInterval = null;
            console.log('Cleared previous interval');
        }

        swal.fire({
            title: 'Sending Vade Test...',
            text: 'Preparing test email for Vade analysis',
            allowOutsideClick: false,
            showConfirmButton: false,
            didOpen: () => { swal.showLoading(); }
        });

        $.ajax({
            url: 'https://a-p.io/mailer/campaigns/vade-test',
            type: 'POST',
            dataType: "json",
            data: {
                from,
                subjects,
                return_path,
                ...campaignHeaderTabs.collectPayload(true),
                negative,
                content_type,
                charset,
                transfer,
                body: b64encode(body),
                servers,
                option,
                type,
                ips: ipsToSend,
                placeholder_combination,
                placeholder_all_combination,
                placeholders,
                send_type,
                boxes_selected,
                        rss_selected: $('#rss_selected').val(),
                        rss_form: 1,
                boxes_rotate_every
            }
        }).done(function (res) {
            if (res.success) {
                resumeVadeQueue(servers, function() {
                    const firstIp = ipsToSend[0].split(',')[0]; // "ip,domain,..." → ip
                    checkVadeResults(firstIp, 'IP');
                });
            } else {
                swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Test Failed', text: res.error || 'Unknown error occurred' });
            }
        }).fail(function(xhr) {
            swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Error', text: xhr.responseJSON?.error || 'Failed to send test email' });
        });
    };

    // One IP — just send. Multiple — same 3-button picker that Normal Test uses.
    if (ips.length === 1) {
        sendVadeTest(ips);
        return;
    }

    swal.fire({
        title: 'Multiple IPs/VMTAs selected',
        text: ips.length + ' selected. How do you want to test?',
        icon: 'question',
        showCancelButton: true,
        showDenyButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-paper-plane mr-1"></i> Normal Test (1)',
        denyButtonText:    '<i class="fas fa-layer-group mr-1"></i> Batch Test (all)',
        cancelButtonText:  'Cancel',
        reverseButtons: false,
        buttonsStyling: false,
        customClass: {
            confirmButton: 'btn btn-primary btn-lg m-1',
            denyButton:    'btn btn-info btn-lg m-1',
            cancelButton:  'btn btn-secondary btn-lg m-1'
        }
    }).then(function (result) {
        if (result.isConfirmed) {
            // Normal Test: pick one IP at random so the test isn't biased to the
            // first selection on every click.
            const randomIp = ips[Math.floor(Math.random() * ips.length)];
            sendVadeTest([randomIp]);
        } else if (result.isDenied) {
            sendVadeTest(ips);
        }
        // Cancel: do nothing.
    });
};

// Function to resume PMTA queue forvade.email
function resumeVadeQueue(servers, callback) {
    console.log('Resuming vade.email queue for servers:', servers);

    swal.update({
        title: 'Resuming Queue...',
        text: 'Preparing vade.email queue for delivery'
    });

    $.ajax({
        url: '/mailer/campaigns/resume-vade-queue',
        type: 'POST',
        dataType: "json",
        data: {
            servers: servers,
            _token: $('meta[name="csrf-token"]').attr('content')
        }
    }).done(function(res) {
        console.log('Queue resume response:', res);
        // Continue to callback regardless of response
        // Some servers might not need queue resume
        if (callback) callback();
    }).fail(function(xhr) {
        console.warn('Queue resume failed, continuing anyway:', xhr);
        // Continue even if queue resume fails
        if (callback) callback();
    });
}

// Function to stop any active checking
function stopVadeChecking() {
    if (activeCheckInterval) {
        clearInterval(activeCheckInterval);
        activeCheckInterval = null;
        console.log('Stopped Vade checking interval');
    }
}

// Function to check Vade results with proper cleanup
window.VadeCheck = window.VadeCheck || {
    waits: 0,
    // looks at PowerMTA before giving up on it: 5 minutes, at one every 5 seconds
    MAX_WAITS: 60,
    begin() { this.waits = 0; },
    esc(s) { return String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({'&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'})[c]); },
    row(label, value) {
        return value ? `<div style="margin-bottom: 6px;"><strong>${label}:</strong> <code style="background: #e9ecef; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-word;">${this.esc(value)}</code></div>` : '';
    },
    // 'stop': the check is over, and said; 'wait': not out of PowerMTA yet - this look does
    // not count; null: nothing to say, the page goes on as it does
    handle(res, ctx) {
        if (!res) return null;
        if (res.bounced) {
            const b = res.bounce || {};
            ctx.stop();
            swal.fire({
                icon: 'error', title: 'Refused by the mail server', width: '750px', confirmButtonText: 'Close',
                html: `<div style="text-align: left; padding: 10px 20px;">
                        <p style="margin-bottom: 12px;">PowerMTA sent the test and the mail server refused it: there is nothing in the mailbox to analyse.</p>
                        <div style="background: #f8d7da; color: #721c24; padding: 12px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 15px; border-left: 3px solid #dc3545; margin-bottom: 14px; word-break: break-word;">${this.esc(b.diag || res.message)}</div>
                        <div style="background: #f8f9fa; padding: 12px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 14px;">
                            ${this.row('Status', b.status)}${this.row('Bounce category', b.category)}${this.row('From', b.vmta)}${this.row('IP', ctx.searchQuery)}${this.row('At', b.at)}
                        </div>
                    </div>`,
            });
            return 'stop';
        }
        if (res.queued) {
            if (++this.waits > this.MAX_WAITS) {
                ctx.stop();
                swal.fire({
                    icon: 'warning', title: 'Still in PowerMTA', width: '750px', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Keep waiting', cancelButtonText: 'Close',
                    html: `<div style="text-align: left; padding: 10px 20px;"><p>After ${Math.round(this.MAX_WAITS * 5 / 60)} minutes the test has neither been delivered nor refused.</p>
                        <div style="background: #fff3cd; padding: 12px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 14px; border-left: 3px solid #ffc107;">${this.esc(res.message)}</div></div>`,
                }).then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) ctx.recheck(); });
                return 'stop';
            }
            swal.update({title: 'Test sent. Waiting for PowerMTA...', text: `${res.message} (${this.waits * 5}s)`});
            return 'wait';
        }
        if (res.delivered && !res.success) {
            if (res.delivered.gave_up) {
                ctx.stop();
                swal.fire({
                    icon: 'warning', title: 'Delivered, but not in the mailbox', width: '750px', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Look again', cancelButtonText: 'Close',
                    html: `<div style="text-align: left; padding: 10px 20px;"><p>${this.esc(res.message)}</p>
                        <p class="text-muted" style="font-size: 13px;">The mail service took it and then dropped it, or holds it back.</p></div>`,
                }).then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) ctx.recheck(); });
                return 'stop';
            }
            swal.update({title: 'Delivered. Looking in the mailbox...', text: `PowerMTA handed it over at ${res.delivered.at}: ${res.delivered.diag}`});
            // (it is on its way: the page's own count of tries is not spent on it yet)
            return 'wait';
        }
        return null;
    },
};

const checkVadeResults = function(searchQuery, searchType = 'IP', isRecheck = false) {
    let attempts = 0;
    VadeCheck.begin();
    const maxAttempts = 12; // asked every 5 seconds, for a minute: a test is looked for among what arrived since it was sent

    // Show loading immediately
    swal.fire({
        title: isRecheck ? 'Rechecking Results...' : 'Test Sent! Checking Results...',
        text: `Searching by ${searchType}: ${searchQuery}`,
        width: '750px',
        allowOutsideClick: false,
        showConfirmButton: false,
        didOpen: () => {
            swal.showLoading();
        }
    });

    // Store the interval so we can clear it later
    activeCheckInterval = setInterval(() => {
        attempts++;

        $.ajax({
            url: 'https://a-p.io/mailer/campaigns/check-vade-results',
            type: 'POST',
            dataType: "json",
            data: {
                search_query: searchQuery,
                search_type: searchType,
                email_count: '1' // Check last 1 emails for better chance of finding it
            }
        }).done(function(res) {
            // what PowerMTA did with the test comes first: refused by the mail server (that is
            // the result), or not out of PowerMTA yet (this look does not count)
            const pmta = VadeCheck.handle(res, {searchQuery, stop: stopVadeChecking, recheck: () => checkVadeResults(searchQuery, searchType, true)});
            if (pmta === 'stop') return;
            if (pmta === 'wait') { attempts--; return; }
            if (res.success && res.result) {
                // IMPORTANT: Stop checking immediately when results are found
                stopVadeChecking();

                // Store results for navigation
                lastVadeResult = res.result;
                lastTotalFound = res.total_found || 1;
                showVadeResults(res.result, res.total_found);
            } else if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
                // Stop checking when max attempts reached
                stopVadeChecking();

                const diag = res && res.ip_diagnostics ? res.ip_diagnostics : null;
                const scanned = res && res.scanned ? res.scanned : 0;
                const diagHtml = diag && diag.ips_seen && diag.ips_seen.length ? `
                    <hr style="margin: 20px 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #ddd;">
                    <p style="margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>Diagnostics:</strong></p>
                    <div style="background: #fff3cd; padding: 12px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 13px; border-left: 3px solid #ffc107;">
                        <div style="margin-bottom: 8px;">Scanned <strong>${scanned}</strong> recent email${scanned === 1 ? '' : 's'} in: <code>${diag.folders.join(', ')}</code></div>
                        <div style="margin-bottom: 6px;">The IP <code>${searchQuery}</code> was not present in any of their headers.</div>
                        <div>IPs we did see: <code style="word-break: break-all;">${diag.ips_seen.join(', ')}</code></div>
                    </div>
                ` : (scanned ? `
                    <hr style="margin: 20px 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #ddd;">
                    <div style="background: #fff3cd; padding: 12px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 13px; border-left: 3px solid #ffc107;">
                        Scanned <strong>${scanned}</strong> recent email${scanned === 1 ? '' : 's'} — no IPs were extractable from their headers.
                    </div>
                ` : '');

                swal.fire({
                    icon: 'warning',
                    title: 'Vade Results Not Found',
                    width: '750px',
                    html: `
                        <div style="text-align: left; padding: 20px;">
                            <p style="margin-bottom: 15px;">Vade results not found after checking.</p>
                            <p style="margin-bottom: 15px;">The email may still be processing or there might be a delivery issue.</p>
                            <hr style="margin: 20px 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #ddd;">
                            <p style="margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong>Search Details:</strong></p>
                            <div style="background: #f8f9fa; padding: 12px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 14px;">
                                <div style="margin-bottom: 8px;">
                                    <strong>Type:</strong> <code style="background: #e9ecef; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px;">${searchType}</code>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <strong>Query:</strong> <code style="background: #e9ecef; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px;">${searchQuery}</code>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            ${diagHtml}
                        </div>
                    `,
                    showCancelButton: true,
                    showConfirmButton: true,
                    confirmButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-redo"></i> Recheck Now',
                    confirmButtonColor: '#007bff',
                    cancelButtonText: 'Close',
                    footer: '<a href="https://a-p.io/mailer/tools/vade" target="_blank" style="color: #007bff;"><i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i> Check Vade Tool manually</a>',
                    width: '750px'
                }).then((result) => {
                    if (result.isConfirmed) {
                        // User clicked recheck button - immediately show loading
                        checkVadeResults(searchQuery, searchType, true);
                    }
                });
            } else {
                // Update progress
                swal.update({
                    text: `Searching by ${searchType}: ${searchQuery} (Attempt ${attempts})`
                });
            }
        }).fail(function(xhr) {
            console.error('Vade check failed:', xhr);
            if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
                stopVadeChecking();
                swal.fire({
                    icon: 'error',
                    title: 'Error Checking Results',
                    text: 'Failed to check Vade results due to connection error',
                    showCancelButton: true,
                    showConfirmButton: true,
                    confirmButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-redo"></i> Retry',
                    confirmButtonColor: '#007bff',
                    cancelButtonText: 'Close',
                    footer: '<a href="https://a-p.io/mailer/tools/vade" target="_blank" style="color: #007bff;"><i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i> Check Vade Tool manually</a>'
                }).then((result) => {
                    if (result.isConfirmed) {
                        // User clicked retry button - immediately show loading
                        checkVadeResults(searchQuery, searchType, true);
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }, 5000); // every 5 seconds (the answer takes about one)

    console.log('Started Vade checking interval:', activeCheckInterval);
};

// (Old formatAuthStatus removed — see VadeModal.formatAuthStatus in _partials/vade_modal.)

    return VadeModal.show(result, {
        totalFound: totalFound,
        onClose: () => { stopVadeChecking(); },
    });
};
