    <script>
// Backoff alerts (layouts.skeleton.backoff_alerts): polls the user's own
// backoffs, counts the unread ones on the bell and in the tab title, and for a
// backoff that is new since the last check shows a pop-up and plays a sound.
// What was already announced is kept per browser, so moving between pages does
// not announce it again. Opening the bell marks everything as read.
(function () {
    const bell = document.getElementById('backoffAlerts');
    if (!bell) return;

    const URLS = {
        index: "https://a-p.io/mailer/backoff-alerts",
        seen: "https://a-p.io/mailer/backoff-alerts/seen",
        campaign: "https://a-p.io/mailer/campaigns/:id",
        warmup: "https://a-p.io/mailer/warmups/:id",
    };
    // a backoff is a campaign's or a warmup's: what to call it, and its page
    const what = (item) => item.warmup_id ? 'warmup' : 'campaign';
    const link = (item) => item.warmup_id ? URLS.warmup.replace(':id', item.warmup_id) : URLS.campaign.replace(':id', item.campaign_id);
    const EVERY = 30000;                                   // ms between checks
    const FRESH = 120000;                                  // first check in a browser: only this recent pops up
    const LAST = 'backoff_alert_last:1';  // highest backoff id already announced
    const MUTED = 'backoff_alert_muted';
    const count = document.getElementById('backoffAlertsCount');
    const list = document.getElementById('backoffAlertsList');
    const popups = document.getElementById('backoffPopups');
    const sound = document.getElementById('backoffAlertsSound');
    const title = document.title;
    let stopped = false, audio = null;

    const store = {
        get: (key) => { try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch (e) { return null; } },
        set: (key, value) => { try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (e) {} },
    };

    function ago(iso) {
        const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()) / 60000));
        if (minutes < 1) return 'just now';
        if (minutes < 60) return minutes + ' min ago';
        if (minutes < 1440) return Math.round(minutes / 60) + ' h ago';
        return Math.round(minutes / 1440) + ' d ago';
    }

    // "13:12" for today, "28 Sep 20:29" for another day
    function clock(iso) {
        const date = new Date(iso);
        const time = date.toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false});
        return date.toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()
            ? time
            : date.toLocaleDateString([], {day: 'numeric', month: 'short'}) + ' ' + time;
    }

    // "45 s", "38 min", "2 h 05 min", "1 d 3 h"
    function duration(fromIso, toIso) {
        const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.round((new Date(toIso) - new Date(fromIso)) / 1000));
        if (seconds < 60) return seconds + ' s';
        if (seconds < 3600) return Math.floor(seconds / 60) + ' min';
        if (seconds < 86400) return Math.floor(seconds / 3600) + ' h ' + String(Math.floor(seconds % 3600 / 60)).padStart(2, '0') + ' min';
        return Math.floor(seconds / 86400) + ' d ' + Math.floor(seconds % 86400 / 3600) + ' h';
    }

    // the campaign's send around the backoff: its start, how long it ran before
    // the backoff, and how it ended
    function times(item) {
        const end = item.killed
            ? 'stopped ' + clock(item.ended_at || item.at)
            : (item.ended_at ? 'ended ' + clock(item.ended_at) : (item.running ? 'still running' : ''));
        if (!item.started_at) return end ? what(item) + ' ' + end : '';
        return ['started ' + clock(item.started_at), 'backoff after ' + duration(item.started_at, item.at), end].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    }

    // an element with text set as text, never as HTML: the verdict is what an ISP sent
    function el(tag, className, text) {
        const node = document.createElement(tag);
        if (className) node.className = className;
        if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text;
        return node;
    }

    function describe(item, into) {
        into.appendChild(el('div', 'backoff-title', item.warmup_id ? 'Backoff · Warmup #' + item.warmup_id : 'Backoff · Campaign #' + item.campaign_id));
        into.appendChild(el('div', 'backoff-error', item.error || 'backoff'));
        into.appendChild(el('div', 'backoff-meta', [
            item.server,
            item.vmta,
            item.recipients + ' recipient' + (item.recipients === 1 ? '' : 's'),
            ago(item.at),
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')));
        const sendTimes = times(item);
        if (sendTimes) into.appendChild(el('div', 'backoff-times', sendTimes));
    }

    function render(data) {
        count.textContent = data.unread > 99 ? '99+' : data.unread;
        count.classList.toggle('d-none', !data.unread);
        document.title = (data.unread ? '(' + data.unread + ') ' : '') + title;

        list.innerHTML = '';
        if (!data.items.length) {
            list.appendChild(el('div', 'backoff-empty', 'No backoff in the last 7 days'));
            return;
        }
        data.items.forEach((item) => {
            const row = el('a', 'backoff-item' + (item.unread ? ' is-unread' : ''));
            row.href = link(item);
            describe(item, row);
            list.appendChild(row);
        });
    }

    function popup(item) {
        const card = el('div', 'backoff-popup');
        const close = el('button', 'backoff-close', '×');
        close.type = 'button';
        close.title = 'Close';
        close.addEventListener('click', () => card.remove());
        card.appendChild(close);
        describe(item, card);
        const open = el('a', 'small font-weight-bold', 'Open ' + what(item));
        open.href = link(item);
        card.appendChild(open);
        popups.insertBefore(card, popups.firstChild);
        while (popups.children.length > 4) popups.lastChild.remove();
    }

    // two short tones; browsers only allow sound once the page has been clicked or typed in
    function beep() {
        if (store.get(MUTED) === '1') return;
        try {
            const Ctx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            audio = audio || new Ctx();
            if (audio.state === 'suspended') audio.resume();
            [[0, 880], [0.22, 660]].forEach(([offset, frequency]) => {
                const tone = audio.createOscillator(), gain = audio.createGain();
                const at = audio.currentTime + offset;
                tone.frequency.value = frequency;
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, at);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.25, at + 0.02);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, at + 0.2);
                tone.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audio.destination);
                tone.start(at);
                tone.stop(at + 0.22);
            });
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function announce(data) {
        if (!data.latest_id) return;
        const stored = store.get(LAST);
        const last = stored === null ? null : parseInt(stored, 10) || 0;
        const fresh = data.items.filter((item) => last === null
            ? Date.now() - new Date(item.at).getTime() < FRESH
            : item.id > last);
        if (last === null || data.latest_id > last) store.set(LAST, String(data.latest_id));
        if (!fresh.length) return;
        fresh.slice().reverse().forEach(popup);   // newest ends on top
        beep();
    }

    function check() {
        if (stopped) return;
        fetch(URLS.index, {credentials: 'same-origin', headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'}})
            .then((response) => {
                // signed out (or the session expired): nothing more to ask for
                if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 419) stopped = true;
                return response.ok ? response.json() : null;
            })
            .then((data) => {
                if (!data) return;
                render(data);
                announce(data);
            })
            .catch(() => {});
    }

    function showSound() {
        const muted = store.get(MUTED) === '1';
        sound.firstElementChild.className = 'fas ' + (muted ? 'fa-volume-mute' : 'fa-volume-up');
        sound.title = muted ? 'Sound is off: click to turn it on' : 'Sound on a new backoff: click to turn it off';
    }

    sound.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();   // keep the list open
        store.set(MUTED, store.get(MUTED) === '1' ? '0' : '1');
        showSound();
        beep();                // a sample, when turned on
    });

    // opening the bell reads everything; the rows keep their mark until the next check
    $(bell).on('show.bs.dropdown', () => {
        if (count.classList.contains('d-none')) return;
        $.ajax({url: URLS.seen, type: 'POST', dataType: 'json', global: false}).done(() => {
            count.classList.add('d-none');
            document.title = title;
        });
    });

    showSound();
    check();
    setInterval(check, EVERY);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (!document.hidden) check(); });
})();
</script>

$("#shuffle").on('click', function (e) {
    // random
    Array.prototype.shuffle = function () {
        let x = this.length;
        if (x === 0) return false;
        let y = 0;
        let temp_x = "";
        let temp_y = "";
        while (--x) {
            y = Math.floor(Math.random() * (x + 1));
            temp_x = this[x];
            temp_y = this[y];
            this[x] = temp_y;
            this[y] = temp_x;
        }
        return this;
    };

    let header = editorHeader.session.getValue();
    header = header.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
    // Group folded headers: a line starting with space/tab is a
    // continuation of the header above it, so keep them together.
    let groups = [];
    header.split("\n").forEach(function (line) {
        if (/^[ \t]/.test(line) && groups.length) {
            groups[groups.length - 1] += "\n" + line;
        } else {
            groups.push(line);
        }
    });
    header = groups.shuffle().join("\n");
    editorHeader.session.setValue(header);
});

// Function to update placeholder count in the header
function updatePlaceholderCount() {
    const placeholderRows = editorPlaceHolders.getAllValue();

    // Count non-empty placeholders (those with data and rotate_every > 0)
    const activeCount = placeholderRows.filter(p => {
        const hasData = p.data && p.data.trim().length > 0;
        const hasRotateEvery = p.rotate_every && parseInt(p.rotate_every) > 0;
        return hasData && hasRotateEvery;
    }).length;

    // Update the block title
    const blockTitle = document.querySelector('#block_placeholder .block-title');
    if (blockTitle) {
        if (activeCount > 0) {
            blockTitle.innerHTML = `PLACEHOLDERS <span style="color: red;"><b>(${activeCount} Active)</b></span>`;
        } else {
            blockTitle.textContent = 'PLACEHOLDERS';
        }
    }
}
// Hook into AppendGrid events to update count when user types or changes values
$(document).on('input change keyup paste', '#placeholders input, #placeholders textarea', function() {
    // Delay the count update to allow the grid to process the change
    setTimeout(updatePlaceholderCount, 200);
});

// Hook into button clicks (add/remove rows) with more specific targeting
$(document).on('click', '#placeholders .btn-group button, #placeholders tfoot button', function() {
    // Longer delay for add/remove operations
    setTimeout(updatePlaceholderCount, 300);
});

// Also listen for any changes in the entire placeholders table
$(document).on('DOMNodeInserted DOMNodeRemoved', '#placeholders', function() {
    setTimeout(updatePlaceholderCount, 300);
});

// Listen for AppendGrid specific events if available
$(document).on('appendGrid.afterRowAppended appendGrid.afterRowRemoved', '#placeholders', function() {
    setTimeout(updatePlaceholderCount, 200);
});

// Initial count update after everything is loaded
setTimeout(updatePlaceholderCount, 500);

    let header = editorHeader.session.getValue();
    const selected = $(this).find("option:selected");
    const values = selected.map(function () {
        return $(this).text();
    }).get();
    let replace = "From: [from] <";
    if (values.length === 1) {
        const from = values[0];
        replace = "From: " + from + " <";
    }
    header = header.replace(/from.*:.*</gi, replace);
    editorHeader.session.setValue(header)
});

$("#subject").on('change', function (e) {

    editorHeader.session.setValue(header)
});

const rssStory = (tag, first = false) => `<tr>
<td style="padding:${first ? '28px' : '24px'} 28px ${first ? '28px' : '24px'} 28px;${first ? '' : 'border-top:1px solid #e8eaed;'}">

</td>

// a category of the selected feeds: its name, and its first two articles

</tr>
${rssStory(`[rss_content1_${c}]`, true).replace('padding:28px 28px 28px 28px;', 'padding:12px 28px 24px 28px;')}

const RSS_TEMPLATES = {

    digest: {name: 'Digest: 4 articles', body: rssLayout([rssStory('[rss_content]', true), rssStory('[rss_content2]'), rssStory('[rss_content3]'), rssStory('[rss_content4]')].join('\n'))},

$('#rss_template').on('change', function () {
    const template = RSS_TEMPLATES[this.value];
    this.value = '';
    if (!template) return;
    const apply = () => {
        editorBody.session.setValue(template.body);
        swal.mixin({toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 4000})
            .fire({icon: 'success', title: 'Template inserted. Use "Subject: [rss_title]" in the header, and select the RSS feeds.'});
    };
    if (!editorBody.session.getValue().trim()) return apply();
    swal.fire({
        icon: 'question',
        title: 'Replace the body?',
        text: `The body will be replaced by the "${template.name}" template.`,
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Replace',
    }).then((result) => result.isConfirmed && apply());

// The body with its RSS tags filled for one email, from real articles of the
// selected feeds, as the send does. Other tags are left as they are.
function rssPreview(body) {
    if (!/\[rss_(title|cat|content|side|link)[\d_]*\]/.test(body)) {
        return $.Deferred().resolve(body).promise();
    }
    return $.ajax({
        url: "https:\/\/a-p.io\/mailer\/warmups\/rss\/sample",
        type: 'post',
        dataType: 'json',
        data: {body: body, rss_selected: $('#rss_selected').val() || []},
        global: false,
    }).then((res) => res.data, () => body);
}
        const rssFeedsOf = (category) => $('#rss_selected').find(`option[data-category="${category}"]`).toArray().map(o => o.value);
let rssCategoriesTicked = [];

$('#rss_category').on('changed.bs.select', function () {
    const now = $(this).val() || [];
    const added = now.filter(c => !rssCategoriesTicked.includes(c));
    const removed = rssCategoriesTicked.filter(c => !now.includes(c));
    rssCategoriesTicked = now;
    if (!added.length && !removed.length) return;

    // only the feeds of what changed: the ones picked by hand elsewhere stay
    const drop = new Set(removed.flatMap(rssFeedsOf));
    const feeds = new Set(($('#rss_selected').val() || []).filter(id => !drop.has(id)));
    added.flatMap(rssFeedsOf).forEach(id => feeds.add(id));
    $('#rss_selected').selectpicker('val', [...feeds]).trigger('change');
});

// The numbers the category tags go by ([rss_cat2], [rss_content1_2]): the
// categories of the selected feeds, in alphabetical order, as RssTagAction counts them
function rssCategoryNumbers() {
    const selected = $('#rss_selected option:selected').toArray();
    const names = [...new Set(selected.map(o => $(o).data('category-name')).filter(Boolean))]
        .sort((a, b) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, {numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base'}));
    $('#rss_categories_hint').text(names.length
        ? 'Categories of the selected feeds: ' + names.map((name, i) => `${i + 1} = ${name}`).join(' · ')
            + '. In the tags: [rss_cat1] is the name of the 1st, [rss_content2_1] its 2nd article.'
        : '');

    // a category is ticked when all its feeds are in
    const chosen = new Set(selected.map(o => o.value));
    rssCategoriesTicked = $('#rss_category option').toArray().map(o => o.value)
        .filter(c => rssFeedsOf(c).length && rssFeedsOf(c).every(id => chosen.has(id)));
    $('#rss_category').selectpicker('val', rssCategoriesTicked);
}
$('#rss_selected').on('changed.bs.select change', rssCategoryNumbers);
rssCategoryNumbers();

// A body written for more categories than the selected feeds have (a
// newsletter of three sections, feeds of two categories): said here, in red,
// before it is sent. The send still fills such a section, with articles of
// any category under the title "Top Stories" (RssTagAction::fill()).
$('#rss_categories_hint').after('<small id="rss_categories_warning" class="form-text text-danger font-w600"></small>');
function rssCategoryCheck() {
    if (typeof editorBody === 'undefined') return;
    const asked = Math.max(0, ...[...editorBody.session.getValue().matchAll(/\[rss_(?:cat|(?:content|side|link|title)\d+_)([1-9])\]/g)].map(m => +m[1]));
    const selected = $('#rss_selected option:selected').toArray();
    const have = new Set(selected.map(o => $(o).data('category-name')).filter(Boolean)).size;
    $('#rss_categories_warning').text(asked > have && selected.length
        ? `The body has sections for ${asked} categories, the selected feeds have ${have}: `
            + `the section${asked - have === 1 ? '' : 's'} past the ${have === 1 ? '1st' : have === 2 ? '2nd' : have === 3 ? '3rd' : have + 'th'} will show articles of any category, under "Top Stories". `
            + 'Select feeds of the missing categories, or build the newsletter again.'
        : '');
}
$('#rss_selected').on('changed.bs.select change', rssCategoryCheck);
if (typeof editorBody !== 'undefined') editorBody.session.on('change', rssCategoryCheck);
rssCategoryCheck();
        const RSS_BUILDER = {
    slots: null,
    key: 'rss_newsletter:1',
    urls: {
        list: "https:\/\/a-p.io\/mailer\/warmups\/rss\/newsletters",
        item: "https:\/\/a-p.io\/mailer\/warmups\/rss\/newsletters\/__ID__",
        sample: "https:\/\/a-p.io\/mailer\/warmups\/rss\/sample",
    },
    styles: [
        ['classic', 'Classic: white page, title band'],
        ['cards', 'Cards: each article in its own card'],
        ['bold', 'Bold: coloured title band'],
        ['minimal', 'Minimal: no band, thin lines'],
    ],
    // how an article is laid out, and the tag that gives it (RssTagAction)
    layouts: [
        ['full', 'Big picture: headline, picture, summary'],
        ['side', 'Picture left: small picture, headline, teaser'],
        ['links', 'Headlines only: the linked headline'],
    ],
    words: {full: 'content', side: 'side', links: 'link'},
    aligns: [['left', 'Left'], ['center', 'Centre'], ['right', 'Right']],
    // the blocks of a newsletter: what the list calls them, and a new one's settings
    blocks: {
        header: {label: 'Header', icon: 'fa-heading', make: () => ({text: 'The Daily Brief', logo: '', logo_width: '', logo_height: '', align: 'left'})},
        article: {label: 'Featured article', icon: 'fa-star', make: () => ({layout: 'full'})},
        section: {label: 'Category section', icon: 'fa-layer-group', make: () => ({category: '', count: 2, layout: 'full', heading: 'Latest'})},
        text: {label: 'Text', icon: 'fa-align-left', make: () => ({text: 'Good morning. Here is what matters today.', size: '15', align: 'left'})},
        button: {label: 'Button', icon: 'fa-hand-pointer', make: () => ({label: 'Read more on our site', url: 'https://[domain]/', align: 'center'})},
        image: {label: 'Picture', icon: 'fa-image', make: () => ({src: '', url: '', alt: ''})},
        divider: {label: 'Divider', icon: 'fa-minus', make: () => ({kind: 'line'})},
        footer: {label: 'Footer', icon: 'fa-shoe-prints', make: () => ({text: nbFooter()})},
        // rows of the newsletter's table, written as they are
        html: {label: 'Custom HTML', icon: 'fa-code', make: () => ({html: '<tr>\n<td style="padding:16px 28px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:23px;color:#333333;">\nYour own HTML\n</td>\n</tr>'})},
    },
};

// a text for the builder's own page
const nbSafe = (text) => String(text ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
// a text for the email: plain ASCII as the articles are, anything else an entity
// ("=" too: see rss_templates)
const nbText = (text) => Array.from(String(text ?? '')).map((ch) => {
    const code = ch.codePointAt(0);
    if (code > 126) return `&#${code};`;
    if (code < 32) return ch === '\n' ? ch : '';
    return ({'&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', '=': '&#61;'})[ch] ?? ch;
}).join('');
const nbUrl = (url) => nbText(String(url ?? '').trim().replace(/[\s"<>]/g, ''));
// a written text for the email, none of its lines long (a line of an email may
// not pass 998 characters): its line breaks kept, "[words](address)" a link
const nbLines = (text, linkStyle = '') => String(text ?? '').trim().split('\n').map((line) => {
    // a space becomes a line break where the line has grown long; the others stay as written
    const wrap = (escaped) => {
        let length = 0;
        return escaped.split(' ').map((word, i) => {
            const fresh = i > 0 && length + word.length > 180;
            length = fresh || i === 0 ? word.length : length + word.length + 1;
            return (i === 0 ? '' : fresh ? '\n' : ' ') + word;
        }).join('');
    };
    let html = '', done = 0;
    for (const link of line.matchAll(/\[([^\[\]]+)\]\(((?:https?:\/\/|mailto:|\[)[^()\s]+)\)/g)) {
        html += wrap(nbText(line.slice(done, link.index))) + `<a href="${nbUrl(link[2])}"${linkStyle ? ` style="${linkStyle}"` : ''}>${nbText(link[1])}</a>`;
        done = link.index + link[0].length;
    }
    return html + wrap(nbText(line.slice(done)));
}).join('<br>\n');
// the same in paragraphs: an empty line starts a new one
const nbParagraphs = (text, linkStyle) => {
    const parts = String(text ?? '').trim().split(/\n\s*\n/).filter(part => part.trim());
    return parts.map((part, i) => `<p style="margin:0${i < parts.length - 1 ? ' 0 10px 0' : ''};">${nbLines(part, linkStyle)}</p>`).join('\n');
};
// the footer a newsletter starts with; the user rewrites it as they like
const nbFooter = (intro = 'We send the top stories of the day to our subscribed users.') => `This mail was sent to [to]
[date]

${intro}${intro ? ' ' : ''}Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [update your preferences](https://[domain]/unsubscribe?=edit) or [unsubscribe](https://[domain]/unsubscribe?=out).

Copyright \u00A9 ${new Date().getFullYear()} [domain]`;

// the categories that have feeds on this page: [{id, name, feeds}], by name
const rssBuilderCategories = () => {
    const seen = {};
    $('#rss_selected option').each(function () {
        const id = String($(this).data('category')), name = $(this).data('category-name');
        if (name) {
            seen[id] = seen[id] || {id, name: String(name), feeds: 0};
            seen[id].feeds++;
        }
    });
    return Object.values(seen).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, {numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base'}));
};

// the tags of a text that change with the email, as RssTagAction::varying() finds them
const rssBuilderTags = (text) => [...new Set(String(text).replace(/\[rss_content\]/g, '[rss_content1]')
    .match(/\[rss_(?:cat|(?:content|side|link)(?:[1-9]|10)(?:_[1-9])?|title(?:[1-9]|10)_[1-9])\]/g) || [])];

/**
 * The body of a newsletter.
 * t: {style, color, blocks: [{type, ...settings}]}
 * numberOf(category id): its number among the selected feeds' categories, 0 when it is not one of them.
 * spans: when given, filled with the number of rows each block wrote.
 */
function rssBuilderHtml(t, numberOf, spans) {
    const font = 'font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;';
    const cards = t.style === 'cards', minimal = t.style === 'minimal', bold = t.style === 'bold';
    const page = minimal ? '#ffffff' : '#f2f4f6';
    const line = '#e8eaed';
    const edge = cards ? '16px' : '28px';
    const color = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(t.color || '') ? t.color : '#1a73e8';
    const align = (b) => ['left', 'center', 'right'].includes(b.align) ? b.align : 'left';

    // one article: a row of the page, or a card of its own; after another article, a line between them
    const story = (tag, layout, joined) => {
        const pad = {full: ['22px', '20px'], side: ['18px', '16px'], links: ['9px', '12px 16px']}[layout] || ['22px', '20px'];
        return cards
            ? `<tr>\n<td style="padding:0 16px ${layout === 'links' ? '8px' : '14px'} 16px;">\n<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="background-color:#ffffff;border:1px solid ${line};border-radius:8px;">\n<tr>\n<td style="padding:${pad[1]};">\n${tag}\n</td>\n</tr>\n</table>\n</td>\n</tr>`
            : `<tr>\n<td style="padding:${pad[0]} 28px;${joined ? `border-top:1px solid ${line};` : ''}">\n${tag}\n</td>\n</tr>`;
    };
    const tagOf = (layout, n, c) => {
        const word = RSS_BUILDER.words[layout] || 'content';
        if (c) return `[rss_${word}${n}_${c}]`;
        return word === 'content' && n === 1 ? '[rss_content]' : `[rss_${word}${n}]`;
    };

    const rows = [];
    let any = 0, last = null, title = '';
    const per = {};
    const write = (b) => {
        let kind = b.type;
        if (b.type === 'header') {
            title = title || String(b.text || '');
            // the logo at the size asked for: one side given, the other follows; none, 36 high
            const px = (value, least, most) => { const n = parseInt(value, 10); return n ? Math.min(most, Math.max(least, n)) : 0; };
            const wide = px(b.logo_width, 20, 544), high = px(b.logo_height, 10, 300) || (wide ? 0 : 36);
            const inner = b.logo
                ? `<img src="${nbUrl(b.logo)}" alt="${nbText(b.text)}"${wide ? ` width="${wide}"` : ''}${high ? ` height="${high}"` : ''} style="display:${align(b) === 'left' ? 'block' : 'inline-block'};width:${wide ? wide + 'px' : 'auto'};height:${high ? high + 'px' : 'auto'};max-width:100%;border:0;">`
                : nbText(b.text);
            rows.push(minimal
                ? `<tr>\n<td align="${align(b)}" style="padding:8px 28px 14px 28px;border-bottom:2px solid ${color};${font}font-size:13px;line-height:18px;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:${color};text-align:${align(b)};">${inner}</td>\n</tr>`
                : `<tr>\n<td align="${align(b)}" style="padding:18px 28px;${bold ? `background-color:${color};border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;color:#ffffff;` : `border-bottom:1px solid ${line};color:#1a1a1a;`}${font}font-size:${bold ? '20px' : '18px'};line-height:26px;font-weight:bold;text-align:${align(b)};">${inner}</td>\n</tr>`);
        } else if (b.type === 'article') {
            if (any >= 10) return;
            any++;
            if (cards && last !== 'story') rows.push('<tr>\n<td style="height:14px;line-height:14px;font-size:14px;">&nbsp;</td>\n</tr>');
            rows.push(story(tagOf(b.layout, any), b.layout, last === 'story'));
            kind = 'story';
        } else if (b.type === 'section') {
            const c = numberOf(String(b.category));
            if (!c) return;
            rows.push(`<tr>\n<td style="padding:${cards ? '8px 16px 10px 16px' : '22px 28px 0 28px'};${font}font-size:13px;line-height:18px;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:${color};${bold && !cards ? `border-left:4px solid ${color};` : ''}">${nbText(b.heading)}${b.heading ? ' ' : ''}[rss_cat${c}]</td>\n</tr>`);
            // a category in two sections: the second goes on where the first stopped
            for (let n = 0; n < (parseInt(b.count, 10) || 1) && (per[c] || 0) < 10; n++) {
                per[c] = (per[c] || 0) + 1;
                rows.push(story(tagOf(b.layout, per[c], c), b.layout, n > 0));
            }
            kind = 'story';
        } else if (b.type === 'text') {
            if (!String(b.text || '').trim()) return;
            const size = [13, 15, 18, 22].includes(parseInt(b.size, 10)) ? parseInt(b.size, 10) : 15;
            rows.push(`<tr>\n<td style="padding:16px ${edge};${font}font-size:${size}px;line-height:${Math.round(size * 1.55)}px;color:#333333;text-align:${align(b)};${size >= 18 ? 'font-weight:bold;' : ''}">\n${nbLines(b.text, `color:${color};text-decoration:underline;`)}\n</td>\n</tr>`);
        } else if (b.type === 'button') {
            if (!String(b.label || '').trim()) return;
            rows.push(`<tr>\n<td align="${align(b)}" style="padding:16px ${edge};text-align:${align(b)};">\n<a href="${nbUrl(b.url)}" style="display:inline-block;padding:12px 26px;background-color:${color};border-radius:6px;${font}font-size:15px;line-height:20px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffffff;text-decoration:none;">${nbText(b.label)}</a>\n</td>\n</tr>`);
        } else if (b.type === 'image') {
            if (!nbUrl(b.src)) return;
            const picture = `<img src="${nbUrl(b.src)}" alt="${nbText(b.alt)}" width="544" style="display:block;width:100%;max-width:544px;height:auto;border:0;border-radius:6px;">`;
            rows.push(`<tr>\n<td style="padding:16px ${edge};">\n${nbUrl(b.url) ? `<a href="${nbUrl(b.url)}">${picture}</a>` : picture}\n</td>\n</tr>`);
        } else if (b.type === 'divider') {
            rows.push(b.kind === 'space'
                ? '<tr>\n<td style="height:24px;line-height:24px;font-size:24px;">&nbsp;</td>\n</tr>'
                : `<tr>\n<td style="padding:12px ${edge} 0 ${edge};">\n<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0">\n<tr>\n<td style="border-top:1px solid ${cards ? '#d5d9de' : line};height:12px;line-height:12px;font-size:12px;">&nbsp;</td>\n</tr>\n</table>\n</td>\n</tr>`);
        } else if (b.type === 'footer') {
            if (!String(b.text || '').trim()) return;
            rows.push(`<tr>\n<td style="padding:20px 28px;${cards || last === 'divider' ? '' : `border-top:1px solid ${line};`}${font}font-size:12px;line-height:18px;color:#8a8f98;">\n${nbParagraphs(b.text, 'color:#8a8f98;text-decoration:underline;')}\n</td>\n</tr>`);
        } else if (b.type === 'html') {
            if (!String(b.html || '').trim()) return;
            rows.push(String(b.html).trim());
        } else {
            return;
        }
        last = kind;
    };
    (t.blocks || []).forEach((b, i) => {
        const from = rows.length;
        write(b);
        if (spans) spans[i] = rows.length - from;
    });

    // [rss_title] is the title of the lead: without a featured article the email is named after its header
    return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width&#61;device-width, initial-scale&#61;1">
<title>${any ? '[rss_title]' : nbText(title || 'Newsletter')}</title>
</head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background-color:${page};">
<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="background-color:${page};">
<tr>
<td align="center" style="padding:24px 12px;">
<table role="presentation" width="600" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="width:100%;max-width:600px;background-color:${cards ? page : '#ffffff'};border-radius:8px;">
${rows.join('\n')}
</table>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</body>
</html>`;
}

// A part of a body written again as the builder writes it - plain ASCII, the
// tags of a table on lines of their own - so that two bodies that read the
// same compare the same, however they were typed.
const nbWritten = (node) => {
    if (node.nodeType === 3) return nbText(node.nodeValue.replace(/[\t\r]/g, ' '));
    if (node.nodeType !== 1) return '';
    const tag = node.tagName.toLowerCase();
    const inner = Array.from(node.childNodes).map(nbWritten).join('');
    if (tag === 'tbody') return inner;
    const attributes = Array.from(node.attributes).map(a => ` ${a.name}="${nbText(a.value)}"`).join('');
    if (['img', 'br', 'hr', 'meta', 'link', 'input'].includes(tag)) return `<${tag}${attributes}>${tag === 'br' ? '\n' : ''}`;
    const own = ['html', 'head', 'body', 'table', 'tr', 'td', 'th'].includes(tag) ? '\n' : '';
    return `${own}<${tag}${attributes}>${own}${inner}${own}</${tag}>${own}`;
};
const nbTidy = (html) => html.replace(/[ ]*\n\s*/g, '\n').trim();
const nbPage = (body) => new DOMParser().parseFromString(String(body), 'text/html');
// the rows of a newsletter: those of the table in the middle of the page
const nbRows = (page) => {
    const table = page.body.querySelector(':scope > table > tbody > tr > td > table');
    return table ? Array.from(table.querySelectorAll(':scope > tbody > tr')) : null;
};
// a text of the email as it was typed in a block: nbLines backwards
const nbUnlines = (el) => Array.from(el.childNodes).map((n) => n.nodeType === 3 ? n.nodeValue.replace(/\s*\n\s*/g, ' ')
    : n.nodeName === 'BR' ? '\u0001'
    : n.nodeName === 'A' ? `[${n.textContent}](${n.getAttribute('href') || ''})`
    : n.textContent).join('').replace(/ ?\u0001 ?/g, '\n').trim();

/**
 * A body read back into a newsletter: rssBuilderHtml backwards.
 * categoryOf(number): the category a tag's number stands for, among the selected feeds' categories.
 * numbering(blocks): the numberOf of those blocks.
 * Gives {template, loose}, or null when the body is not a newsletter of the
 * builder. Each block is checked by writing it again: one that would not come
 * out as it stands in the body is kept as a "Custom HTML" block instead, so
 * nothing typed by hand is lost. loose: something outside the blocks (the
 * page's colours, its title) was changed, and cannot be kept.
 */
function rssBuilderRead(body, categoryOf, numbering, fallbackColor) {
    // the categories' numbers as the builder will count them: 1, 2, 3 in the order they have
    const numbers = [...new Set([...String(body).matchAll(/\[rss_(?:cat|(?:content|side|link|title)\d+_)(\d)\]/g)].map(m => +m[1]))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const category = Object.fromEntries(numbers.map((n, i) => [i + 1, categoryOf(n)]));
    const page = nbPage(String(body).replace(/\[rss_(cat|(?:content|side|link|title)\d+_)(\d)\]/g, (all, word, n) => `[rss_${word}${numbers.indexOf(+n) + 1}]`));
    const trs = nbRows(page);
    if (!trs || !trs.length) return null;

    const styleOf = (el) => (el && el.getAttribute('style') || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
    const has = (el, part) => styleOf(el).includes(part);
    const hex = (el, property) => (styleOf(el).match(new RegExp(`(?:^|;)${property}:(#[0-9a-fA-F]{6})`)) || [])[1];
    const cells = trs.map(row => row.querySelector(':scope > td'));
    const table = trs[0].closest('table');
    const ground = hex(page.body, 'background-color') || '#f2f4f6';
    const minimal = ground.toLowerCase() === '#ffffff';
    const cards = !minimal && (hex(table, 'background-color') || '').toLowerCase() === ground.toLowerCase();
    const band = cells.find(td => has(td, 'border-radius:8px8px00'));
    const heading = cells.find(td => td && has(td, 'text-transform:uppercase'));
    const button = cells.map(td => td && td.querySelector(':scope > a')).find(a => a && has(a, 'display:inline-block'));
    const style = minimal ? 'minimal' : cards ? 'cards' : band ? 'bold' : 'classic';
    const color = (band && hex(band, 'background-color')) || (heading && hex(heading, 'color')) || (button && hex(button, 'background-color')) || fallbackColor || '#1a73e8';

    const words = {content: 'full', side: 'side', link: 'links'};
    const sideOf = (td) => ['left', 'center', 'right'].includes(td.getAttribute('align')) ? td.getAttribute('align')
        : (styleOf(td).match(/text-align:(left|center|right)/) || [])[1] || 'left';
    const blocks = [];
    let spacer = null;                                  // the gap a card style leaves before its first article
    trs.forEach((row, i) => {
        const td = cells[i], src = nbTidy(nbWritten(row));
        const push = (block) => { blocks.push({...block, rows: [...(spacer ? [spacer] : []), src]}); spacer = null; };
        const custom = () => push({type: 'html'});
        if (!td || row.children.length !== 1) return custom();
        const text = td.textContent.trim(), picture = td.querySelector('img'), link = td.querySelector(':scope > a');
        const story = text.match(/^\[rss_(content|side|link)(\d*)(?:_(\d))?\]$/);
        const title = text.match(/^(.*?)\s*\[rss_cat(\d)\]$/s);
        if (story && story[3]) {
            const section = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
            if (!section || section.type !== 'section' || section.number !== story[3] || spacer) return custom();
            section.layout = section.count ? section.layout : words[story[1]];
            section.count++;
            section.rows.push(src);
        } else if (story) {
            push({type: 'article', layout: words[story[1]]});
        } else if (title && has(td, 'text-transform:uppercase')) {
            push({type: 'section', heading: title[1], number: title[2], category: String(category[title[2]] ?? ''), count: 0, layout: 'full'});
        } else if (text === '' && td.textContent === ' ' && !td.children.length && has(td, 'height:14px') && !spacer) {
            spacer = src;
        } else if (text === '' && td.textContent === ' ' && !td.children.length) {
            push({type: 'divider', kind: 'space'});
        } else if (text === '' && td.querySelector(':scope > table') && !picture) {
            push({type: 'divider', kind: 'line'});
        } else if (has(td, 'font-weight:bold') && (has(td, 'line-height:26px') || has(td, 'border-bottom:2pxsolid')) && !/\[rss_/.test(text)) {
            push({type: 'header', text: picture ? picture.getAttribute('alt') || '' : text, logo: picture ? picture.getAttribute('src') || '' : '',
                logo_width: picture && picture.getAttribute('width') || '', logo_height: picture && picture.getAttribute('height') || '', align: sideOf(td)});
        } else if (has(td, 'color:#8a8f98') && has(td, 'font-size:12px')) {
            const parts = Array.from(td.children).filter(el => el.tagName === 'P');
            push({type: 'footer', text: parts.length ? parts.map(nbUnlines).join('\n\n') : nbUnlines(td)});
        } else if (link && has(link, 'display:inline-block') && td.children.length === 1) {
            push({type: 'button', label: link.textContent, url: link.getAttribute('href') || '', align: sideOf(td)});
        } else if (picture && td.children.length === 1) {
            push({type: 'image', src: picture.getAttribute('src') || '', url: link ? link.getAttribute('href') || '' : '', alt: picture.getAttribute('alt') || ''});
        } else if (has(td, 'color:#333333') && text) {
            push({type: 'text', text: nbUnlines(td), size: (styleOf(td).match(/font-size:(\d+)px/) || [])[1] || '15', align: sideOf(td)});
        } else {
            custom();
        }
    });
    if (spacer) blocks.push({type: 'html', rows: [spacer]});
    if (!blocks.some(b => b.type !== 'html')) return null;

    // each block written again: one that does not come out as it stands in the body stays as it stands
    const template = () => ({style, color, blocks: blocks.map(({rows, number, ...b}) => b.type === 'html' ? {...b, html: rows.join('\n')} : b)});
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 5; pass++) {
        const spans = [], now = template();
        const made = nbRows(nbPage(rssBuilderHtml(now, numbering(now.blocks), spans))).map(row => nbTidy(nbWritten(row)));
        let at = 0, turned = false;
        blocks.forEach((b, i) => {
            // a Custom HTML block is written in one piece, however many rows it holds
            const span = b.type === 'html' ? b.rows.length : spans[i];
            const mine = made.slice(at, at + span).join('\n');
            at += span;
            if (b.type !== 'html' && mine !== b.rows.join('\n')) {
                blocks[i] = {type: 'html', rows: b.rows};
                turned = true;
            }
        });
        if (!turned) break;
    }
    if (!blocks.some(b => b.type !== 'html')) return null;
    const result = template();
    return {template: result, loose: nbTidy(nbWritten(nbPage(rssBuilderHtml(result, numbering(result.blocks))).documentElement)) !== nbTidy(nbWritten(page.documentElement))};
}

// the newsletters to start from, on the categories the page has
function rssBuilderPresets(categories) {
    const make = (type, settings = {}) => ({type, ...RSS_BUILDER.blocks[type].make(), ...settings});
    const sections = (count, settings) => categories.slice(0, count).map(c => make('section', {category: c.id, ...settings}));
    return [
        {key: 'brief', name: 'Daily brief: a lead, then 2 categories', template: {style: 'classic', color: '#1a73e8', blocks: [
            make('header'), make('article'), ...sections(2, {count: 2}), make('footer'),
        ]}},
        {key: 'categories', name: 'By category: 3 categories, 2 articles each', template: {style: 'cards', color: '#1a73e8', blocks: [
            make('header'), ...sections(3, {count: 2}), make('footer'),
        ]}},
        {key: 'magazine', name: 'Magazine: a lead, then small pictures', template: {style: 'bold', color: '#c0392b', blocks: [
            make('header'), make('article'), ...sections(2, {count: 3, layout: 'side'}),
            make('button'), make('footer'),
        ]}},
        {key: 'headlines', name: 'Headlines: a lead, then lists of headlines', template: {style: 'minimal', color: '#1a1a1a', blocks: [
            make('header'), make('article'), ...sections(3, {count: 3, layout: 'links', heading: 'More in'}), make('footer'),
        ]}},
    ];
}

$('#rss_builder').on('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const categories = rssBuilderCategories();
    if (!categories.length) {
        swal.fire({icon: 'info', title: 'No category yet', text: 'File the RSS feeds under categories first (RSS page), then build a newsletter from them.'});
        return;
    }
    const byId = Object.fromEntries(categories.map(c => [c.id, c]));
    const presets = rssBuilderPresets(categories);
    const B = RSS_BUILDER.blocks;

    let uid = 0;
    // a newsletter as the builder works on it: known blocks only, each with a handle for the page
    const adopt = (template) => ({
        style: RSS_BUILDER.styles.some(s => s[0] === template?.style) ? template.style : 'classic',
        color: /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(template?.color || '') ? template.color : '#1a73e8',
        blocks: (Array.isArray(template?.blocks) ? template.blocks : []).filter(b => b && B[b.type])
            // a footer kept before the whole of it could be written: its first sentence, in the text it was part of
            .map(({intro, ...b}) => b.type === 'footer' && b.text === undefined && typeof intro === 'string' ? {...b, text: nbFooter(intro)} : b)
            .map(b => ({...B[b.type].make(), ...b, ...(b.type === 'section' ? {category: String(b.category ?? '')} : {}), uid: String(++uid)})),
    });
    // and as it is saved: without the handles
    const bare = () => ({style: state.template.style, color: state.template.color, blocks: state.template.blocks.map(({uid, ...block}) => block)});

    let saved = {};
    try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RSS_BUILDER.key) || '{}'); } catch (e) {}
    const state = {
        template: adopt(Array.isArray(saved.template?.blocks) && saved.template.blocks.length ? saved.template : presets[0].template),
        current: saved.current && saved.current.id ? saved.current : null,     // the saved newsletter being worked on: {id, name}
        name: saved.name || '',
        open: null,                                                            // the block whose settings are shown
        dirty: false,
        read: null,                                                            // read from the body: {loose}
    };
    let templates = [];                                                        // the user's saved newsletters

    const blocks = () => state.template.blocks;
    const sectionCategories = () => [...new Set(blocks().filter(b => b.type === 'section' && byId[b.category]).map(b => String(b.category)))];
    // the number a category's tags carry: its place, by name, among the sections' categories
    const numbering = (list) => {
        const used = list.filter(b => b.type === 'section' && byId[b.category]).map(b => String(b.category));
        return (id) => categories.filter(c => used.includes(c.id)).findIndex(c => c.id === id) + 1;
    };
    const numberOf = (id) => numbering(blocks())(id);
    // the feeds the newsletter draws from: those of its sections' categories; without a section, the ones selected, or all
    const feedsOf = () => {
        const used = sectionCategories(), all = $('#rss_selected option').toArray();
        if (used.length) return all.filter(o => used.includes(String($(o).data('category')))).map(o => o.value);
        const now = $('#rss_selected').val() || [];
        return now.length ? now : all.map(o => o.value);
    };
    const html = () => rssBuilderHtml(state.template, numberOf);

    // The body as it is now comes first: changed by hand since the builder wrote
    // it, it is read back into blocks, so the builder goes on from those changes
    // and not from what it remembers. A tag's number is a category of the selected
    // feeds (of all of them when none is selected), by name.
    const written = editorBody.session.getValue();
    if (written.trim()) {
        const same = (a, b) => nbTidy(nbWritten(nbPage(a).documentElement)) === nbTidy(nbWritten(nbPage(b).documentElement));
        const chosen = $('#rss_selected option:selected').toArray().map(o => String($(o).data('category')));
        const among = categories.filter(c => !chosen.length || chosen.includes(c.id));
        const read = same(written, html()) ? null : rssBuilderRead(written, (n) => among[n - 1]?.id, numbering, state.template.color);
        if (read) {
            state.template = adopt(read.template);
            // not the saved newsletter any more: saving it under that name asks first
            state.name = state.current ? state.current.name : state.name;
            state.current = null;
            state.dirty = true;
            state.read = {loose: read.loose};
        }
    }

    const option = (list, value) => list.map(([v, l]) => `<option value="${nbSafe(v)}" ${String(value) === String(v) ? 'selected' : ''}>${nbSafe(l)}</option>`).join('');
    const field = (label, control, col = 12) => `<div class="form-group col-${col} mb-2"><label class="small text-muted mb-0">${label}</label>${control}</div>`;
    const input = (b, name, more = '') => `<input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm" data-field="${name}" value="${nbSafe(b[name])}" ${more}>`;
    const select = (b, name, list) => `<select class="form-control form-control-sm" data-field="${name}">${option(list, b[name])}</select>`;

    // what the list says of a block, beside its name
    const summary = (b) => ({
        header: () => b.logo ? 'logo' : b.text,
        article: () => RSS_BUILDER.layouts.find(l => l[0] === b.layout)?.[1].split(':')[0] ?? '',
        section: () => byId[b.category]
            ? `${byId[b.category].name} · ${b.count} × ${(RSS_BUILDER.layouts.find(l => l[0] === b.layout)?.[1].split(':')[0] ?? '').toLowerCase()}`
            : 'pick a category',
        text: () => String(b.text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 44),
        button: () => b.label,
        image: () => b.src ? String(b.src).replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').slice(0, 40) : 'no picture yet',
        divider: () => b.kind === 'space' ? 'empty space' : 'thin line',
        footer: () => String(b.text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 44),
        html: () => String(b.html || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 44) || 'as written',
    })[b.type]();
    // and its settings
    const form = (b) => ({
        header: () => field('Newsletter name', input(b, 'text', 'maxlength="60"'), 8) + field('Position', select(b, 'align', RSS_BUILDER.aligns), 4)
            + field('Logo instead of the name: address of the picture (optional)', input(b, 'logo', 'placeholder="https://..." maxlength="500"'))
            + field('Logo width, px', `<input type="number" class="form-control form-control-sm" data-field="logo_width" data-optional="1" min="20" max="544" placeholder="auto" value="${nbSafe(b.logo_width)}">`, 6)
            + field('Logo height, px', `<input type="number" class="form-control form-control-sm" data-field="logo_height" data-optional="1" min="10" max="300" placeholder="${b.logo_width ? 'auto' : '36'}" value="${nbSafe(b.logo_height)}">`, 6)
            + '<div class="col-12 small text-muted mb-2">Give one side and the other keeps the picture\'s proportions; give both for an exact size.</div>',
        article: () => field('Layout', select(b, 'layout', RSS_BUILDER.layouts))
            + '<div class="col-12 small text-muted">An article of any of the newsletter\'s categories. The first one is the lead: [rss_title] is its title.</div>',
        section: () => field('Category', select(b, 'category', [...(byId[b.category] ? [] : [['', 'Pick a category...']]), ...categories.map(c => [c.id, `${c.name} (${c.feeds} feed${c.feeds === 1 ? '' : 's'})`])]), 8)
            + field('Articles', `<input type="number" class="form-control form-control-sm" data-field="count" min="1" max="10" value="${nbSafe(b.count)}">`, 4)
            + field('Layout', select(b, 'layout', RSS_BUILDER.layouts), 8)
            + field('Title starts with', input(b, 'heading', 'maxlength="30" placeholder="Latest"'), 4),
        text: () => field('Text (tags such as [to] and [domain] work; a link is written [words](address))', `<textarea class="form-control form-control-sm" rows="3" data-field="text" maxlength="2000">${nbSafe(b.text)}</textarea>`)
            + field('Size', select(b, 'size', [['13', 'Small'], ['15', 'Normal'], ['18', 'Large, bold'], ['22', 'Headline']]), 6) + field('Position', select(b, 'align', RSS_BUILDER.aligns), 6),
        button: () => field('Label', input(b, 'label', 'maxlength="60"'), 8) + field('Position', select(b, 'align', RSS_BUILDER.aligns), 4)
            + field('Link', input(b, 'url', 'maxlength="500"')),
        image: () => field('Address of the picture', input(b, 'src', 'placeholder="https://..." maxlength="500"'))
            + field('Link when clicked (optional)', input(b, 'url', 'maxlength="500"'), 7) + field('Description', input(b, 'alt', 'maxlength="80"'), 5),
        divider: () => field('Kind', select(b, 'kind', [['line', 'Thin line'], ['space', 'Empty space']])),
        footer: () => field('Footer text', `<textarea class="form-control form-control-sm" rows="9" data-field="text" maxlength="3000">${nbSafe(b.text)}</textarea>`)
            + '<div class="col-12 small text-muted mb-2">Write it as you want it read. An empty line starts a new paragraph; a link is written [words](address); tags such as [to], [date] and [domain] work. Keep a way to unsubscribe in it.</div>',
        html: () => field('HTML, written into the newsletter as it is', `<textarea class="form-control form-control-sm" rows="9" data-field="html" maxlength="12000" spellcheck="false" style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;white-space:pre">${nbSafe(b.html)}</textarea>`)
            + '<div class="col-12 small text-muted mb-2">Rows of the newsletter\'s table: &lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;...&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;. A part of the body changed by hand that no other block can say comes back here, untouched.</div>',
    })[b.type]();

    const dialog = bootbox.dialog({
        title: '<i class="fas fa-newspaper text-primary mr-2"></i> Newsletter builder',
        size: 'xl',
        onEscape: true,
        closeButton: true,
        message: `<style>
                #nb-blocks .nb-head { cursor: grab; user-select: none; }
                #nb-blocks .nb-block.nb-dragging { opacity: .35; }
                #nb-blocks .nb-block.nb-open { border-color: #5c80d1 !important; }
                #nb-blocks .nb-marker { height: 4px; margin: 3px 0; border-radius: 2px; background: #5c80d1; }
                #nb-palette .nb-add { cursor: grab; }
            </style>
            <div class="row">
            <div class="col-lg-5">
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="form-group col-5 mb-2">
                        <label class="small text-muted mb-0">Load</label>
                        <select class="form-control form-control-sm" id="nb-load"></select>
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group col-7 mb-2">
                        <label class="small text-muted mb-0">Save under the name</label>
                        <div class="input-group input-group-sm">
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="nb-tname" maxlength="60" placeholder="e.g. Health weekly">
                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="nb-save" title="Save this newsletter under that name"><i class="fas fa-save mr-1"></i>Save</button>
                                <button type="button" class="btn btn-alt-secondary" id="nb-copy" title="Save a copy under another name"><i class="fas fa-copy"></i></button>
                                <button type="button" class="btn btn-alt-danger" id="nb-remove" title="Remove this saved newsletter"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div id="nb-status" class="small text-muted mb-2"></div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="form-group col-8 mb-2">
                        <label class="small text-muted mb-0">Style</label>
                        <select class="form-control form-control-sm" id="nb-style">${option(RSS_BUILDER.styles, '')}</select>
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group col-4 mb-2">
                        <label class="small text-muted mb-0">Colour</label>
                        <input type="color" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="nb-color">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <label class="small text-muted mb-1">Add a block: click it, or drag it into place</label>
                <div id="nb-palette" class="mb-2">${Object.entries(B).map(([type, block]) =>
                    `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-alt-secondary nb-add mr-1 mb-1" draggable="true" data-type="${type}"><i class="fas ${block.icon} mr-1"></i>${block.label}</button>`).join('')}</div>
                <label class="small text-muted mb-1">The newsletter, top to bottom: drag a block to move it, click it for its settings</label>
                <div id="nb-blocks" class="border rounded p-2 mb-2 bg-body-light" style="max-height: 400px; min-height: 80px; overflow-y: auto"></div>
                <div id="nb-count" class="small"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-lg-7">
                <label class="small text-muted mb-1">Preview, with real articles <a href="#" id="nb-refresh" class="ml-2"><i class="fas fa-sync-alt"></i> other articles</a></label>
                <iframe id="nb-preview" sandbox="" style="width:100%;height:640px;border:1px solid #e9ecef;border-radius:4px;background:#fff"></iframe>
            </div>
        </div>`,
        buttons: {
            cancel: {label: 'Cancel', className: 'btn-secondary'},
            use: {
                label: '<i class="fas fa-check mr-1"></i> Use this newsletter',
                className: 'btn-primary nb-use',
                callback: () => {
                    const apply = () => {
                        const lead = blocks().some(b => b.type === 'article'), first = numberOf(sectionCategories()[0]);
                        $('#rss_selected').selectpicker('val', feedsOf()).trigger('change');
                        editorBody.session.setValue(html());
                        swal.mixin({toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 6000})
                            .fire({icon: 'success', title: 'Newsletter written and its feeds selected. For the subject: "Subject: '
                                + (lead || !first ? '[rss_cat]: [rss_title]' : `[rss_cat${first}]: [rss_title1_${first}]`) + '".'});
                    };
                    if (!editorBody.session.getValue().trim()) { apply(); return true; }
                    swal.fire({icon: 'question', title: 'Replace the body?', text: 'The body will be replaced by this newsletter.', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Replace'})
                        .then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) { apply(); dialog.modal('hide'); } });
                    return false;
                },
            },
        },
    });
    const list = dialog.find('#nb-blocks');
    const toast = (icon, title) => swal.mixin({toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 3500}).fire({icon, title});
    const failed = (xhr) => toast('error', xhr.responseJSON?.data || xhr.responseJSON?.message || 'Could not reach the server');

    let timer = null, shown = 0;
    function preview() {
        const mine = ++shown;
        $.ajax({url: RSS_BUILDER.urls.sample, type: 'post', dataType: 'json', global: false, data: {body: html(), rss_selected: feedsOf()}})
            .done((res) => { if (mine === shown) dialog.find('#nb-preview').attr('srcdoc', res.data); });
    }

    const head = (b) => `<i class="fas fa-grip-vertical text-muted mr-2"></i><i class="fas ${B[b.type].icon} text-primary mr-2" style="width: 1rem"></i>
        <span class="flex-grow-1 text-truncate"><b>${B[b.type].label}</b> <small class="text-muted ml-1 nb-summary">${nbSafe(summary(b))}</small></span>`;
    function draw() {
        list.html(blocks().map((b) => `
            <div class="nb-block border rounded bg-white mb-1 ${state.open === b.uid ? 'nb-open' : ''}" data-uid="${b.uid}">
                <div class="nb-head d-flex align-items-center px-2 py-1" draggable="true" title="Drag to move, click for the settings">
                    ${head(b)}
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link text-muted px-1 nb-dup" title="Duplicate"><i class="far fa-clone"></i></button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link text-danger px-1 nb-del" title="Take out"><i class="fas fa-times"></i></button>
                </div>
                ${state.open === b.uid ? `<div class="form-row border-top px-2 pt-2 mx-0">${form(b)}</div>` : ''}
            </div>`).join('') || '<div class="text-center text-muted small py-3">Empty: click a block above, or drag one here.</div>');
        changed(false);
    }
    // the newsletter changed: count, keep, show
    function changed(edited = true) {
        if (edited) state.dirty = true;
        const tags = rssBuilderTags(html());
        // a warmup keeps the first of its contents for the lead, used or not
        const used = tags.length + (tags.includes('[rss_content1]') ? 0 : 1);
        const problems = [];
        if (!blocks().length) problems.push('add a block');
        if (sectionCategories().length > 9) problems.push('9 categories at most');
        if (RSS_BUILDER.slots && used > RSS_BUILDER.slots) problems.push(`${used} articles, a warmup email carries ${RSS_BUILDER.slots}: take some out`);
        const notes = [];
        if (blocks().some(b => b.type === 'section' && !byId[b.category])) notes.push('a section without a category is left out');
        if (blocks().some(b => b.type === 'image' && !String(b.src || '').trim())) notes.push('a picture without an address is left out');
        if (!blocks().some(b => b.type === 'footer' && /unsubscribe/i.test(b.text || ''))) notes.push('no unsubscribe link in a footer');
        dialog.find('#nb-count')
            .toggleClass('text-danger', problems.length > 0).toggleClass('text-muted', !problems.length)
            .text(problems.length ? problems.join('; ') : `${tags.length} article${tags.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} per email`
                + (RSS_BUILDER.slots ? ` - ${used} of the ${RSS_BUILDER.slots} a warmup email can carry` : '')
                + (notes.length ? ' · ' + notes.join('; ') : ''));
        dialog.find('.nb-use').prop('disabled', problems.length > 0);
        dialog.find('#nb-status').text(state.current
            ? `Working on "${state.current.name}"` + (state.dirty ? ', changed since it was saved' : '')
            : state.read ? 'Read from the body as it is now, with the changes made to it by hand'
                + (state.read.loose ? '. Changes outside the blocks (the page\'s colours, its title) are not kept: use the Style and Colour here' : '')
            : 'Not saved under a name yet: it is kept in this browser only');
        dialog.find('#nb-remove').prop('disabled', !state.current);
        try { localStorage.setItem(RSS_BUILDER.key, JSON.stringify({template: bare(), current: state.current, name: dialog.find('#nb-tname').val()})); } catch (e) {}
        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(preview, 350);
    }
    function drawLoad() {
        dialog.find('#nb-load').html('<option value="">Load a newsletter...</option>'
            + (templates.length ? `<optgroup label="Saved">${templates.map(t => `<option value="s:${t.id}">${nbSafe(t.name)}</option>`).join('')}</optgroup>` : '')
            + `<optgroup label="Start from">${presets.map(p => `<option value="p:${p.key}">${nbSafe(p.name)}</option>`).join('')}</optgroup>`);
    }
    function load(template, current) {
        state.template = adopt(template);
        state.current = current;
        state.open = null;
        state.dirty = false;
        state.read = null;
        dialog.find('#nb-tname').val(current ? current.name : '');
        dialog.find('#nb-style').val(state.template.style);
        dialog.find('#nb-color').val(state.template.color);
        draw();
    }
    // a block of a kind, ready to go in: a section takes the first category no section has yet
    function fresh(type) {
        const block = {type, ...B[type].make(), uid: String(++uid)};
        if (type === 'section') {
            const taken = sectionCategories();
            block.category = (categories.find(c => !taken.includes(c.id)) || categories[0]).id;
        }
        return block;
    }

    dialog.find('#nb-tname').val(state.current ? state.current.name : state.name).on('input', () => changed(false));
    dialog.find('#nb-style').val(state.template.style).on('change', function () { state.template.style = this.value; changed(); });
    dialog.find('#nb-color').val(state.template.color).on('input', function () { state.template.color = this.value; changed(); });
    dialog.find('#nb-refresh').on('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); preview(); });

    // saved newsletters: load, save, copy, remove
    dialog.find('#nb-load').on('change', function () {
        const [kind, key] = this.value.split(':');
        this.value = '';
        const found = kind === 's' ? templates.find(t => String(t.id) === key) : presets.find(p => p.key === key);
        if (!found) return;
        const go = () => load(found.template, kind === 's' ? {id: found.id, name: found.name} : null);
        if (!state.dirty) return go();
        swal.fire({icon: 'question', title: 'Load it?', text: 'The changes made here since the last save will be lost.', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Load'})
            .then((result) => result.isConfirmed && go());
    });
    function store(name, onto) {
        const done = (res) => {
            templates = templates.filter(t => t.id !== res.template.id).concat([res.template]).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
            state.current = {id: res.template.id, name: res.template.name};
            state.dirty = false;
            dialog.find('#nb-tname').val(res.template.name);
            drawLoad();
            changed(false);
            toast('success', res.data);
        };
        return $.ajax({
            url: onto ? RSS_BUILDER.urls.item.replace('__ID__', onto) : RSS_BUILDER.urls.list,
            type: onto ? 'put' : 'post', dataType: 'json', global: false,
            // as one text: sent field by field, an emptied setting would come back as "not set"
            data: {name, template: JSON.stringify(bare())},
        }).done(done).fail(failed);
    }
    function save(copy) {
        let name = dialog.find('#nb-tname').val().trim();
        if (!name) {
            dialog.find('#nb-tname').focus();
            return toast('info', 'Give the newsletter a name first');
        }
        if (!blocks().length) return toast('info', 'There is nothing to save yet');
        const mine = !copy && state.current ? state.current.id : null;
        if (copy && templates.some(t => t.name === name)) {
            // a copy needs a name of its own
            const base = name.replace(/ copy( \d+)?$/, '');
            for (let n = 1; templates.some(t => t.name === name); n++) name = `${base} copy${n > 1 ? ' ' + n : ''}`;
        }
        const other = templates.find(t => t.name === name && t.id !== mine);
        if (!other) return store(name, mine);
        swal.fire({icon: 'question', title: `Replace "${name}"?`, text: 'A saved newsletter has that name already.', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Replace'})
            .then((result) => result.isConfirmed && store(name, null));
    }
    dialog.find('#nb-save').on('click', () => save(false));
    dialog.find('#nb-copy').on('click', () => save(true));
    dialog.find('#nb-remove').on('click', () => {
        if (!state.current) return;
        const {id, name} = state.current;
        swal.fire({icon: 'warning', title: `Remove "${name}"?`, text: 'The saved newsletter is removed. What is on screen stays.', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: 'Remove'})
            .then((result) => {
                if (!result.isConfirmed) return;
                $.ajax({url: RSS_BUILDER.urls.item.replace('__ID__', id), type: 'delete', dataType: 'json', global: false}).done((res) => {
                    templates = templates.filter(t => t.id !== id);
                    state.current = null;
                    drawLoad();
                    changed(false);
                    toast('success', res.data);
                }).fail(failed);
            });
    });

    // the blocks: settings, duplicate, take out
    const blockOf = (el) => blocks().find(b => b.uid === String($(el).closest('.nb-block').data('uid')));
    dialog.on('click', '.nb-add', function () {
        const block = fresh($(this).data('type'));
        blocks().push(block);
        state.open = block.uid;
        draw();
        changed();
        list.scrollTop(list[0].scrollHeight);
    }).on('click', '.nb-head', function (e) {
        if ($(e.target).closest('button').length) return;
        const b = blockOf(this);
        state.open = state.open === b.uid ? null : b.uid;
        draw();
    }).on('click', '.nb-dup', function () {
        const b = blockOf(this), copy = {...b, uid: String(++uid)};
        blocks().splice(blocks().indexOf(b) + 1, 0, copy);
        draw();
        changed();
    }).on('click', '.nb-del', function () {
        blocks().splice(blocks().indexOf(blockOf(this)), 1);
        draw();
        changed();
    }).on('input change', '[data-field]', function () {
        const b = blockOf(this), name = $(this).data('field');
        if (!b) return;
        // a number within the limits its box has; one that may be left empty stays empty
        const least = parseInt(this.min, 10) || 1, most = parseInt(this.max, 10) || 10;
        b[name] = this.type !== 'number' ? this.value
            : this.value === '' && $(this).data('optional') ? ''
            : Math.min(most, Math.max(least, parseInt(this.value, 10) || least));
        $(this).closest('.nb-block').find('.nb-summary').text(summary(b));
        changed();
    });

    // drag and drop: a block of the list to another place, or a new one from the palette
    let drag = null, at = null;
    const placeOf = (y) => {
        const cards = list.children('.nb-block').toArray();
        const i = cards.findIndex((card) => { const r = card.getBoundingClientRect(); return y < r.top + r.height / 2; });
        return i < 0 ? cards.length : i;
    };
    const drop = (place) => {
        let block;
        if (drag.uid) {
            const from = blocks().findIndex(b => b.uid === drag.uid);
            if (from < 0) return;
            [block] = blocks().splice(from, 1);
            if (from < place) place--;
        } else {
            block = fresh(drag.type);
            state.open = block.uid;
        }
        blocks().splice(place, 0, block);
    };
    dialog.on('dragstart', '.nb-head, .nb-add', function (e) {
        const card = $(this).closest('.nb-block');
        drag = card.length ? {uid: String(card.data('uid'))} : {type: $(this).data('type')};
        at = null;
        card.addClass('nb-dragging');
        const transfer = e.originalEvent.dataTransfer;
        if (transfer) {
            transfer.effectAllowed = 'copyMove';
            transfer.setData('text/plain', drag.uid || drag.type);     // Firefox drags nothing without data
        }
    }).on('dragend', function () {
        drag = null;
        list.find('.nb-marker').remove();
        list.find('.nb-dragging').removeClass('nb-dragging');
    });
    list.on('dragover', function (e) {
        if (!drag) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const place = placeOf(e.originalEvent.clientY);
        if (place === at) return;
        at = place;
        list.find('.nb-marker').remove();
        const cards = list.children('.nb-block');
        const marker = $('<div class="nb-marker"></div>');
        place < cards.length ? marker.insertBefore(cards.eq(place)) : marker.appendTo(list);
    }).on('drop', function (e) {
        if (!drag) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        drop(at ?? placeOf(e.originalEvent.clientY));
        drag = null;
        draw();
        changed();
    });

    drawLoad();
    draw();
    $.ajax({url: RSS_BUILDER.urls.list, dataType: 'json', global: false}).done((res) => {
        templates = res.data || [];
        // the one worked on last time may be gone, or renamed, since
        const mine = state.current && templates.find(t => t.id === state.current.id);
        state.current = mine ? {id: mine.id, name: mine.name} : null;
        drawLoad();
        changed(false);
    });
});
        const rssSummary = () => {

        $("#body_map").on('change', async function () {
            const getMeta = (image) => {
                return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    if(!image) {
                        resolve([0,0]);
                    }
                    const link = "/o" + "/" + image;
                    $("<img/>").attr('src', link)
                        .on('load', function () {
                            resolve([this.width, this.height]);

            const creative = $("#creative option:selected").text();

                $(this).prop('checked', false);

            const domain = $("#domain").val() || '[domain]';

            let body = bodyZero
                .replace(/\[domain\]/gi, domain)
                .replace('[imgr]', creative || 'NA')
                .replace('[imgu]', unsubscribe?.value || 'NA');

            if (this.checked) {
                body = bodyMapZero
                    .replace(/\[domain\]/gi, domain)
                    .replace('[imgr]', creative || 'NA')
                    .replace('[imgu]', unsubscribe?.value || 'NA');

                const [wr, hr] = await getMeta(creative);
                body = body.replace('[imgr_width]', wr).replace('[imgr_height]', hr);
                const [wu, hu] = await getMeta(unsubscribe?.value);
                body = body.replace('[imgu_width]', wu).replace('[imgu_height]', hu);
            }
            editorBody.session.setValue(body);
        });

        window.ptrMode = () => Number($('#option option:selected').data('ptr')) === 1;

// Resolves when the PTR VMTAs of the servers are in place (at once when the
// option is not PTR); rejects when the user says no, after going back to IP.
window.ptrReady = function (servers, type) {
    const ready = $.Deferred();
    if (!ptrMode()) {
        return ready.resolve().promise();
    }

    const esc = (text) => $('<div>').text(text == null ? '' : text).html();
    const list = (items) => esc(items.slice(0, 6).join(', ')) + (items.length > 6 ? ` and ${items.length - 6} more` : '');
    const back = () => {
        $('#option').val('ip').selectpicker('refresh').trigger('change');
        ready.reject();
    };
    const ask = (apply) => $.ajax({
        url: "https:\/\/a-p.io\/mailer\/pmta\/ptr-vmta",
        type: 'post',
        dataType: 'json',
        global: false,
        data: {server_ids: servers, type: type, apply: apply ? 1 : 0},
    });
    const failed = (xhr) => {
        swal.fire({icon: 'error', title: 'PTR option', text: xhr.responseJSON?.message || xhr.responseJSON?.data || 'Could not prepare the PTR VMTAs'});
        back();
    };
    // what could not be used, or is worth knowing, once the VMTAs are there
    const notes = (res) => [
        res.errors.length ? `<p class="text-danger mb-1"><b>Not created</b> on ${res.errors.length} server(s): ${esc(res.errors.join(' | '))}</p>` : '',
        res.no_ptr.length ? `<p class="mb-1"><b>${res.no_ptr.length} IP(s) have no PTR</b> and are left out: ${list(res.no_ptr)}</p>` : '',
        res.unconfirmed.length ? `<p class="mb-1"><b>${res.unconfirmed.length} IP(s)</b> have a PTR that does not point back at them (receivers may distrust it): ${list(res.unconfirmed)}</p>` : '',
    ].join('');
    const waiting = (title) => swal.fire({title, allowOutsideClick: false, showConfirmButton: false, didOpen: () => swal.showLoading()});

    waiting('Looking up the PTR of the IPs...');
    ask(false).done((plan) => {
        if (!plan.to_create) {
            const extra = notes(plan);
            if (extra) {
                swal.fire({icon: 'info', title: 'PTR as VMTA', html: `<p class="mb-1">${plan.kept} IP(s) ready.</p>${extra}`});
            } else {
                swal.close();
            }
            ready.resolve();
            return;
        }
        swal.fire({
            icon: 'info',
            title: 'Set the PTR as VMTA?',
            html: `<p>For <b>${plan.to_create} IP(s)</b> on <b>${plan.servers} server(s)</b>, a VMTA is created on the server
                   with the IP's PTR (its reverse DNS name) as host name, and PMTA is reloaded.</p>
                   <p class="mb-1">The send then goes through these VMTAs: PMTA greets with the PTR, and
                   <b>[vmta_domain]</b> is the PTR, like <b>[rdns]</b>. <b>[domain]</b> stays the IP's own domain.</p>
                   ${plan.kept ? `<p class="mb-1 text-muted">${plan.kept} IP(s) already have theirs.</p>` : ''}${notes(plan)}`,
            showCancelButton: true,
            confirmButtonText: 'Set PTR as VMTA',
            cancelButtonText: 'Cancel',
        }).then((result) => {
            if (!result.isConfirmed) {
                back();
                return;
            }
            waiting('Creating the VMTAs on the servers...');
            ask(true).done((res) => {
                const extra = notes(res);
                swal.fire({
                    icon: res.errors.length ? 'warning' : 'success',
                    title: `${res.created} PTR VMTA(s) created`,
                    html: extra || undefined,
                    timer: extra ? undefined : 1800,
                    showConfirmButton: !!extra,
                });
                ready.resolve();
            }).fail(failed);
        });
    }).fail(failed);

    return ready.promise();
};

    }
});
