<script>
// Template Editor engine: position-exact HTML tokenizer + surgical edits.
// Every edit splices only the bytes of the tag / content it changes, so the rest
// of the template stays byte-for-byte what was pasted.
const TE = (function () {
    const VOID = new Set(['area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'embed', 'hr', 'img', 'input', 'link', 'meta', 'param',
        'source', 'track', 'wbr', 'basefont', 'bgsound', 'frame', 'keygen']);
    const RAW_TEXT = new Set(['script', 'style', 'textarea', 'title', 'xmp']);
    const DEFAULT_HIDE = 'display: table-column-group';
    let hideMethods = [DEFAULT_HIDE];

    // ── decoding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function looksQuotedPrintable(s) {
        return /=\r?\n/.test(s) || /=3D/i.test(s) || (/=[0-9A-F]{2}/.test(s) && /=20|=09|=0D|=0A/i.test(s));
    }

    // the bytes a quoted-printable text stands for
    function qpDecodeBytes(input) {
        const s = input.replace(/=\r?\n/g, '');
        const bytes = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            const c = s[i];
            if (c === '=' && i + 2 < s.length && /^[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$/.test(s.substr(i + 1, 2))) {
                bytes.push(parseInt(s.substr(i + 1, 2), 16));
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
            const code = c.charCodeAt(0);
            if (code < 0x80) bytes.push(code);
            else for (const b of new TextEncoder().encode(c)) bytes.push(b);
        }
        return new Uint8Array(bytes);
    }

    function qpDecode(input) {
        const u8 = qpDecodeBytes(input);
        try {
            return new TextDecoder('utf-8', {fatal: true}).decode(u8);
        } catch (e) {
            // not valid UTF-8: most QP-encoded mail bodies that aren't are Windows-1252
            return new TextDecoder('windows-1252').decode(u8);
        }
    }

    function decode(input) {
        if (looksQuotedPrintable(input)) {
            // Plain HTML holds "=XX" of its own (content="IE=edge", ?qs=ABB7...).
            // Without a soft line break or an "=3D" to say it is encoded, it is
            // taken for quoted-printable only if it decodes to proper text.
            const sure = /=\r?\n/.test(input) || /=3D/i.test(input);
            if (!sure) {
                try {
                    return {html: new TextDecoder('utf-8', {fatal: true}).decode(qpDecodeBytes(input)), wasQp: true};
                } catch (e) {
                    return {html: input, wasQp: false};
                }
            }
            return {html: qpDecode(input), wasQp: true};
        }
        return {html: input, wasQp: false};
    }

    // ── encoding ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Quoted-printable that never breaks a line inside a [tag] (the sender
    // would no longer recognise [dom=\r\nain]) or an =XX escape.
    function qpEncodeBytes(bytes, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        const maxLen = opts.maxLen || 76;
        const protectRe = opts.protectRe || /\[[^\]\r\n]*\]/g;

        // Step 1: per-character encoding into an array of "atoms".
        // Each atom is either a printable ASCII char or a =XX sequence.
        // Then we collapse adjacent atoms into one string, but mark
        // the indices of protected `[tag]` ranges.
        const out = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
            const b = bytes[i];
            if (b === 0x0A) { out.push('\n'); continue; }                // LF
            if (b === 0x0D) { out.push('\r'); continue; }                // CR
            if (b === 0x3D) { out.push('=3D'); continue; }               // '='
            if (b === 0x09 || b === 0x20) { out.push(String.fromCharCode(b)); continue; } // tab/space
            if (b >= 0x21 && b <= 0x7E) { out.push(String.fromCharCode(b)); continue; }   // printable ASCII
            out.push('=' + b.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, '0'));
        }
        const encoded = out.join('');

        // Step 2: line-wrap at maxLen, avoiding breaks inside [tag]
        // and inside an =XX sequence. Also encode trailing space/tab
        // on each hard line (RFC 2045 requires this).
        const lines = encoded.split(/\r\n|\n|\r/);
        const result = [];

        for (const rawLine of lines) {
            let line = rawLine;
            // Encode trailing whitespace
            line = line.replace(/[ \t]+$/, (m) => {
                return [...m].map(c => '=' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, '0')).join('');
            });

            // Find protected ranges in this line
            const protect = [];
            let pm;
            const re = new RegExp(protectRe.source, protectRe.flags);
            while ((pm = re.exec(line)) !== null) {
                protect.push([pm.index, pm.index + pm[0].length]);
                if (pm.index === re.lastIndex) re.lastIndex++; // avoid infinite loop on zero-length
            }

            const insideProtect = (pos) => {
                for (const [s, e] of protect) {
                    if (pos > s && pos < e) return [s, e];
                }
                return null;
            };

            let pos = 0;
            while (line.length - pos > maxLen) {
                // Tentative break at pos + maxLen - 1 (reserve 1 for trailing '=')
                let breakAt = pos + maxLen - 1;

                // Don't break inside an =XX sequence
                if (line[breakAt - 1] === '=') breakAt -= 1;
                else if (breakAt >= 2 && line[breakAt - 2] === '=') breakAt -= 2;

                // Don't break inside a protected [tag] — back off to before it
                const inside = insideProtect(breakAt);
                if (inside) {
                    breakAt = inside[0]; // jump to start of the tag
                }

                // If after all adjustments we'd produce an empty chunk,
                // just emit the protected atom oversize (better than splitting it)
                if (breakAt <= pos) {
                    const inside2 = insideProtect(pos + 1);
                    if (inside2) {
                        // Emit the protected range as one oversize chunk
                        result.push(line.slice(pos, inside2[1]) + '=');
                        pos = inside2[1];
                        continue;
                    }
                    // No way to break cleanly — fall back to hard cut
                    breakAt = pos + maxLen - 1;
                }

                result.push(line.slice(pos, breakAt) + '=');
                pos = breakAt;
            }
            result.push(line.slice(pos));
        }

        return result.join('\r\n');
    }

    function qpEncode(input, opts) {
        return qpEncodeBytes(new TextEncoder().encode(input), opts);
    }

    // ── tokenizer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // nodes[i] = {id, name, start, tagEnd, innerStart, innerEnd, end}
    //   start..tagEnd      the opening tag, e.g. <td style="...">
    //   innerStart..innerEnd  content between the tags (null if never closed / void)
    function findTagEnd(src, from) {
        let quote = null;
        for (let i = from; i < src.length; i++) {
            const c = src[i];
            if (quote) {
                if (c === quote) quote = null;
            } else if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
                quote = c;
            } else if (c === '>') {
                return i + 1;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    function parse(src) {
        const nodes = [];
        const stack = [];
        let i = 0;
        const n = src.length;

        while (i < n) {
            const lt = src.indexOf('<', i);
            if (lt === -1) break;
            i = lt;

            if (src.startsWith('<!--', i)) {
                const e = src.indexOf('-->', i + 4);
                i = e === -1 ? n : e + 3;
                continue;
            }
            if (src[i + 1] === '!' || src[i + 1] === '?') {
                const e = src.indexOf('>', i);
                i = e === -1 ? n : e + 1;
                continue;
            }

            const endMatch = /^<\/([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9:-]*)/.exec(src.substr(i, 64));
            if (endMatch) {
                const e = src.indexOf('>', i);
                const tagEndPos = e === -1 ? n : e + 1;
                const name = endMatch[1].toLowerCase();
                for (let s = stack.length - 1; s >= 0; s--) {
                    if (stack[s].name === name) {
                        // anything opened after it and not closed stays "unclosed"
                        stack[s].innerEnd = i;
                        stack[s].end = tagEndPos;
                        stack.length = s;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                i = tagEndPos;
                continue;
            }

            const startMatch = /^<([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9:-]*)/.exec(src.substr(i, 64));
            if (!startMatch) {
                i++;
                continue;
            }

            const tagEnd = findTagEnd(src, i + startMatch[0].length);
            if (tagEnd === -1) break; // malformed tail: leave it as text

            const name = startMatch[1].toLowerCase();
            const node = {
                id: nodes.length, name, start: i, tagEnd,
                innerStart: null, innerEnd: null, end: null,
            };
            nodes.push(node);

            const selfClosed = src[tagEnd - 2] === '/';
            if (VOID.has(name) || selfClosed) {
                node.end = tagEnd;
                i = tagEnd;
                continue;
            }

            node.innerStart = tagEnd;

            if (RAW_TEXT.has(name)) {
                // CSS/JS content is not markup: skip straight to its closing tag
                const close = src.toLowerCase().indexOf('</' + name, tagEnd);
                if (close === -1) {
                    i = n;
                } else {
                    const e = src.indexOf('>', close);
                    node.innerEnd = close;
                    node.end = e === -1 ? n : e + 1;
                    i = node.end;
                }
                continue;
            }

            stack.push(node);
            i = tagEnd;
        }

        return nodes;
    }

    // ── attributes (operate on the raw opening-tag text) ──────────
    function attrs(tagRaw) {
        const nameLen = /^<[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9:-]*/.exec(tagRaw)[0].length;
        const re = /\s+([^\s"'>\/=]+)(?:\s*=\s*("([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\s"'>]+)))?/g;
        re.lastIndex = nameLen;
        const out = [];
        let m;
        while ((m = re.exec(tagRaw)) !== null) {
            if (m.index !== re.lastIndex - m[0].length) break;
            out.push({
                name: m[1].toLowerCase(),
                value: m[3] ?? m[4] ?? m[5] ?? null,
                start: m.index,
                end: m.index + m[0].length,
            });
        }
        return out;
    }

    function getAttr(tagRaw, name) {
        const a = attrs(tagRaw).find(x => x.name === name.toLowerCase());
        return a ? a.value : null;
    }

    function setAttr(tagRaw, name, value) {
        const a = attrs(tagRaw).find(x => x.name === name.toLowerCase());
        const serialized = value === null ? '' : ' ' + name + '="' + String(value).replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + '"';
        if (a) {
            return tagRaw.slice(0, a.start) + serialized + tagRaw.slice(a.end);
        }
        if (value === null) return tagRaw;
        const close = tagRaw.endsWith('/>') ? tagRaw.length - 2 : tagRaw.length - 1;
        // keep a space before "/>" if the tag had one
        const insertAt = tagRaw.endsWith(' />') ? close - 1 : close;
        return tagRaw.slice(0, insertAt) + serialized + tagRaw.slice(insertAt);
    }

    // ── URLs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Where an email carries addresses: link / image attributes, and url(...)
    // in inline styles and <style> blocks. Edits replace only the URL's text,
    // inside its own quotes, so the rest of the tag stays as it was.
    const URL_ATTRS = ['href', 'src', 'background', 'action', 'poster'];
    const HOST_URL = /^(\s*)((?:https?:)?\/\/)([^\/?#\s@]*@)?([^\/?#:\s]+)(:\d+)?([\s\S]*?)(\s*)$/i;
    // url(...), quoted with ' or ", as HTML entities (inside a style="" attribute), or not at all
    const CSS_URL = /url\(\s*(&quot;|&#0*34;|&#0*39;|&apos;|['"]?)([^'")]*?)\1\s*\)/gi;

    function splitUrl(url) {
        const m = HOST_URL.exec(url);
        return m ? {lead: m[1], scheme: m[2], user: m[3] || '', host: m[4], port: m[5] || '', rest: m[6], trail: m[7]} : null;
    }

    const joinUrl = u => u.lead + u.scheme + u.user + u.host + u.port + u.rest + u.trail;

    // where an attribute's value sits in the tag: [start, end), or null
    function attrValueSpan(tagRaw, name) {
        const a = attrs(tagRaw).find(x => x.name === name);
        if (!a || a.value === null) return null;
        const text = tagRaw.slice(a.start, a.end);
        let i = text.indexOf('=') + 1;
        while (/\s/.test(text[i])) i++;
        const start = a.start + i + (text[i] === '"' || text[i] === "'" ? 1 : 0);
        return [start, start + a.value.length];
    }

    // what an address is used for, in the email
    function urlKind(node, attr) {
        if (attr === 'href') return node.name === 'a' || node.name === 'area' ? 'link' : 'other';
        return attr === 'src' || attr === 'background' || attr === 'css' ? 'image' : 'other';
    }

    // url(...) in CSS text, each rewritten by fn(url, kind) -> new url or null (keep)
    function editCss(css, fn) {
        return css.replace(CSS_URL, (whole, quote, url) => {
            const next = fn(url, 'image');
            return next === null || next === url ? whole : whole.replace(url, () => next);
        });
    }

    // Rewrite addresses: fn(url, kind) returns the new url, or null to keep it.
    // Nodes are edited from the end backwards, so offsets not yet reached stay right.
    function editUrls(src, fn) {
        let out = src;
        parse(src).slice().sort((a, b) => b.start - a.start).forEach(node => {
            if (node.name === 'style' && node.innerEnd !== null) {
                const css = innerOf(out, node);
                const next = editCss(css, fn);
                if (next !== css) out = replaceInner(out, node, next);
            }
            let tag = tagRawOf(out, node);
            const edits = [];
            URL_ATTRS.forEach(attr => {
                const span = attrValueSpan(tag, attr);
                if (!span) return;
                const url = tag.slice(span[0], span[1]);
                const next = fn(url, urlKind(node, attr));
                if (next !== null && next !== url) edits.push([span, next]);
            });
            const styleSpan = attrValueSpan(tag, 'style');
            if (styleSpan) {
                const css = tag.slice(styleSpan[0], styleSpan[1]);
                const next = editCss(css, fn);
                if (next !== css) edits.push([styleSpan, next]);
            }
            if (!edits.length) return;
            edits.sort((a, b) => b[0][0] - a[0][0]).forEach(([span, text]) => {
                tag = tag.slice(0, span[0]) + text + tag.slice(span[1]);
            });
            out = replaceTag(out, node, tag);
        });
        return out;
    }

    // The domains addresses point at, most used first:
    // [{host, links, images, other, total}] (hosts as written; grouped ignoring case)
    function hosts(src) {
        const found = new Map();
        editUrls(src, (url, kind) => {
            const u = splitUrl(url);
            if (u) {
                const key = u.host.toLowerCase();
                const row = found.get(key) || {host: u.host, links: 0, images: 0, other: 0, total: 0};
                row[kind === 'link' ? 'links' : kind === 'image' ? 'images' : 'other']++;
                row.total++;
                found.set(key, row);
            }
            return null;
        });
        return [...found.values()].sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total || a.host.localeCompare(b.host));
    }

    const sameHost = (u, host) => !!u && u.host.toLowerCase() === host.toLowerCase();

    // every address on `host` points at `newHost` instead; scheme, port, path,
    // query and fragment are kept
    function changeHost(src, host, newHost) {
        return editUrls(src, url => {
            const u = splitUrl(url);
            return sameHost(u, host) ? joinUrl({...u, host: newHost}) : null;
        });
    }

    // `suffix` at the end of every link on `host` (before a #fragment); images
    // and other addresses only when asked, since a changed image address breaks it
    function appendToUrls(src, host, suffix, opts) {
        const kinds = opts && opts.allKinds ? null : ['link'];
        return editUrls(src, (url, kind) => {
            const u = splitUrl(url);
            if (!sameHost(u, host) || (kinds && !kinds.includes(kind))) return null;
            const hash = u.rest.indexOf('#');
            const body = hash < 0 ? u.rest : u.rest.slice(0, hash);
            if (body.endsWith(suffix)) return null;
            return joinUrl({...u, rest: body + suffix + (hash < 0 ? '' : u.rest.slice(hash))});
        });
    }

    // ── inline style ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    function splitDecls(style) {
        const out = [];
        let depth = 0, quote = null, cur = '';
        for (const c of style) {
            if (quote) {
                if (c === quote) quote = null;
            } else if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
                quote = c;
            } else if (c === '(') {
                depth++;
            } else if (c === ')') {
                depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
            } else if (c === ';' && depth === 0) {
                out.push(cur);
                cur = '';
                continue;
            }
            cur += c;
        }
        out.push(cur);
        return out.filter(d => d.trim() !== '');
    }

    function joinDecls(decls) {
        return decls.map(d => d.trim()).join('; ') + (decls.length ? ';' : '');
    }

    // A hide method is one or more declarations appended at the end of the inline
    // style. An element counts as hidden only when its style ENDS with a known
    // method, so a declaration the template already had (e.g. its own display:none
    // earlier in the style) is never mistaken for ours, and unhide removes exactly
    // what hide added.
    function normDecl(d) {
        return d.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
            .replace(/\s*:\s*/, ':').replace(/\s*!\s*important$/, '!important');
    }

    function methodDecls(method) {
        return splitDecls(method || '').map(d => d.trim()).filter(d => d.includes(':'));
    }

    function sameMethod(a, b) {
        return methodDecls(a).map(normDecl).join(';') === methodDecls(b).map(normDecl).join(';');
    }

    function setHideMethods(list) {
        const valid = [DEFAULT_HIDE, ...list].filter(m => methodDecls(m).length);
        // longest first, so "display: none; mso-hide: all" wins over "display: none"
        hideMethods = valid.filter((m, k) => valid.findIndex(x => sameMethod(x, m)) === k)
            .sort((a, b) => methodDecls(b).length - methodDecls(a).length);
    }

    function hiddenTail(decls) {
        for (const method of hideMethods) {
            const md = methodDecls(method).map(normDecl);
            const tail = decls.slice(-md.length);
            if (tail.length === md.length && tail.every((d, k) => normDecl(d) === md[k])) {
                return {method, count: md.length};
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    // the method the element is hidden with, or null
    function hiddenWith(tagRaw) {
        const style = getAttr(tagRaw, 'style');
        const tail = style ? hiddenTail(splitDecls(style)) : null;
        return tail ? tail.method : null;
    }

    function isHidden(tagRaw) {
        return hiddenWith(tagRaw) !== null;
    }

    // Appended last, so it wins over an existing display without replacing it.
    // Hiding with a different method switches: the old declarations go first.
    function hide(tagRaw, method) {
        method = method || DEFAULT_HIDE;
        const md = methodDecls(method);
        if (!md.length) return tagRaw;
        const current = hiddenWith(tagRaw);
        if (current !== null && sameMethod(current, method)) return tagRaw;
        if (current !== null) tagRaw = unhide(tagRaw);

        const style = getAttr(tagRaw, 'style');
        if (style === null || style.trim() === '') {
            return setAttr(tagRaw, 'style', joinDecls(md));
        }
        return setAttr(tagRaw, 'style', style.replace(/\s*;?\s*$/, '') + '; ' + joinDecls(md));
    }

    function unhide(tagRaw) {
        const style = getAttr(tagRaw, 'style');
        if (style === null) return tagRaw;
        const decls = splitDecls(style);
        const tail = hiddenTail(decls);
        if (!tail) return tagRaw;
        const kept = decls.slice(0, decls.length - tail.count);
        return setAttr(tagRaw, 'style', kept.length ? joinDecls(kept) : null);
    }

    function setStyleProp(tagRaw, prop, value) {
        const style = getAttr(tagRaw, 'style') ?? '';
        const decls = splitDecls(style);
        const tail = hiddenTail(decls);
        const tailStart = decls.length - (tail ? tail.count : 0);
        const idx = decls.findIndex((d, k) => k < tailStart && d.split(':')[0].trim().toLowerCase() === prop);
        if (value === null) {
            if (idx === -1) return tagRaw;
            decls.splice(idx, 1);
        } else if (idx === -1) {
            // keep the hide declarations last so they still win
            decls.splice(tailStart, 0, prop + ': ' + value);
        } else {
            decls[idx] = prop + ': ' + value;
        }
        return setAttr(tagRaw, 'style', decls.length ? joinDecls(decls) : null);
    }

    // ── splicing into the source ──────────────────────────────────
    function tagRawOf(src, node) {
        return src.slice(node.start, node.tagEnd);
    }

    function replaceTag(src, node, newTagRaw) {
        return src.slice(0, node.start) + newTagRaw + src.slice(node.tagEnd);
    }

    function innerOf(src, node) {
        return node.innerEnd === null ? null : src.slice(node.innerStart, node.innerEnd);
    }

    // e.g. <a href="..."> + element + </a>
    function wrap(src, node, openTag, closeTag) {
        const end = node.end ?? node.tagEnd;
        return src.slice(0, node.start) + openTag + src.slice(node.start, end) + closeTag + src.slice(end);
    }

    // remove an element's own tags, keep what's inside
    function unwrap(src, node) {
        if (node.innerEnd === null) throw new Error('element has no closing tag');
        return src.slice(0, node.start) + src.slice(node.innerStart, node.innerEnd) + src.slice(node.end);
    }

    function replaceInner(src, node, newInner) {
        if (node.innerEnd === null) throw new Error('element has no closing tag');
        return src.slice(0, node.innerStart) + newInner + src.slice(node.innerEnd);
    }

    // ── preview (never part of the output) ───────────────────────
    function previewHtml(src, nodes, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        let out = src;
        for (let k = nodes.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
            const node = nodes[k];
            const nameEnd = node.start + 1 + node.name.length;
            const marker = ' data-te="' + node.id + '"' + (isHidden(tagRawOf(src, node)) ? ' data-te-hidden' : '');
            out = out.slice(0, nameEnd) + marker + out.slice(nameEnd);
        }
        if (opts.previewDomain) {
            out = out.replace(/\[domain\]/gi, opts.previewDomain);
        }
        return out;
    }

    return {
        decode, looksQuotedPrintable, qpDecode, qpDecodeBytes, qpEncode, qpEncodeBytes, parse, attrs, getAttr, setAttr,
        DEFAULT_HIDE, setHideMethods, sameMethod, hiddenWith, isHidden, hide, unhide, setStyleProp,
        tagRawOf, replaceTag, innerOf, replaceInner, wrap, unwrap, previewHtml,
        splitUrl, hosts, editUrls, changeHost, appendToUrls,
    };
})();
</script>
<script>
// The HTML part of an email body, for the Template Editor: find it, decode it,
// and put an edited version back. Everything outside that part (boundaries,
// part headers, the text/plain part) is left byte for byte as it was.
// Needs TE (engine) for quoted-printable.
const TemplateMime = (function () {
    // Charsets the part can be written back in without changing a character
    const UTF8 = ['utf-8', 'utf8', 'us-ascii', 'ascii'];
    const LATIN1 = ['iso-8859-1', 'iso8859-1', 'latin1', 'l1'];

    function eolOf(text) {
        return text.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n';
    }

    // "Content-Type: text/html; charset=..." headers of a part, unfolded, lower-cased names
    function parseHeaders(block) {
        const headers = {};
        block.replace(/\r?\n[ \t]+/g, ' ').split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line) => {
            const i = line.indexOf(':');
            if (i > 0) headers[line.slice(0, i).trim().toLowerCase()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
        });
        return headers;
    }

    function param(value, name) {
        const m = new RegExp(name + '\\s*=\\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|([^;\\s]+))', 'i').exec(value || '');
        return m ? (m[1] ?? m[2]) : null;
    }

    // [charset] / [transfer] / [content_type] as the campaign form sets them
    function resolveTags(value, form) {
        return (value || '')
            .replace(/\[charset\]/gi, form.charset || 'UTF-8')
            .replace(/\[transfer\]/gi, form.transfer || '8bit')
            .replace(/\[content_type\]/gi, form.contentType || 'text/html');
    }

    // The html parts inside a multipart body (recursing into nested multiparts),
    // each as {start, end, headers}: start..end is the part's content.
    function htmlParts(body, boundary, form, from = 0, to = body.length) {
        const found = [];
        const delim = '--' + boundary;
        const lines = [];
        const re = /[^\r\n]*(\r\n|\n|$)/g;
        re.lastIndex = from;
        let m;
        while (re.lastIndex < to && (m = re.exec(body)) && m[0] !== '') {
            const text = m[0].replace(/\r?\n$/, '');
            if (text.replace(/[ \t]+$/, '') === delim || text.replace(/[ \t]+$/, '') === delim + '--') {
                lines.push({start: m.index, end: m.index + m[0].length, close: text.trimEnd() === delim + '--'});
            }
        }
        // a body that does not close its last part ("--boundary--" left out): the part runs to the end
        if (lines.length && !lines[lines.length - 1].close) {
            lines.push({start: to, end: to, close: true});
        }
        for (let k = 0; k < lines.length - 1; k++) {
            if (lines[k].close) break;
            const partStart = lines[k].end;
            const partEnd = lines[k + 1].start;
            const part = body.slice(partStart, partEnd);
            const split = /\r?\n\r?\n/.exec(part);
            if (!split) continue;
            const headers = parseHeaders(resolveTags(part.slice(0, split.index), form));
            const type = (headers['content-type'] || 'text/plain').toLowerCase();
            const contentStart = partStart + split.index + split[0].length;
            // the line break before the next delimiter belongs to the delimiter
            let contentEnd = partEnd;
            if (body.slice(contentEnd - 2, contentEnd) === '\r\n') contentEnd -= 2;
            else if (body[contentEnd - 1] === '\n') contentEnd -= 1;
            if (type.startsWith('multipart/') && param(type, 'boundary')) {
                found.push(...htmlParts(body, param(headers['content-type'], 'boundary'), form, contentStart, contentEnd));
            } else if (type.startsWith('text/html')) {
                found.push({start: contentStart, end: Math.max(contentStart, contentEnd), headers});
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    function bytesToText(bytes, charset) {
        if (UTF8.includes(charset)) {
            return new TextDecoder('utf-8', {fatal: true}).decode(bytes);
        }
        return Array.from(bytes, (b) => String.fromCharCode(b)).join(''); // latin1: byte = code point
    }

    function textToBytes(text, charset) {
        // us-ascii is written as UTF-8: identical for ASCII, and what any
        // other character in such a part already is (see extract)
        if (UTF8.includes(charset)) {
            return new TextEncoder().encode(text);
        }
        // Latin-1 holds a byte per character up to U+00FF; of any other charset
        // only its ASCII is written (extract() lets such a part in only when
        // it holds nothing else)
        const last = LATIN1.includes(charset) ? 0xFF : 0x7F;
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(text.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
            const code = text.charCodeAt(i);
            if (code > last) throw new Error(`"${text[i]}" can't be written in ${charset}. Remove it, or change the part's charset to UTF-8.`);
            bytes[i] = code;
        }
        return bytes;
    }

    function base64ToBytes(text) {
        const bin = atob(text.replace(/\s+/g, ''));
        return Uint8Array.from(bin, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
    }

    function bytesToBase64(bytes, eol) {
        let bin = '';
        bytes.forEach((b) => (bin += String.fromCharCode(b)));
        return (btoa(bin).match(/.{1,76}/g) || ['']).join(eol);
    }

    /**
     * Find and decode the HTML to edit.
     *   body, header: the campaign's body and header text
     *   form: {charset, transfer, contentType} from the campaign form, for [tags]
     * Returns {ok: true, html, part} or {ok: false, error}. `part` is what
     * apply() needs, plus `notes` and `label` to show the user.
     */
    function extract(body, header, form = {}) {
        const eol = eolOf(body);
        const headerType = resolveTags(parseHeaders(header || '')['content-type'] || '', form);
        const said = param(headerType, 'boundary');

        // The boundary the body is cut with. The header's, when the body uses
        // it. Otherwise the body's own: one it names itself, in a header block
        // of its own ("Content-Type: multipart/...; boundary=..."), or the one
        // of its first delimiter line - "--something", then a part's headers.
        const named = /^content-type:[ \t]*multipart\/[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n[ \t]+[^\r\n]*)*/im.exec(body);
        const first = /^--(\S+)[ \t]*\r?\n(?:[\w-]+:[^\r\n]*\r?\n(?:[ \t]+[^\r\n]*\r?\n)*)*?content-type:/im.exec(body);
        const own = [named ? param(resolveTags(named[0], form), 'boundary') : null, first ? first[1] : null].filter(Boolean);
        let boundary = null, parts = [];
        for (const candidate of [said, ...own].filter(Boolean)) {
            parts = htmlParts(body, candidate, form);
            if (parts.length) {
                boundary = candidate;
                break;
            }
        }

        let start = 0, end = body.length, cte, charset, notes = [], label, sure = true;
        if (!boundary && (own.length || /^content-type:/im.test(body))) {
            // cut in parts, and none of them is HTML - or its delimiter lines could not be made out
            return {ok: false, error: 'This body has no HTML part to edit.'};
        }
        if (boundary) {
            if (said && boundary !== said) {
                notes.push(`The header's boundary (${said}) is not the one the body is cut with (${boundary}): a mail client would not find the parts. Editing the HTML part the body itself marks.`);
            }
            if (parts.length > 1) notes.push(`This body has ${parts.length} HTML parts; editing the first one, the others are left as they are.`);
            ({start, end} = parts[0]);
            cte = (parts[0].headers['content-transfer-encoding'] || '7bit').toLowerCase();
            charset = (param(parts[0].headers['content-type'], 'charset') || 'us-ascii').toLowerCase();
            label = 'HTML part';
        } else {
            // (a header that names a boundary over a body that is not cut in parts: the body is all there is to edit)
            if (said) {
                notes.push('The header says multipart, but the body is not cut in parts: it is edited as one HTML body.');
            }
            // A single HTML body: stored decoded, or already quoted-printable.
            // Plain HTML holds "=XX" of its own - content="IE=edge",
            // ?qs=ABB7... - so those alone do not make a body quoted-printable:
            // a soft line break or an "=3D" does, or the header saying so.
            const transfer = resolveTags(parseHeaders(header || '')['content-transfer-encoding'] || '', form).trim().toLowerCase();
            sure = /=\r?\n/.test(body) || /=3D/i.test(body);
            cte = sure || (TE.looksQuotedPrintable(body) && (transfer === 'quoted-printable' || transfer === ''))
                ? 'quoted-printable' : '8bit';
            charset = (param(headerType, 'charset') || form.charset || 'utf-8').toLowerCase();
            label = 'body';
        }

        const content = body.slice(start, end);
        if (!UTF8.includes(charset) && !LATIN1.includes(charset)) {
            // Another charset (ISO-2022-JP, windows-1252...). A part that is not
            // encoded is text already, and is written back as text: its charset
            // does not come into it. An encoded one can be edited while it only
            // holds ASCII, which every such charset writes the same way.
            const encoded = cte === 'quoted-printable' || cte === 'base64';
            let ascii = true;
            if (encoded) {
                try {
                    ascii = (cte === 'base64' ? base64ToBytes(content) : TE.qpDecodeBytes(content)).every((byte) => byte < 0x80);
                } catch (e) {
                    ascii = false;
                }
            }
            if (!ascii) {
                return {ok: false, error: `The ${label} uses the ${charset} charset, which the Template Editor can't write back without changing characters.`};
            }
            if (encoded) notes.push(`This ${label} is in ${charset.toUpperCase()}: only plain ASCII characters can be added to it.`);
        }

        let html;
        try {
            if (cte === 'quoted-printable') html = bytesToText(TE.qpDecodeBytes(content), charset);
            else if (cte === 'base64') html = bytesToText(base64ToBytes(content), charset);
            else html = content; // 7bit / 8bit: already text
        } catch (e) {
            if (cte === 'quoted-printable' && !sure) {
                // it only looked quoted-printable: decoded, it is not text. It is plain HTML.
                cte = '8bit';
                html = content;
            } else if (cte === 'quoted-printable' || cte === 'base64') {
                // Really encoded, but in another charset than it says (an email
                // saved from a Latin-1 mailbox, mostly). Read byte for byte, it
                // is written back byte for byte: nothing in it changes.
                html = bytesToText(cte === 'base64' ? base64ToBytes(content) : TE.qpDecodeBytes(content), 'iso-8859-1');
                notes.push(`This ${label} says ${charset.toUpperCase()} but holds other bytes (Latin-1, most likely). Accented letters may look odd here; they are written back exactly as they are.`);
                charset = 'iso-8859-1';
            } else {
                return {ok: false, error: `The ${label} is not valid ${charset.toUpperCase()}, so it can't be edited safely.`};
            }
        }

        if ((charset === 'us-ascii' || charset === 'ascii') && /[^\x00-\x7F]/.test(html)) {
            notes.push(`This ${label} says us-ascii but already holds other characters (as UTF-8); they are kept exactly as they are.`);
        }

        const encoding = cte === 'quoted-printable' ? 'quoted-printable' : (cte === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'plain');
        return {ok: true, html, part: {start, end, cte: encoding, charset, eol, notes, label}};
    }

    // Quoted-printable in the part's charset and line breaks. The body's own
    // line break is a hard line break; any other CR or LF inside the HTML
    // (an =0D / =0A in the stored text) must stay escaped, or re-encoding
    // would turn it into a line break. The encoder writes CR and LF as line
    // breaks, so they go through it as NUL / SOH (=00 / =01), which HTML
    // never holds, and are renamed back.
    function qpEncode(html, part) {
        if (/[\x00\x01]/.test(html)) throw new Error('The HTML holds control characters (NUL / SOH) the editor can\'t encode.');
        const segments = html.split(part.eol).map((line) => line.replace(/\r/g, '\x00').replace(/\n/g, '\x01'));
        return TE.qpEncodeBytes(textToBytes(segments.join('\n'), part.charset))
            .replace(/=00/g, '=0D')
            .replace(/=01/g, '=0A')
            .replace(/\r\n/g, part.eol);
    }

    /**
     * The body with the part's content replaced by `html`, encoded the way the
     * part was. Throws if a character can't be written in the part's charset.
     */
    function apply(body, part, html) {
        let encoded;
        if (part.cte === 'quoted-printable') {
            encoded = qpEncode(html, part);
        } else if (part.cte === 'base64') {
            encoded = bytesToBase64(textToBytes(html, part.charset), part.eol);
        } else {
            encoded = html; // 7bit / 8bit: written back as text, nothing to encode
        }
        return body.slice(0, part.start) + encoded + body.slice(part.end);
    }

    return {extract, apply};
})();
</script>
<script>
// ── Template Editor UI ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// Wires the workspace markup. A page with its own paste box / output box
// (teInput, teLoad, teOutput, teCopy, teDownload) gets them wired too; a page
// without them drives the editor through window.TemplateEditor (see the end).
window.TemplateEditor = (function () {
    const $e = id => document.getElementById(id);
    const on = (id, type, fn) => $e(id) && $e(id).addEventListener(type, fn);
    const frame = $e('tePreview');
    if (!frame) return null;

    // Preview-only styling; never part of the output
    const EDITOR_CSS =
        '[data-te-hover]{outline:2px dashed #3b82f6 !important;outline-offset:-2px !important;cursor:pointer !important}' +
        '[data-te-selected]{outline:3px solid #f59e0b !important;outline-offset:-3px !important}' +
        'html.te-show-hidden [data-te-hidden]{display:revert !important;max-height:none !important;' +
        'overflow:visible !important;visibility:visible !important;opacity:.5 !important;' +
        'background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(220,53,69,.22) 0 6px,transparent 6px 12px) !important}';
    const TEXT_EDIT_BLOCKED = new Set(['html', 'head', 'style', 'script', 'title']);
    const MAX_INNER = 20000;
    const METHOD_KEY = 'te.hideMethod';
    const CUSTOM_KEY = 'te.hideCustom';

    let original = '';
    let src = '';
    let nodes = [];
    let selected = []; // node ids, in selection order
    let imgRatio = 0;
    const history = [];
    const listeners = []; // told after every render: onChange()

    const doc = () => frame.contentDocument;
    const elOf = id => (doc() ? doc().querySelector('[data-te="' + id + '"]') : null);
    const tagOf = node => TE.tagRawOf(src, node);
    const show = (id, visible) => $e(id).classList.toggle('d-none', !visible);

    // ── the content box ──────────────────────────────────────────
    // An HTML editor, so the markup you are editing is readable: tags and
    // attributes coloured, long lines wrapped, and the box growing with the
    // content instead of six fixed rows of one long string. The plain
    // textarea stays underneath and takes over if ace did not load, so the
    // panel is never left with nothing to type into.
    let teEditor = null;

    if (window.ace) {
        try {
            teEditor = ace.edit('teTextEditor');
            teEditor.setTheme('ace/theme/chrome');
            teEditor.getSession().setMode('ace/mode/html');
            teEditor.setOptions({
                fontSize: '12px',
                wrap: true,
                minLines: 6,
                maxLines: 24,
                showPrintMargin: false,
                highlightActiveLine: false,
            });
            teEditor.renderer.setScrollMargin(4, 4);
            // what is being edited is a fragment - a <td>, a <span>, the
            // inside of an <a> - so the html validator flags every one of them
            // as malformed and fills the gutter with errors that are not
            teEditor.session.setUseWorker(false);
        } catch (e) {
            teEditor = null;
        }
    }

    if (!teEditor) {
        $e('teTextEditor').classList.add('d-none');
        $e('teText').classList.remove('d-none');
    }

    const teTextGet = () => (teEditor ? teEditor.getValue() : $e('teText').value);
    const teTextSet = (value) => {
        if (!teEditor) {
            $e('teText').value = value;

            return;
        }
        teEditor.session.setValue(value);
        teEditor.clearSelection();
        // resize(true), not resize(): only the forced one re-runs the
        // autosize that minLines/maxLines drive. Deferred because the box is
        // hidden until an element is picked, and ace measures itself as
        // zero-height while it is.
        setTimeout(() => teEditor.resize(true), 0);
    };

    // ── hide method ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    const store = {
        get: key => {
            try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch (e) { return null; }
        },
        set: (key, value) => {
            try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (e) { /* preview / private mode */ }
        },
    };
    const presetMethods = () => [...$e('teHideMethod').options].map(o => o.value).filter(v => v !== 'custom');
    const customMethod = () => $e('teHideCustom').value.trim();

    function currentMethod() {
        return $e('teHideMethod').value === 'custom' ? customMethod() : $e('teHideMethod').value;
    }

    function methodLabel(method) {
        const opt = [...$e('teHideMethod').options].find(o => o.value !== 'custom' && TE.sameMethod(o.value, method));
        return opt ? opt.value : 'custom';
    }

    // every preset (and the custom one) is recognised as "hidden", whichever is picked,
    // so elements hidden with another method can still be unhidden or switched
    function registerMethods() {
        TE.setHideMethods([...presetMethods(), customMethod()]);
    }

    (function restoreMethod() {
        const custom = store.get(CUSTOM_KEY);
        if (custom) $e('teHideCustom').value = custom;
        const saved = store.get(METHOD_KEY);
        if (saved && [...$e('teHideMethod').options].some(o => o.value === saved)) $e('teHideMethod').value = saved;
        show('teHideCustom', $e('teHideMethod').value === 'custom');
        registerMethods();
    }());

    // The preview must never run the template or navigate away. This copy is only
    // for display; the output is always built from the pasted text itself.
    function sanitizeForPreview(html) {
        return html
            .replace(/<script\b[\s\S]*?<\/script\s*>/gi, '')
            .replace(/<meta\b[^>]*http-equiv\s*=\s*["']?refresh[^>]*>/gi, '')
            .replace(/<base\b[^>]*>/gi, '')
            .replace(/\son[a-z]+\s*=\s*("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/gi, '');
    }

    // Keep a leading <!DOCTYPE> first, or the preview drops into quirks mode and
    // tables render differently from how mail clients show them.
    function withEditorCss(html) {
        const css = '<style id="te-editor-css">' + EDITOR_CSS + '</style>';
        const m = /^\s*<!doctype[^>]*>/i.exec(html);
        return m ? m[0] + css + html.slice(m[0].length) : css + html;
    }

    // nextSelection: ids to select after an edit that added or removed elements
    function render(nextSelection) {
        const prevNames = selected.map(id => nodes[id] && nodes[id].name);
        nodes = TE.parse(src);
        if (nextSelection) {
            selected = nextSelection.filter(id => nodes[id]);
        } else if (selected.some((id, k) => !nodes[id] || nodes[id].name !== prevNames[k])) {
            // ids are document-order indexes; drop the selection if they no longer
            // point at the same kind of element (e.g. undo of a content edit)
            selected = [];
        }
        const scrollY = doc() && doc().defaultView ? doc().defaultView.scrollY : 0;
        const preview = TE.previewHtml(src, nodes, {previewDomain: $e('tePreviewDomain').value.trim()});

        frame.onload = () => {
            wireFrame();
            if (doc() && doc().defaultView) doc().defaultView.scrollTo(0, scrollY);
            syncSelection();
            updatePanel();
        };
        frame.srcdoc = withEditorCss(sanitizeForPreview(preview));

        show('teEmpty', false);
        if ($e('teOutput')) $e('teOutput').value = src;
        if ($e('teOutStatus')) $e('teOutStatus').textContent = src === original ? '— unchanged' : '— edited';
        $e('teUndo').disabled = history.length === 0;
        $e('teReset').disabled = src === original;
        updatePanel();
        listeners.forEach(fn => fn(src));
    }

    function wireFrame() {
        const d = doc();
        if (!d || !d.documentElement) return;
        d.documentElement.classList.toggle('te-show-hidden', $e('teShowHidden').checked);

        let hovered = null;
        const target = e => (e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-te]') : null);

        d.addEventListener('mouseover', e => {
            const el = target(e);
            if (hovered && hovered !== el) hovered.removeAttribute('data-te-hover');
            if (el) el.setAttribute('data-te-hover', '');
            hovered = el;
        }, true);
        d.addEventListener('mouseout', e => {
            if (!e.relatedTarget && hovered) {
                hovered.removeAttribute('data-te-hover');
                hovered = null;
            }
        }, true);
        d.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            const el = target(e);
            if (!el) return;
            const id = Number(el.getAttribute('data-te'));
            if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey) {
                selected = selected.includes(id) ? selected.filter(x => x !== id) : [...selected, id];
            } else {
                selected = [id];
            }
            syncSelection();
            updatePanel();
        }, true);
        ['auxclick', 'submit', 'dragstart'].forEach(type => d.addEventListener(type, e => e.preventDefault(), true));
    }

    function syncSelection() {
        const d = doc();
        if (!d) return;
        d.querySelectorAll('[data-te-selected]').forEach(el => el.removeAttribute('data-te-selected'));
        selected.forEach(id => {
            const el = elOf(id);
            if (el) el.setAttribute('data-te-selected', '');
        });
    }

    function parentIdOf(id) {
        const el = elOf(id);
        const p = el && el.parentElement ? el.parentElement.closest('[data-te]') : null;
        return p ? Number(p.getAttribute('data-te')) : null;
    }

    function snippet(node, el) {
        const tag = tagOf(node);
        if (node.name === 'img') return (TE.getAttr(tag, 'src') || '').split('/').pop();
        if (node.name === 'a' && !(el && el.textContent.trim())) return TE.getAttr(tag, 'href') || '';
        return el ? el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 70) : '';
    }

    function styleHasProp(tag, prop) {
        const style = TE.getAttr(tag, 'style') || '';
        return new RegExp('(^|;)\\s*' + prop + '\\s*:', 'i').test(style);
    }

    function updatePanel() {
        const n = selected.length;
        $e('teSelTitle').textContent = n ? n + ' selected' : 'Nothing selected';

        const list = $e('teSelList');
        list.innerHTML = '';
        selected.forEach(id => {
            const node = nodes[id];
            if (!node) return;
            const li = document.createElement('li');
            const code = document.createElement('code');
            code.textContent = '<' + node.name + '>';
            const snip = document.createElement('span');
            snip.className = 'te-snippet';
            snip.textContent = snippet(node, elOf(id));
            li.append(code, snip);
            const hiddenBy = TE.hiddenWith(tagOf(node));
            if (hiddenBy !== null) {
                const badge = document.createElement('span');
                badge.className = 'badge badge-warning';
                badge.textContent = 'hidden';
                badge.title = hiddenBy;
                li.append(badge);
            }
            list.append(li);
        });

        const method = currentMethod();
        const hiddenBy = selected.map(id => (nodes[id] ? TE.hiddenWith(tagOf(nodes[id])) : null));
        $e('teHide').disabled = !n || !method || hiddenBy.every(m => m !== null && TE.sameMethod(m, method));
        $e('teUnhide').disabled = !n || hiddenBy.every(m => m === null);

        // hidden elements (anywhere in the template) that use a different method
        const others = method
            ? nodes.filter(node => {
                const m = TE.hiddenWith(tagOf(node));
                return m !== null && !TE.sameMethod(m, method);
            })
            : [];
        $e('teSwitchAll').disabled = !others.length;
        $e('teSwitchAll').textContent = others.length
            ? 'Switch ' + others.length + ' hidden element' + (others.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' to this method'
            : 'All hidden elements use this method';
        $e('teSwitchAll').dataset.ids = others.map(node => node.id).join(',');
        const usage = {};
        nodes.forEach(node => {
            const m = TE.hiddenWith(tagOf(node));
            if (m !== null) usage[methodLabel(m)] = (usage[methodLabel(m)] || 0) + 1;
        });
        $e('teHideUsage').textContent = Object.keys(usage).length
            ? 'In template: ' + Object.entries(usage).map(([m, c]) => c + ' × ' + m).join(', ')
            : '';
        $e('teClear').disabled = !n;
        $e('teParent').disabled = n !== 1 || parentIdOf(selected[0]) === null;

        const single = n === 1 ? nodes[selected[0]] : null;
        const el = single ? elOf(single.id) : null;

        // image
        const isImg = !!single && single.name === 'img';
        show('teImageBox', isImg);
        if (isImg) {
            const tag = tagOf(single);
            const box = el ? el.getBoundingClientRect() : {width: 0, height: 0};
            const w = parseInt(TE.getAttr(tag, 'width'), 10) || Math.round(box.width) || '';
            const h = parseInt(TE.getAttr(tag, 'height'), 10) || Math.round(box.height) || '';
            $e('teImgSrc').value = TE.getAttr(tag, 'src') ?? '';
            $e('teImgW').value = w;
            $e('teImgH').value = h;
            imgRatio = el && el.naturalWidth && el.naturalHeight
                ? el.naturalWidth / el.naturalHeight
                : (w && h ? w / h : 0);
            // (its real size, when the preview has loaded it: what "Get size" would put in the boxes)
            $e('teImgReal').textContent = el && el.naturalWidth && el.naturalHeight
                ? `Real size: ${el.naturalWidth} × ${el.naturalHeight} px`
                : '';
        }

        // link: the selected <a>, or the link wrapped around the selection
        let linkNode = null;
        if (single && single.name === 'a') {
            linkNode = single;
        } else if (el) {
            const a = el.closest('a[data-te]');
            if (a) linkNode = nodes[Number(a.getAttribute('data-te'))];
        }
        const canAddLink = !linkNode && isImg;
        show('teLinkBox', !!linkNode || canAddLink);
        show('teLinkRemove', !!linkNode && linkNode.innerEnd !== null);
        if (linkNode) {
            $e('teLinkTitle').textContent = linkNode === single ? 'Link' : 'Link around this element';
            $e('teLinkApply').textContent = 'Apply link';
            $e('teLinkHref').value = TE.getAttr(tagOf(linkNode), 'href') ?? '';
            $e('teLinkBox').dataset.node = linkNode.id;
            $e('teLinkBox').dataset.mode = 'edit';
        } else if (canAddLink) {
            $e('teLinkTitle').textContent = 'This image has no link';
            $e('teLinkApply').textContent = 'Add link';
            $e('teLinkHref').value = '';
            $e('teLinkBox').dataset.node = single.id;
            $e('teLinkBox').dataset.mode = 'add';
        }

        // content
        let note = '';
        let editable = false;
        if (single && !TEXT_EDIT_BLOCKED.has(single.name) && single.innerStart !== null) {
            if (single.innerEnd === null) {
                note = 'This element has no closing tag in the template, so its content can\'t be edited here. Select an element inside it instead.';
            } else if (single.innerEnd - single.innerStart > MAX_INNER) {
                note = 'This element\'s content is too large to edit here. Select a smaller element inside it.';
            } else {
                editable = true;
                teTextSet(TE.innerOf(src, single));
            }
        }
        show('teTextBox', editable);
        show('teTextNote', !!note);
        $e('teTextNote').textContent = note;
    }

    function commit(next, nextSelection) {
        if (next === src) return false;
        history.push(src);
        if (history.length > 100) history.shift();
        src = next;
        render(nextSelection);
        return true;
    }

    // Splice tag edits from the end of the document backwards, so every offset
    // not yet processed still points at the same bytes.
    function editTags(ids, fn) {
        let out = src;
        ids.map(id => nodes[id]).filter(Boolean)
            .sort((a, b) => b.start - a.start)
            .forEach(node => {
                const tag = TE.tagRawOf(out, node);
                const next = fn(tag, node);
                if (next !== tag) out = TE.replaceTag(out, node, next);
            });
        return commit(out);
    }

    // start over on this HTML: it becomes the "original" that Reset goes back to
    function load(html) {
        original = src = html;
        history.length = 0;
        selected = [];
        render();
    }

    // ── actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    on('teLoad', 'click', () => {
        const raw = $e('teInput').value;
        if (!raw.trim()) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'warning', title: 'Paste a template first'});
            return;
        }
        const decoded = TE.decode(raw);
        load(decoded.html);
        $e('teStatus').textContent = decoded.wasQp ? 'Loaded — decoded from quoted-printable.' : 'Loaded.';
    });

    $e('tePreviewDomain').addEventListener('change', () => src && render());

    $e('teShowHidden').addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (doc() && doc().documentElement) {
            doc().documentElement.classList.toggle('te-show-hidden', $e('teShowHidden').checked);
        }
    });

    $e('teHideMethod').addEventListener('change', () => {
        const isCustom = $e('teHideMethod').value === 'custom';
        show('teHideCustom', isCustom);
        if (isCustom) $e('teHideCustom').focus();
        store.set(METHOD_KEY, $e('teHideMethod').value);
        updatePanel();
    });

    $e('teHideCustom').addEventListener('change', () => {
        store.set(CUSTOM_KEY, customMethod());
        registerMethods();
        if (src) render(); // the preview's hidden markers depend on the known methods
    });

    function withMethod(fn) {
        const method = currentMethod();
        if (!method || !method.includes(':')) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'warning', title: 'Enter a custom hide style', text: 'For example: display: none; mso-hide: all'});
            return;
        }
        fn(method);
    }

    $e('teHide').addEventListener('click', () => withMethod(method => editTags(selected, tag => TE.hide(tag, method))));
    $e('teUnhide').addEventListener('click', () => editTags(selected, tag => TE.unhide(tag)));
    $e('teSwitchAll').addEventListener('click', () => withMethod(method => {
        const ids = ($e('teSwitchAll').dataset.ids || '').split(',').filter(Boolean).map(Number);
        editTags(ids, tag => TE.hide(tag, method));
    }));

    $e('teParent').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const parent = parentIdOf(selected[0]);
        if (parent === null) return;
        selected = [parent];
        syncSelection();
        updatePanel();
    });

    $e('teClear').addEventListener('click', () => {
        selected = [];
        syncSelection();
        updatePanel();
    });

    $e('teImgW').addEventListener('input', () => {
        const w = parseInt($e('teImgW').value, 10);
        if ($e('teImgLock').checked && imgRatio && w > 0) $e('teImgH').value = Math.round(w / imgRatio);
    });
    $e('teImgH').addEventListener('input', () => {
        const h = parseInt($e('teImgH').value, 10);
        if ($e('teImgLock').checked && imgRatio && h > 0) $e('teImgW').value = Math.round(h * imgRatio);
    });

    // "Get size": the real size of the image at the URL in the box - the one typed, applied or
    // not - read by loading it here in the browser, and put in the two boxes. The proportions
    // kept from then on are the image's own.
    const realImageSize = (url) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const img = new Image();
        const late = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('late')), 15000);
        img.onload = () => {
            clearTimeout(late);
            img.naturalWidth > 0 && img.naturalHeight > 0 ? resolve([img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight]) : reject(new Error('no size'));
        };
        img.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(late); reject(new Error('not loaded')); };
        img.src = url;
    });
    $e('teImgSize').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const url = $e('teImgSrc').value.trim(), note = $e('teImgReal'), button = $e('teImgSize');
        if (!/^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(url) && !/^data:image\//i.test(url)) {
            note.textContent = url === '' ? 'Put the address of the image in the box first.'
                : 'This is not an address an image can be loaded from (a placeholder, or a file inside the message).';
            return;
        }
        button.disabled = true;
        note.textContent = 'Loading the image...';
        realImageSize(url).then(([w, h]) => {
            $e('teImgW').value = w;
            $e('teImgH').value = h;
            imgRatio = w / h;
            note.textContent = `Real size: ${w} × ${h} px - put in the boxes. "Apply image" sets it.`;
        }).catch(() => {
            note.textContent = 'The image could not be loaded from this address.'
                + (location.protocol === 'https:' && /^http:/i.test(url) ? ' It is an http address: the browser may refuse it on this https page.' : '');
        }).finally(() => { button.disabled = false; });
    });

    $e('teImgApply').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const node = nodes[selected[0]];
        if (!node || node.name !== 'img') return;
        editTags([node.id], tag => {
            let t = tag;
            const url = $e('teImgSrc').value.trim();
            if (url !== '' && url !== (TE.getAttr(tag, 'src') ?? '')) t = TE.setAttr(t, 'src', url);

            [['width', $e('teImgW').value], ['height', $e('teImgH').value]].forEach(([prop, raw]) => {
                const px = parseInt(raw, 10);
                if (!(px > 0) || String(px) === TE.getAttr(tag, prop)) return;
                // attribute for Outlook; inline style too when the template sets one,
                // otherwise that style would silently override the new size
                t = TE.setAttr(t, prop, String(px));
                if (styleHasProp(t, prop)) t = TE.setStyleProp(t, prop, px + 'px');
            });
            return t;
        });
    });

    $e('teLinkApply').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = Number($e('teLinkBox').dataset.node);
        const node = nodes[id];
        if (!node) return;
        const href = $e('teLinkHref').value.trim();

        if ($e('teLinkBox').dataset.mode !== 'add') {
            editTags([id], tag => (href === (TE.getAttr(tag, 'href') ?? '') ? tag : TE.setAttr(tag, 'href', href)));
            return;
        }

        if (!href) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'warning', title: 'Enter the link URL'});
            return;
        }
        // linked images get a border in some clients unless border="0" is set
        let out = src;
        const tag = tagOf(node);
        if (TE.getAttr(tag, 'border') === null && !/(^|;)\s*border\s*:/i.test(TE.getAttr(tag, 'style') || '')) {
            out = TE.replaceTag(out, node, TE.setAttr(tag, 'border', '0'));
        }
        const img = TE.parse(out)[id];
        out = TE.wrap(out, img, TE.setAttr('<a>', 'href', href), '</a>');
        // the new <a> takes this id, the image moves to the next one
        commit(out, [id + 1]);
    });

    $e('teLinkRemove').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = Number($e('teLinkBox').dataset.node);
        const node = nodes[id];
        if (!node || node.name !== 'a' || node.innerEnd === null) return;
        // elements after the removed <a> move up one id
        commit(TE.unwrap(src, node), selected.filter(x => x !== id).map(x => (x > id ? x - 1 : x)));
    });

    $e('teTextApply').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const node = nodes[selected[0]];
        if (!node || node.innerEnd === null) return;
        commit(TE.replaceInner(src, node, teTextGet()));
    });

    $e('teUndo').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!history.length) return;
        src = history.pop();
        render();
    });

    $e('teReset').addEventListener('click', () => {
        swal.fire({
            icon: 'question',
            title: 'Discard all edits?',
            text: 'The editor goes back to the template exactly as you pasted it.',
            showCancelButton: true,
            confirmButtonText: 'Discard edits',
        }).then(r => {
            if (r.isConfirmed || r.value) {
                selected = [];
                commit(original);
            }
        });
    });

    on('teCopy', 'click', () => {
        const btn = $e('teCopy');
        const done = () => {
            btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
            setTimeout(() => (btn.textContent = 'Copy'), 1500);
        };
        if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(src).then(done);
        } else {
            $e('teOutput').select();
            document.execCommand('copy');
            done();
        }
    });

    on('teDownload', 'click', () => {
        if (!src) return;
        const blob = new Blob([src], {type: 'text/html'});
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = 'template-' + Date.now() + '.html';
        a.click();
    });

    return {
        load,                              // show this HTML, as the new original
        value: () => src,                  // the HTML with every edit so far
        edited: () => src !== original,
        transform: fn => commit(fn(src)),  // one undoable edit of the whole HTML; false if nothing changed
        onChange: fn => listeners.push(fn), // after every change, undo and reset included
    };
}());
</script>

<script>
$(function () {
    const modal = $('#templateEditorModal');
    const toast = swal.mixin({toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 4000});
    const Range = ace.require('ace/range').Range;
    let open = null; // {part, body, html} of the edit in progress

    // what the form says for [charset] / [transfer] / [content_type]
    const formTags = () => ({
        charset: $('#charset').val(),
        transfer: $('#transfer').val(),
        contentType: $('#content_type').val(),
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#template_editor', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!window.TemplateEditor || !window.campaignEditors) return;
        const body = window.campaignEditors.body.getValue();
        if (!body.trim()) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'info', title: 'Template Editor', text: 'The body is empty: add the body first.'});
            return;
        }
        const found = TemplateMime.extract(body, window.campaignEditors.header.getValue(), formTags());
        if (!found.ok) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'info', title: 'Template Editor', text: found.error});
            return;
        }
        open = {part: found.part, body, html: found.html};
        const encoding = {'quoted-printable': 'quoted-printable', base64: 'base64', plain: 'not encoded'}[found.part.cte];
        $('#teModalInfo').text(`Editing the ${found.part.label} (${encoding}, ${found.part.charset})`);
        $('#teModalNotes').toggleClass('d-none', !found.part.notes.length).text(found.part.notes.join(' '));
        modal.modal('show');
    });

    // ── Domains: change a domain, or add a tag to the end of its links ──
    const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({'&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'})[c]);
    const LABEL = '(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?|\\[[a-z_0-9:]+\\])';
    const DOMAIN = new RegExp('^' + LABEL + '(?:\\.' + LABEL + ')*$', 'i');
    const validDomain = (d) => DOMAIN.test(d) && (d.includes('.') || /^\[[a-z_0-9:]+\]$/i.test(d));
    const plural = (n, word) => n + ' ' + word + (n === 1 ? '' : 's');

    function renderDomains() {
        if ($('#teDomains').hasClass('d-none') || !open) return;
        const rows = TE.hosts(window.TemplateEditor.value());
        if (!rows.length) {
            $('#teDomainRows').html('<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-muted">No links or images with a domain in this HTML.</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        $('#teDomainRows').html(rows.map((r) => {
            const used = [r.links && plural(r.links, 'link'), r.images && plural(r.images, 'image'), r.other && plural(r.other, 'other')].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
            return `<tr data-host="${esc(r.host)}">
                <td><code>${esc(r.host)}</code></td>
                <td class="small text-nowrap">${used}</td>
                <td><div class="input-group input-group-sm">
                    <input class="form-control te-new-domain" placeholder="new-domain.com">
                    <div class="input-group-append"><button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary te-change-domain">Change</button></div>
                </div></td>
                <td><div class="input-group input-group-sm">
                    <input class="form-control te-suffix" value="[rndln_8]">
                    <div class="input-group-append"><button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary te-add-suffix"${r.links || $('#teDomainAllKinds').is(':checked') ? '' : ' disabled title="No links on this domain"'}>Add</button></div>
                </div></td>
            </tr>`;
        }).join(''));
    }

    $('#teDomainsToggle').on('click', function () {
        $('#teDomains').toggleClass('d-none');
        $(this).toggleClass('active', !$('#teDomains').hasClass('d-none'));
        renderDomains();
    });
    $('#teDomainAllKinds').on('change', renderDomains);
    window.TemplateEditor && window.TemplateEditor.onChange(renderDomains);

    const countUrls = (html, pick) => {
        let n = 0;
        TE.editUrls(html, (url, kind) => { const u = TE.splitUrl(url); if (pick(u, kind)) n++; return null; });
        return n;
    };

    $('#teDomainRows').on('click', '.te-change-domain', function () {
        const row = $(this).closest('tr'), host = row.data('host'), to = row.find('.te-new-domain').val().trim();
        if (!validDomain(to)) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'warning', title: 'Enter a domain', text: 'For example new-domain.com, or a tag such as [domain].'});
            return;
        }
        const n = countUrls(window.TemplateEditor.value(), (u) => u && u.host.toLowerCase() === String(host).toLowerCase());
        if (window.TemplateEditor.transform((src) => TE.changeHost(src, String(host), to))) {
            toast.fire({icon: 'success', title: `${plural(n, 'address')} now on ${to}`});
        }
    });

    $('#teDomainRows').on('click', '.te-add-suffix', function () {
        const row = $(this).closest('tr'), host = String(row.data('host')), suffix = row.find('.te-suffix').val().trim();
        if (!suffix || /[\s"'<>]/.test(suffix)) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'warning', title: 'Enter what to add', text: 'For example [rndln_8]; no spaces or quotes.'});
            return;
        }
        const allKinds = $('#teDomainAllKinds').is(':checked');
        const before = window.TemplateEditor.value();
        if (window.TemplateEditor.transform((src) => TE.appendToUrls(src, host, suffix, {allKinds}))) {
            const added = window.TemplateEditor.value().split(suffix).length - before.split(suffix).length;
            toast.fire({icon: 'success', title: `${suffix} added to ${plural(added, allKinds ? 'address' : 'link')} on ${host}`});
        } else {
            toast.fire({icon: 'info', title: `Every ${allKinds ? 'address' : 'link'} on ${host} already ends with ${suffix}`});
        }
    });

    // the preview measures itself, so load once the pop-up is on screen
    modal.on('shown.bs.modal', () => open && window.TemplateEditor.load(open.html));

    const close = () => {
        open = null;
        modal.modal('hide');
    };

    modal.on('click', '[data-te-cancel]', () => {
        if (!open || !window.TemplateEditor.edited()) {
            close();
            return;
        }
        swal.fire({
            icon: 'question',
            title: 'Discard your template edits?',
            text: 'The body stays as it was.',
            showCancelButton: true,
            confirmButtonText: 'Discard',
        }).then((r) => (r.isConfirmed || r.value) && close());
    });

    $('#teApply').on('click', function () {
        if (!open) return;
        if (!window.TemplateEditor.edited()) {
            close();
            toast.fire({icon: 'info', title: 'No changes: the body is unchanged'});
            return;
        }

        const editor = window.campaignEditors.body;
        if (editor.getValue() !== open.body) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'warning', title: 'The body changed while the editor was open', text: 'Close the editor and open it again.'});
            return;
        }

        let updated;
        try {
            updated = TemplateMime.apply(open.body, open.part, window.TemplateEditor.value());
        } catch (err) {
            swal.fire({icon: 'error', title: 'Could not apply the edits', text: err.message});
            return;
        }

        // replace only the HTML part's text, so Ctrl+Z in the body editor undoes it in one step
        const doc = editor.session.getDocument();
        const from = doc.indexToPosition(open.part.start);
        const to = doc.indexToPosition(open.part.end);
        const text = updated.slice(open.part.start, updated.length - (open.body.length - open.part.end));
        editor.session.replace(new Range(from.row, from.column, to.row, to.column), text);

        close();
        toast.fire({icon: 'success', title: 'Body updated: review, test and save as usual (Ctrl+Z undoes it)'});
    });
});
</script>
